words.enDefinition: the fourth generation of mobile network technology

examples.en: Our phones switched to 4G when the train moved farther from the city centre.
examples.zh: 火车离市中心更远后，我们的手机切换到了「第四代移动网络」。

examples.en: The coverage map showed 4G service along much of my usual bus route to campus.
examples.zh: 覆盖地图显示，我平时坐公交上学的大部分路段有「第四代移动网络」服务。

words.enDefinition: the fifth generation of mobile network technology

examples.en: I saw 5G on the screen while waiting for my bus outside the library.
examples.zh: 在图书馆外等公交时，我看见屏幕上显示「第五代移动网络」。

examples.en: The phone supported 5G, but the signal varied between my dorm and the station.
examples.zh: 那部手机支持「第五代移动网络」，不过宿舍和车站之间的信号有变化。

words.enDefinition: written exchanges about academic work, study, or university matters

examples.en: I use my university account for academic correspondence about my research project.
examples.zh: 研究项目有关的「学术邮件往来」，我用学校的账户收发。

examples.en: My supervisor suggested keeping our academic correspondence about the project in one folder.
examples.zh: 导师建议把项目有关的「学术邮件往来」放在同一个文件夹。

collocations: keep a record of academic correspondence

words.enDefinition: To approve a proposed change so it becomes part of a document.

examples.en: I chose to accept a suggestion that made the chart title clearer for our classmates.
examples.zh: 有一条建议能让同学更容易看懂图表标题，我决定「接受这条修订建议」。

examples.en: Before you accept a suggestion, please check that it still matches the values in our table.
examples.zh: 在「接受修订建议」之前，请确认它仍然符合我们表里的数值。

collocations: accept a suggestion from a reviewer

words.enDefinition: to agree to a provider's stated conditions for using its network

examples.en: I had to accept network terms before opening my university timetable at the station.
examples.zh: 我先「同意网络使用条件」，才能在车站打开学校课表。

examples.en: The welcome screen asked visitors to accept network terms for the temporary connection.
examples.zh: 欢迎页面请访客「同意网络使用条件」，以使用临时网络。

collocations: prompt someone to accept network terms

words.enDefinition: A status showing that a request for permission has still to be answered.

examples.en: The screen said “Access request pending” after I asked to read the updated seminar notes.
examples.zh: 我请求读取更新过的研讨课笔记后，屏幕显示「访问请求待处理」。

examples.en: I saw “Access request pending” when I reopened the document during our group meeting.
examples.zh: 小组开会时我重新打开文档，看到了「访问请求待处理」。

collocations: a notice saying access request pending
see access request pending on a file

words.enDefinition: wording introducing the final date or time that access continues

examples.en: The app displayed “Access until” above the expiry date in my settings.
examples.zh: 应用在设置里的到期日期上方显示了「可使用至」。

examples.en: I checked “Access until” before planning my last session with the app.
examples.zh: 安排最后一次用这个应用前，我查看了「可使用至」。

words.enDefinition: options that make a device or service easier to use for people with different access needs

examples.en: I opened accessibility settings to adjust how the text looked on my new tablet.
examples.zh: 我打开「无障碍设置」，调整了新平板上的文字显示。

examples.en: The assistant showed us where to find accessibility settings on the library computers.
examples.zh: 工作人员给我们指了图书馆电脑上的「无障碍设置」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a quick way to turn an accessibility feature on or off

examples.en: I set up an accessibility shortcut to turn the magnifier on during my reading.
examples.zh: 我设置了一个「无障碍快捷操作」，阅读时可以快速打开放大镜。

examples.en: The tutor showed me which accessibility shortcut was available on the computer in class.
examples.zh: 导师给我看了教室电脑可以用哪个「无障碍快捷操作」。

words.enDefinition: an incident in which another person gains unauthorised control of or access to an account

examples.en: The helpdesk investigated a possible account compromise after the student noticed unfamiliar activity.
examples.zh: 那位学生发现不熟悉的活动后，服务台调查了一起可能的「账户安全失守事件」。

examples.en: We covered account compromise in training for volunteers who manage the society's email.
examples.zh: 给管理社团邮箱的志愿者培训时，我们讲到了「账户安全失守事件」。

words.enDefinition: measures that help keep an account safe from unauthorised use

examples.en: The orientation guide explains account protection for the university portal and library service.
examples.zh: 入学指南介绍了校园门户和图书馆服务的「账户保护」。

examples.en: Student IT held a workshop on account protection at the beginning of term.
examples.zh: 学期开始时，学生信息技术部门办了一场「账户保护」工作坊。

words.enDefinition: the controls for information and options associated with an account

examples.en: I opened account settings to see which plan was active.
examples.zh: 我打开「账户设置」，看看当前用的是哪个套餐。

examples.en: The app displayed my plan name near the bottom of account settings.
examples.zh: 应用在「账户设置」靠底部的位置显示了我的套餐名称。

words.enDefinition: a control for choosing between accounts you already use

examples.en: I used the account switcher to open my university profile before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我用「账户切换器」打开了学校账户。

examples.en: The account switcher showed which profile was selected on my laptop.
examples.zh: 「账户切换器」在我的笔记本电脑上显示了当前选中的账户。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that an account cannot be used for a limited period or until a check is completed

examples.en: I saw Account temporarily locked when I entered the wrong password several times.
examples.zh: 我输错好几次密码后，看到了「账户已暂时锁定」。

examples.en: When Account temporarily locked appeared again, I contacted the helpdesk from the official portal.
examples.zh: 再次出现「账户已暂时锁定」时，我通过官方门户联系了服务台。

words.enDefinition: an overview of the service use recorded against an account

examples.en: I checked my account usage summary after using the phone more often that week.
examples.zh: 那一周手机用得更多，我查看了「账户用量汇总」。

examples.en: The account usage summary showed a separate total for each line on our plan.
examples.zh: 「账户用量汇总」分别显示了套餐下各条线路的使用总量。

words.enDefinition: A collaborator currently present in a shared file or workspace.

examples.en: The document showed one active collaborator when I logged in to review the conclusion after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭后我登录查看结论时，文档显示有一位「在线协作者」。

examples.en: I saw an active collaborator on the group whiteboard even though everyone had left the study room.
examples.zh: 虽然大家都离开自习室了，我仍看到小组白板上有一位「在线协作者」。

words.enDefinition: a subscription that currently gives access to its services

examples.en: The account page showed an active subscription for the drawing programme.
examples.zh: 账户页面显示这个绘画软件有一项「有效订阅」。

examples.en: I checked whether my active subscription was for the reading or drawing app.
examples.zh: 我确认了这项「有效订阅」对应的是阅读应用还是绘画应用。

words.enDefinition: an input device that can be activated in a way suited to the user's abilities

examples.en: The adaptive switch was connected to the tablet we used during the accessibility demonstration.
examples.zh: 「辅助操作开关」连在我们做无障碍演示时用的平板上。

examples.en: My tutor helped position the adaptive switch so it was within easy reach.
examples.zh: 导师帮忙把「辅助操作开关」放到了我容易够到的位置。

words.enDefinition: to include another person in an existing group chat

examples.en: I asked how to add a group member who had just joined our club.
examples.zh: 我问怎样把刚加入社团的人「添加为群成员」。

examples.en: The settings gave us an option to add a group member by name.
examples.zh: 设置里有个选项，可以按姓名「添加一名群成员」。

collocations: choose to add a group member
ask an admin to add a group member
an option to add a group member

words.zhGloss: 新增一条移动通信线路
words.enDefinition: to attach another mobile service line to an existing plan or account
acceptedZhAnswers: 新增一条移动通信线路

examples.en: I asked how much it would cost to add a line to my account.
examples.zh: 我问在自己的账户里「新增一条移动通信线路」要花多少钱。

examples.en: The provider offered to add a line for the tablet under our current plan.
examples.zh: 运营商提出，在现有套餐下为平板「新增一条移动通信线路」。

collocations: add a line to your plan
add a line for a device

words.enDefinition: to include a teaching staff member's title when greeting them

examples.en: Our tutor explained how to address your instructor by title in a first email.
examples.zh: 导师讲了第一封邮件里怎么「用头衔称呼任课老师」。

examples.en: You can address your instructor by title if that's the form they use themselves.
examples.zh: 如果对方平常就是这么自称的，你可以「用头衔称呼任课老师」。

collocations: choose to address your instructor by title
remember to address your instructor by title
address your instructor by title in writing

words.enDefinition: a scheme asking for money upfront for a benefit the victim never receives

examples.en: The student advice centre gave an example of an advance-fee scam in its handout.
examples.zh: 学生咨询中心在讲义里举了一个「要求预付费用的诈骗」的例子。

examples.en: The message was flagged as an advance-fee scam before anyone paid the requested amount.
examples.zh: 在有人付出所要费用前，这条消息就被标为「要求预付费用的诈骗」。

collocations: warn people about an advance-fee scam

words.enDefinition: A status message confirming the application has saved the changes made so far.

examples.en: The All changes saved message appeared before I closed the document and left the study room.
examples.zh: 我关掉文档离开自习室之前，屏幕上出现了「所有修改已保存」的提示。

examples.en: Once I saw All changes saved, I told the group the corrected handout was ready.
examples.zh: 看到「所有修改已保存」后，我就告诉小组修改好的讲义可以用了。

words.enDefinition: to let alarms sound while other alerts are being silenced

examples.en: I wanted my bedtime settings to allow alarms through even when calls were silent.
examples.zh: 我想让就寝设置在来电被静音时仍「允许闹钟响铃」。

examples.en: Her focus profile could allow alarms through while the rest of the device stayed quiet.
examples.zh: 她的专注模式可以「允许闹钟响铃」，设备其他提示仍保持安静。

collocations: set the mode to allow alarms through

words.enDefinition: gives an app permission to show alerts on your device

examples.en: I chose "Allow notifications" because I needed updates from the course app.
examples.zh: 我需要课程应用发来的更新，所以选择了「允许通知」。

examples.en: The "Allow notifications" toggle was off for the app we use in class.
examples.zh: 我们上课用的应用没有打开「允许通知」开关。

words.enDefinition: lets a later call from the same person ring through

examples.en: I saw allow repeat callers among the call options for my study profile.
examples.zh: 我在学习用专注模式的来电选项里看到了「允许重复来电」。

examples.en: The focus settings let you allow repeat callers while silencing some other calls.
examples.zh: 专注设置可以「允许重复来电」，同时静音其他一些电话。

collocations: decide whether to allow repeat callers

words.enDefinition: apps whose alerts can still appear during a focus mode

examples.en: I checked the allowed apps because my timetable update still appeared.
examples.zh: 课表更新还是弹了出来，所以我查了「允许通知的应用」。

examples.en: The focus profile listed my calendar among the allowed apps that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，专注模式把日历列在「允许通知的应用」里。

words.enDefinition: people whose calls or messages may still alert you during focus

examples.en: I added my project partner to the allowed contacts for that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我把项目搭档加进了那天下午「允许提醒的联系人」名单。

examples.en: My phone showed who was on the list of allowed contacts.
examples.zh: 手机显示了谁在「允许提醒的联系人」名单上。

collocations: put someone among the allowed contacts

words.enDefinition: a status saying you previously bought the item on your account

examples.en: The listing said “Already purchased” when I opened the drawing pack.
examples.zh: 我打开绘画素材包时，详情页写着「已经购买」。

examples.en: I saw “Already purchased” above the button for opening the extra tools.
examples.zh: 我在打开额外工具的按钮上方看到了「已经购买」。

words.enDefinition: Apple's setting for apps or contacts exempt from specified limits

examples.en: My course timetable was among the apps marked "Always Allowed" on my iPhone.
examples.zh: 在我的 iPhone 上，课程课表应用被标为「始终允许使用」。

examples.en: I checked "Always Allowed" before the evening restrictions started on my tablet.
examples.zh: 平板晚上的限制开始前，我看了看「始终允许使用」。

collocations: add an app to Always Allowed

words.enDefinition: a version containing notes or comments added beside the main text

examples.en: The professor returned an annotated copy of my essay by email.
examples.zh: 教授用邮件回传了我的论文的「带批注的副本」。

examples.en: I checked the annotated copy before rewriting the second paragraph that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚重写第二段之前，我看了看「带批注的副本」。

words.enDefinition: an Apple setting for reading incoming notifications aloud through supported devices

examples.en: I tried "Announce Notifications" with my headphones while packing for class.
examples.zh: 收拾东西准备上课时，我戴着耳机试了试「播报通知」。

examples.en: My iPhone showed which apps were included in "Announce Notifications".
examples.zh: 我的 iPhone 显示了哪些应用启用了「播报通知」。

words.enDefinition: a service option covering a year at a time

examples.en: I checked what the annual plan included before choosing the software.
examples.zh: 选软件之前，我查看了「年度套餐」包含哪些功能。

examples.en: The app showed the annual plan beneath the shorter plan options.
examples.zh: 应用把「年度套餐」列在期限较短的套餐选项下方。

collocations: the annual plan for an app

words.enDefinition: A viewer whose name is not shown to others in a shared file.

examples.en: An anonymous viewer appeared just after I sent the group the link to our reading list.
examples.zh: 我刚把阅读清单的链接发给小组，就出现了一位「匿名查看者」。

examples.en: The class demo showed how an anonymous viewer might be represented by an icon instead of a name.
examples.zh: 课堂演示给我们看了「匿名查看者」如何用图标代替姓名显示。

words.enDefinition: A sharing option that makes a file available to whoever has the link.

examples.en: The public handout was marked “Anyone with the link” on the workshop page that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，研讨活动页上的公开讲义标为「获得链接的任何人」都能看。

examples.en: We discussed what “Anyone with the link” meant before choosing how to share our notes.
examples.zh: 决定怎么共享笔记前，我们讨论了「获得链接的任何人」这个选项的含义。

collocations: a setting labeled anyone with the link
accessible to anyone with the link
a label saying anyone with the link

words.enDefinition: a group of apps offered together as a package

examples.en: The app bundle included a planner and a separate timer for study sessions.
examples.zh: 这个「应用套装」包含一个计划工具和独立的学习计时器。

examples.en: I checked which tools came in the app bundle before choosing it.
examples.zh: 选这个「应用套装」之前，我先查了里面有哪些工具。

collocations: include an app in a bundle

words.enDefinition: the written details explaining what an app does

examples.en: I read the app description to see whether it supported handwritten notes.
examples.zh: 我看了「应用说明」，想确认它是不是支持手写笔记。

examples.en: The app description mentioned a feature for saving a reading list.
examples.zh: 「应用说明」提到了保存阅读书单的功能。

words.enDefinition: the language chosen for one app's menus and messages

examples.en: I changed the app language while helping my roommate with the setup.
examples.zh: 我帮室友设置时更改了「应用语言」。

examples.en: The app language stayed English when I changed the calendar format.
examples.zh: 改完日历格式后，「应用语言」仍然是英语。

words.enDefinition: permission granted to use an app under specified terms

examples.en: I checked whether the app licence included use on my desktop.
examples.zh: 我查看了「应用使用许可」是否涵盖在台式机上使用。

examples.en: The course provided an app licence for students in the design workshop.
examples.zh: 课程为设计工作坊里的学生提供了「应用使用许可」。

words.enDefinition: the Apple Screen Time settings for limiting time in apps

examples.en: I found "App Limits" in the screen time settings on my iPhone.
examples.zh: 我在 iPhone 的屏幕使用时间设置里找到了「应用限额」。

examples.en: My tablet's "App Limits" menu listed separate options for games and other apps.
examples.zh: 我平板上的「应用限额」菜单分别列出了游戏和其他应用的选项。

collocations: check App Limits in Screen Time

words.enDefinition: a store page describing a particular app

examples.en: I opened the app listing to check what the study timer could do.
examples.zh: 我打开「应用商店详情页」，看看这个学习计时器有哪些功能。

examples.en: The app listing included the developer's name beneath the first picture.
examples.zh: 「应用商店详情页」的第一张图下面写了开发者的名称。

words.enDefinition: a short listing video showing an app in use

examples.en: The app preview video showed how a student organised her reading notes.
examples.zh: 「应用预览视频」演示了一名学生怎样整理阅读笔记。

examples.en: I watched the app preview video before opening the full description.
examples.zh: 打开完整说明前，我看了「应用预览视频」。

collocations: an app preview video on the listing

words.enDefinition: information about how an app handles or uses data

examples.en: I read the app privacy details before trying the study programme.
examples.zh: 试用这款学习软件前，我看了「应用隐私详情」。

examples.en: The app privacy details appeared near the bottom of the listing.
examples.zh: 「应用隐私详情」出现在商店详情页靠近底部的位置。

collocations: app privacy details on a listing

words.enDefinition: the person or organisation responsible for releasing an app

examples.en: I checked who the app publisher was before asking about a student edition.
examples.zh: 咨询学生版之前，我先确认了谁是「应用发行方」。

examples.en: The app publisher was listed beside the developer's support address.
examples.zh: 「应用发行方」列在开发者的支持联系地址旁边。

words.enDefinition: images on a listing showing how parts of an app look

examples.en: The app screenshots showed where I could see my weekly timetable.
examples.zh: 「应用截图」显示了在哪里可以查看我的每周课表。

examples.en: I looked through the app screenshots before choosing the language practice tool.
examples.zh: 选语言练习工具前，我先浏览了「应用截图」。

words.enDefinition: the controls for changing the behaviour of one app

examples.en: I found the calendar format under app settings after the update.
examples.zh: 更新后，我在「应用设置」里找到了日历格式。

examples.en: The app settings let me choose between two layouts for my notes.
examples.zh: 在「应用设置」里，我可以为笔记选两种排版中的一种。

words.enDefinition: a store link for finding help with a specific app

examples.en: The app support link opened a page about the classroom edition.
examples.zh: 「应用支持链接」打开了一个介绍课堂版的页面。

examples.en: I used the app support link to look up the programme's controls.
examples.zh: 我通过「应用支持链接」查看这个程序的操作方式。

collocations: an app support link on a listing

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount of time a user is allowed to spend in an app within a set period

examples.en: I set an app time limit for games before revision week began.
examples.zh: 复习周开始前，我给游戏设了「应用使用时限」。

examples.en: My phone displayed the app time limit underneath the icon for that app.
examples.zh: 手机在那个应用的图标下面显示了「应用使用时限」。

words.enDefinition: an Android control that records how much time has been spent in an app and applies a daily limit

examples.en: I set an app timer for the app I kept opening during class.
examples.zh: 我给课上总会打开的那个应用设了「应用限时器」。

examples.en: The app timer had run out by the time I finished reading.
examples.zh: 我读完材料时，「应用限时器」的时间已经用完了。

words.enDefinition: a record of app updates previously installed on a device

examples.en: I checked the app update history to see when my planner had changed.
examples.zh: 我查看了「应用更新记录」，想知道计划工具是什么时候更新的。

examples.en: The app update history listed the new version beside the installation date.
examples.zh: 「应用更新记录」把新版本和安装日期列在一起。

collocations: a date in the app update history

words.enDefinition: the Apple Screen Time feature that records app and website use

examples.en: My iPhone showed time on study websites under "App & Website Activity".
examples.zh: iPhone 在「应用与网站活动」下面显示了我访问学习网站的时长。

examples.en: The report was empty because "App & Website Activity" had not been switched on.
examples.zh: 报告是空的，因为「应用与网站活动」还没开启。

words.enDefinition: To add a version number at the end of a file name or label.

examples.en: We append a version number when we save marked copies of the diagrams for our supervisor.
examples.zh: 每次保存示意图副本供导师查看时，我们会「在末尾加版本号」。

examples.en: I asked whether to append a version number to every draft in the workshop folder.
examples.zh: 我问工作坊文件夹里的每份草稿文件名是否都要「在末尾加版本号」。

collocations: append a version number to the file name
append a version number to the title

words.enDefinition: to make the new settings take effect

examples.en: I clicked “Apply changes” to see the new layout on the screen.
examples.zh: 我点了「应用更改」，想看屏幕上的新排版。

examples.en: The preview stayed open until I chose “Apply changes” on the settings page.
examples.zh: 预览一直开着，直到我在设置页面选了「应用更改」。

words.enDefinition: to allow a person who asked to follow your account

examples.en: I chose to approve a follow request from my new classmate.
examples.zh: 我选择「通过新同学的关注请求」。

examples.en: The menu showed me where to approve a follow request from the club.
examples.zh: 菜单告诉我，在哪里可以「通过社团发来的关注请求」。

collocations: decide to approve a follow request
ask how to approve a follow request
be ready to approve a follow request

words.enDefinition: to move a conversation out of the main list while keeping it

examples.en: I decided to archive a chat about a project we had already finished.
examples.zh: 我决定把已经结束的项目的「聊天归档」。

examples.en: The help page showed how to archive a chat from the conversation list.
examples.zh: 帮助页面介绍了怎么在会话列表里「归档聊天」。

collocations: be able to archive a chat
archive a chat after a project

words.enDefinition: to take a published post off your regular profile while keeping a copy

examples.en: I decided to archive a post from the club's old rehearsal schedule.
examples.zh: 我决定把社团旧排练安排的那条「帖子归档」。

examples.en: The profile menu let me archive a post without deleting its text.
examples.zh: 主页菜单让我能「归档帖子」，同时保留帖子的文字。

collocations: an option to archive a post
archive a post from your profile

words.zhGloss: 过了截止时间还能交吗
words.enDefinition: asks whether work submitted after the deadline can still be accepted
acceptedZhAnswers: 过了截止时间还能交吗

examples.en: Are late submissions accepted for the reflection that was due after Wednesday's seminar?
examples.zh: 周三研讨课后该交的反思作业，「过了截止时间还能交吗」？

examples.en: Are late submissions accepted if we use the same link on the course page?
examples.zh: 如果通过课程页面的同一个链接交，「过了截止时间还能交吗」？

collocations: check if late submissions are accepted
are late submissions accepted for this assignment
ask whether late submissions are accepted

words.enDefinition: asks whether a set of slides has been made available

examples.en: Are the slides available from yesterday's lecture on the course page this week?
examples.zh: 本周课程页面上，「能看到昨天大课的课件幻灯片吗」？

examples.en: I asked, "Are the slides available?" because I wanted to check a diagram.
examples.zh: 我想核对一张图，所以问：「课件幻灯片能看到吗」？

collocations: ask if the slides are available
are the slides available to students
are the slides available after class

words.expression: are we allowed to work in pairs
words.lemma: are we allowed to work in pairs
words.enDefinition: asks if two students may complete a task together
acceptedEnVariants: are we allowed to work in pairs

examples.en: Are we allowed to work in pairs for the report that follows next week's field trip?
examples.zh: 下周实地考察后的报告，「我们可以两人合作吗」？

examples.en: Are we allowed to work in pairs, or should we each collect our own observations first?
examples.zh: 「我们可以两人合作吗」？还是应该先各自收集观察结果？

collocations: ask whether we are allowed to work in pairs
are we allowed to work in pairs for this task
check if we are allowed to work in pairs

words.expression: are you holding office hours this week
words.lemma: are you holding office hours this week
words.enDefinition: asks whether the instructor plans to hold office hours that week
acceptedEnVariants: are you holding office hours this week

examples.en: Are you holding office hours this week? I'd like to ask about the outline for my essay.
examples.zh: 「您这周有答疑时间吗」？我想问一下论文提纲的事。

examples.en: Are you holding office hours this week, or will the holiday change the schedule for our class?
examples.zh: 「您这周有答疑时间吗」？还是假期会影响我们班的安排？

collocations: email to ask whether you are holding office hours this week
check if you are holding office hours this week
confirm whether you are holding office hours this week

words.enDefinition: To give a specific person responsibility for following up on a comment.

examples.en: I can assign a comment about the figures to the teammate who collected the raw data.
examples.zh: 收集原始数据的组员可以回答数字方面的问题，我可以「给他指派批注」。

examples.en: Before the rehearsal, I will assign a comment about each missing slide image to its presenter.
examples.zh: 排练前，我会为涉及幻灯片缺图的问题「指派批注」，由对应的主讲同学确认。

collocations: assign a comment to a teammate
assign a comment to its author

words.enDefinition: an on-screen view of a file before it is downloaded

examples.en: I checked the attachment preview to make sure I had the correct draft.
examples.zh: 我查看了「附件预览」，确认附的是正确的草稿。

examples.en: The attachment preview showed only the first page of the reading list.
examples.zh: 「附件预览」只显示了阅读清单的第一页。

words.enDefinition: the maximum file size an email service allows for attachments

examples.en: The recording was above the attachment size limit for my university account.
examples.zh: 那段录音超出了学校邮箱的「附件大小上限」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to check the attachment size limit before sending our posters.
examples.zh: 导师请我们发海报前先查看「附件大小上限」。

words.enDefinition: a notice advising the recipient that an attachment may need to be checked or handled carefully

examples.en: I saw an attachment warning under the subject line and contacted the course administrator.
examples.zh: 我在主题行下面看到「附件安全提醒」，于是联系了课程管理员。

examples.en: Our mail service displayed an attachment warning when I opened the student's message.
examples.zh: 我打开那位学生的消息时，邮件服务显示了一条「附件安全提醒」。

collocations: pay attention to the attachment warning

words.enDefinition: a warning or notification given through a sound you can hear

examples.en: I heard an audible alert from the tablet beside my notes.
examples.zh: 我听见笔记旁边的平板发出「声音提醒」。

examples.en: The timer played an audible alert at the end of each session.
examples.zh: 每个时段结束后，计时器都播放「声音提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a control for choosing who can see a particular post

examples.en: I opened the audience selector before posting the photos from our dinner.
examples.zh: 发聚餐照片之前，我打开了「受众选择器」。

examples.en: The audience selector showed separate choices for friends and the wider public.
examples.zh: 「受众选择器」把好友和一般公众分成两个选项。

words.enDefinition: sound received by a device from a microphone or another audio source

examples.en: The recording app showed audio input from the microphone clipped to my shirt.
examples.zh: 录音应用显示收到了夹在我衣服上的麦克风的「音频输入」。

examples.en: I checked the audio input before recording my part of the group project.
examples.zh: 录制自己负责的小组项目内容之前，我检查了「音频输入」。

words.enDefinition: audio sent from a device, or its routing to a speaker, headphones or another destination

examples.en: I switched the audio output to my headphones before listening to the course recording.
examples.zh: 听课程录音前，我把「音频输出」切换到了耳机。

examples.en: The lab computer sent its audio output to the monitor instead of the room speakers.
examples.zh: 机房电脑把「音频输出」送到了显示器，没有走房间音箱。

words.enDefinition: a type of evidence used to verify identity, such as something you know, possess or are

examples.en: Our tutor explained that possession of a security key can be an authentication factor.
examples.zh: 导师解释，持有安全密钥可以作为一种「身份验证因素」。

examples.en: A password counts as an authentication factor based on what the user knows.
examples.zh: 密码属于基于用户所知信息的「身份验证因素」。

words.enDefinition: a particular technique or tool used to check someone's identity during sign-in

examples.en: I chose a different authentication method after moving my account to a new device.
examples.zh: 我把账户移到新设备后，换了一种「身份验证方式」。

examples.en: The university lets students choose an authentication method that works on their own devices.
examples.zh: 学校允许学生选一种自己设备支持的「身份验证方式」。

words.enDefinition: an app that helps verify sign-ins, for example through temporary codes or confirmation requests

examples.en: I set up an authenticator app before using my student account on a second device.
examples.zh: 在第二台设备上用学生账户之前，我先设置了「身份验证应用」。

examples.en: The authenticator app showed my university account alongside the other accounts I had added.
examples.zh: 「身份验证应用」把校园账户和我添加的其他账户一起列了出来。

words.enDefinition: a feature that automatically changes a screen's brightness in response to surrounding light

examples.en: I left auto-brightness on while moving between the sunny courtyard and the library.
examples.zh: 我在阳光下的庭院和图书馆之间来回时，让「自动亮度调节」保持开启。

examples.en: The device guide explains why auto-brightness can change the screen when you step outside.
examples.zh: 设备指南解释了为什么走到户外时，「自动亮度调节」会改变屏幕亮度。

words.enDefinition: a setting letting a device connect automatically to an available saved network

examples.en: I turned off auto-join for the guest network on the train that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，我关掉了火车访客网络的「自动连接已知网络」功能。

examples.en: The phone showed auto-join was available for the campus connection I had saved.
examples.zh: 手机显示我保存的校园连接可以使用「自动连接已知网络」。

words.enDefinition: a subscription set to continue automatically at the end of each period

examples.en: I noticed the note about an auto-renewing subscription before choosing the plan.
examples.zh: 选套餐前，我注意到了关于「自动续订套餐」的说明。

examples.en: The account listed one auto-renewing subscription among my active software plans.
examples.zh: 账户里列了我一项当前有效的「自动续订套餐」。

collocations: a label for an auto-renewing subscription

words.enDefinition: a feature that adds prepaid credit automatically at a specified time or balance level

examples.en: I turned off auto top-up before leaving the country for my summer break.
examples.zh: 暑假出国前，我关闭了「自动充值」。

examples.en: The provider sent a reminder before the next auto top-up on my mobile account.
examples.zh: 下次为手机账户「自动充值」之前，运营商发来了一条提醒。

words.enDefinition: a setting that installs newer app versions without prompting each time

examples.en: I checked whether automatic app updates were enabled on the shared tablet.
examples.zh: 我查了那台共用平板上有没有开「应用自动更新」。

examples.en: Automatic app updates kept the campus reading app current during the break.
examples.zh: 假期里，「应用自动更新」让校园阅读应用保持在较新版本。

words.enDefinition: a setting letting a device choose an available compatible cellular network by itself

examples.en: The phone used automatic network selection when my bus crossed into the next country.
examples.zh: 公交车驶入邻国时，手机用了「自动选择移动网络」功能。

examples.en: I checked whether automatic network selection was enabled on the second line after the trip.
examples.zh: 旅行后，我查看第二条线路是否开启了「自动选择移动网络」。

words.enDefinition: a setting that locks a device after a chosen period without activity

examples.en: I enabled automatic screen lock on the tablet I use in the university café.
examples.zh: 我给在校园咖啡馆用的平板开了「自动锁屏」。

examples.en: The support page explains how to adjust automatic screen lock during presentations and classes.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了演示和上课时如何调整「自动锁屏」设置。

words.enDefinition: a setting or service that applies security updates with little or no user action

examples.en: I enabled automatic security updates so my laptop would stay current during the semester.
examples.zh: 我启用了「自动安全更新」，让笔记本在学期里及时得到保护。

examples.en: The help page shows where to turn on automatic security updates for the operating system.
examples.zh: 帮助页面标出了在哪里能开启操作系统的「自动安全更新」。

words.enDefinition: free to meet in a gap between scheduled classes

examples.en: I'm available between classes on Wednesday, as my afternoon lab was moved.
examples.zh: 我的下午实验课改时间了，所以周三「课间有空」。

examples.en: My supervisor asked whether I was available between classes for a brief discussion.
examples.zh: 导师问我能不能「课间有空」简单聊几句。

collocations: let me know if you're available between classes

words.enDefinition: Accessible on your device without an internet connection.

examples.en: My project notes were available offline when the campus network went down during our presentation.
examples.zh: 演示时校园网断了，但我的项目笔记仍「可离线访问」。

examples.en: We checked whether the bus timetable was available offline before leaving for the field trip.
examples.zh: 出发去实地考察前，我们查看了公交时刻表是否「可离线访问」。

words.enDefinition: the average amount of screen use per day over a period

examples.en: My average daily screen time dropped when our classes moved back to campus.
examples.zh: 课程改回线下以后，我的「平均每日屏幕时长」下降了。

examples.en: The weekly report displayed my average daily screen time below the graph.
examples.zh: 每周报告把我的「平均每日屏幕时长」显示在图表下面。

words.enDefinition: data used by apps that are not currently open on the screen

examples.en: My phone listed background data separately from the data used while I watched lectures.
examples.zh: 手机把「后台网络流量」与我观看课程时使用的流量分开列出。

examples.en: I checked which app had used the most background data during the night.
examples.zh: 我查看了哪个应用夜里使用了最多的「后台网络流量」。

words.enDefinition: soft sounds a device plays to mask distractions or create a steadier sound environment

examples.en: I played background sounds on my phone while reading in the busy student lounge.
examples.zh: 学生休息区很嘈杂，我读书时用手机播放「背景音效」。

examples.en: The tablet offers several background sounds, including rain and the sound of a stream.
examples.zh: 平板提供多种「背景音效」，包括雨声和流水声。

collocations: adjust the volume of background sounds

words.enDefinition: a code kept for signing in when the usual verification method is unavailable

examples.en: I stored a backup code where I could find it after replacing my phone.
examples.zh: 我把「备用登录码」存到了更换手机后也能找到的地方。

examples.en: The instructions explain when to use a backup code for the student portal.
examples.zh: 说明里写着什么时候可以用「备用登录码」登录学生门户。

words.enDefinition: the number displayed in a badge on an app icon

examples.en: I saw the badge count rise while I worked on the essay.
examples.zh: 我写论文的时候，看见「角标数字」变大了。

examples.en: The badge count beside the mail icon didn't match my unread messages.
examples.zh: 邮件图标旁的「角标数字」和未读消息数对不上。

words.enDefinition: An upload of a group of files together rather than one at a time.

examples.en: The batch upload included all the photographs we had cleared for use in the class project.
examples.zh: 这次「批量上传」包含了课程项目获准使用的所有照片。

examples.en: I checked the file list after the batch upload to make sure our charts were included.
examples.zh: 「批量上传」后，我看了文件列表，确认已经包含我们的图表。

words.enDefinition: the loss of battery charge over time, especially when it happens faster than expected

examples.en: I noticed unusual battery drain after a long seminar with the tablet display on.
examples.zh: 平板屏幕开着上完一堂长研讨课后，我注意到「电量消耗」不太正常。

examples.en: The support adviser asked when the battery drain became noticeable during a typical day.
examples.zh: 支持人员问，平常一天里什么时候开始明显感觉到「电量消耗」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of battery charge left, shown as a percentage of a full charge

examples.en: The battery percentage dropped after I played a long video on the loan tablet.
examples.zh: 我在借来的平板上播放一段长视频后，「电池电量百分比」下降了。

examples.en: I enabled the battery percentage display so I could see exactly how much charge remained.
examples.zh: 我打开了「电池电量百分比」显示，这样就能确切知道还剩多少电量。

words.enDefinition: information about the current battery charge or whether a device is charging

examples.en: I checked the battery status before taking the loan tablet to the library.
examples.zh: 把借来的平板带去图书馆之前，我查看了「电池状态」。

examples.en: The device shows its battery status in the corner while I read course materials.
examples.zh: 我看课程材料时，设备在屏幕角落显示「电池状态」。

words.enDefinition: the box for copying recipients whose addresses other recipients cannot see

examples.en: The department put the student mailing addresses in the BCC field for privacy.
examples.zh: 为了保护隐私，系里把学生邮箱地址放在「密送栏」。

examples.en: I learned what the BCC field did while helping with a class survey.
examples.zh: 协助做课堂问卷时，我了解了「密送栏」的作用。

collocations: add addresses to the BCC field

words.enDefinition: an Android mode that limits interruptions around a planned bedtime

examples.en: My phone's bedtime mode started while I was putting my books away.
examples.zh: 我收书的时候，手机的「就寝模式」开启了。

examples.en: I scheduled bedtime mode earlier on nights before morning lab sessions.
examples.zh: 第二天一早要上实验课时，我把「就寝模式」设得早点开启。

words.enDefinition: a version made available for testing before the final release

examples.en: The developer invited students to try a beta version of the planner.
examples.zh: 开发者邀请学生试用计划工具的「测试版」。

examples.en: I read the feedback about the beta version before the classroom demonstration.
examples.zh: 课堂演示前，我看了关于「测试版」的反馈。

words.enDefinition: having subscription charges handled by the app store

examples.en: The plan was billed through the app store because that's where I started it.
examples.zh: 这项套餐「由应用商店计费」，因为我是在那里开通的。

examples.en: I checked whether our reading plan was billed through the app store.
examples.zh: 我确认了我们的阅读套餐是不是「由应用商店计费」。

collocations: a plan billed through the app store
a subscription billed through the app store
check whether it is billed through the app store

words.enDefinition: a subject field that has been left empty in an email

examples.en: I nearly sent my question with a blank subject line before the lecture.
examples.zh: 那封提问邮件的「主题行是空的」，我上课前差点就发出去了。

examples.en: A warning about the blank subject line appeared before my message went out.
examples.zh: 发信前，应用弹出了「主题行未填写」的提示。

collocations: send with a blank subject line
message with a blank subject line
warning about a blank subject line

words.enDefinition: to stop a particular person or address from messaging you through a service

examples.en: I decided to block the sender after receiving several unwanted messages from the same address.
examples.zh: 同一地址发来好几条我不想收的消息后，我决定「屏蔽发件人」。

examples.en: Our email app asks whether to block the sender when we flag an unwanted message.
examples.zh: 标记不想接收的消息时，我们的邮件应用会询问是否「屏蔽发件人」。

collocations: use the menu to block the sender

words.enDefinition: the list of addresses or contacts whose messages a service blocks

examples.en: I checked my blocked sender list after missing several reminders from the language club.
examples.zh: 错过语言社的几次提醒后，我查看了「已屏蔽发件人名单」。

examples.en: The blocked sender list moved to a different page after the email application changed.
examples.zh: 邮件应用改版后，「已屏蔽发件人名单」移到了另一个页面。

collocations: add an address to the blocked sender list

words.enDefinition: a setting that makes supported interface text appear in heavier strokes

examples.en: I set my phone to use bold text to make the menu labels clearer.
examples.zh: 我把手机设成「粗体文本」，让菜单上的字更清楚。

examples.en: The librarian switched on bold text while we adjusted the borrowed tablet for reading.
examples.zh: 我们调整借来的平板以便阅读时，馆员开启了「粗体文本」。

words.enDefinition: to add a post to a list you can revisit later

examples.en: I decided to bookmark a post about the Saturday craft workshop.
examples.zh: 我决定「收藏一条关于周六手作工作坊的帖子」。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to bookmark a post on the app.
examples.zh: 室友教我怎样在应用里「收藏一条帖子」。

words.enDefinition: a notice that informs affected people or authorities about a data breach

examples.en: The breach notification included a contact address for former students who had questions.
examples.zh: 「数据泄露通知」留了一个联系方式，供有疑问的往届学生使用。

examples.en: I read the breach notification on the university's official website before taking any action.
examples.zh: 采取行动前，我先在学校官网阅读了「数据泄露通知」。

words.enDefinition: a device alert prompting you to pause what you are doing

examples.en: A break reminder appeared while I was editing my presentation notes.
examples.zh: 我在改展示笔记时，弹出了一条「休息提醒」。

examples.en: I set a break reminder so I would pause after reviewing the chapter.
examples.zh: 我设了「休息提醒」，复习完那一章就停一会儿。

words.enDefinition: a timer that measures the length of a planned pause

examples.en: I started a break timer before going out for some water.
examples.zh: 我出去喝点水之前，开启了「休息计时器」。

examples.en: The break timer rang while we were walking back to our desks.
examples.zh: 我们往各自桌子走时，「休息计时器」响了。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen control that changes brightness when you drag its handle

examples.en: I moved the brightness slider down before taking notes in the dark lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我在昏暗的讲堂里记笔记前，把「亮度滑块」往低处拖了点。

examples.en: The brightness slider appeared below the display options when I opened the settings app.
examples.zh: 打开设置应用后，「亮度滑块」出现在显示选项下方。

words.expression: bring my draft to office hours
words.lemma: bring my draft to office hours
words.enDefinition: to take your draft along to an instructor's scheduled student meeting time
acceptedEnVariants: bring my draft to office hours

examples.en: May I bring my draft to office hours so we can talk about the opening paragraph?
examples.zh: 我可以「带着草稿去答疑」吗？想和您谈谈开头一段。

examples.en: I plan to bring my draft to office hours instead of describing the whole paper by email.
examples.zh: 我打算「带着草稿去答疑」，省得在邮件里把整篇论文描述一遍。

collocations: ask to bring my draft to office hours
plan to bring my draft to office hours
offer to bring my draft to office hours

words.enDefinition: a plan option that lets customers use a compatible phone they already own

examples.en: I selected bring your own phone because my old handset still worked well on campus.
examples.zh: 旧手机在校园用得还不错，所以我选了「自备手机入网」。

examples.en: The provider asked which model I had after I chose bring your own phone.
examples.zh: 我选择「自备手机入网」后，运营商问我的手机是什么型号。

words.enDefinition: a release focused on correcting problems in earlier software

examples.en: The notes called it a bug fix release for the drawing app.
examples.zh: 说明把它称为绘画应用的一个「缺陷修复版本」。

examples.en: I checked whether the bug fix release changed any of our classroom tools.
examples.zh: 我确认了「缺陷修复版本」有没有改动课堂上用的工具。

collocations: check for a bug fix release
notes for a bug fix release

words.enDefinition: a label identifying a particular packaged build of a software release

examples.en: The app information page listed a build number beneath the version label.
examples.zh: 应用信息页在版本标签下面列了一个「构建编号」。

examples.en: I wrote down the build number while comparing the two classroom tablets.
examples.zh: 对比两台课堂平板时，我记下了「构建编号」。

collocations: a build number in app information

words.enDefinition: a feature that uses visible outlines or marks to show which text or controls act as buttons

examples.en: I turned on Button Shapes so I could identify the controls in the reading app.
examples.zh: 我开启了「按钮形状」，方便辨认阅读应用里的控件。

examples.en: With Button Shapes enabled, the back button was easier to spot on my phone.
examples.zh: 开启「按钮形状」后，手机上的返回按钮更容易找了。

words.enDefinition: a service that sends incoming calls from one number to another

examples.en: I checked whether call forwarding was still active after changing my spare phone.
examples.zh: 换掉备用手机后，我确认了「呼叫转接功能」是否仍启用。

examples.en: The provider listed call forwarding separately from the phone's built-in voicemail feature.
examples.zh: 运营商把「呼叫转接功能」和手机内置的语音信箱功能分开列出。

words.enDefinition: how clearly and reliably a voice call can be heard

examples.en: The call quality was noticeably better after I walked out of the crowded station.
examples.zh: 我走出拥挤的车站后，「通话质量」明显好转。

examples.en: My flatmate asked me about call quality before choosing the same mobile provider.
examples.zh: 室友选择同一家手机运营商之前，问我「通话质量」怎么样。

words.enDefinition: a feature or practice for assessing an incoming call before answering it

examples.en: My phone's call screening feature asked unexpected callers to say their names aloud.
examples.zh: 手机的「来电筛选」功能会请不在预期内的来电者报上姓名。

examples.en: I read the call screening settings because I was waiting for an unfamiliar campus number.
examples.zh: 我在等校园的一个陌生号码打来，就看了「来电筛选」设置。

words.enDefinition: a feature notifying someone of a second incoming call while already on a call

examples.en: I heard the call waiting tone while speaking to the adviser about my timetable.
examples.zh: 我正和顾问谈课表，听到了「呼叫等待」提示音。

examples.en: The instructions showed whether my phone could use call waiting with both lines active.
examples.zh: 说明解释了两条线路都启用时，我的手机能不能用「呼叫等待」。

words.enDefinition: a service displaying identifying information about an incoming telephone call

examples.en: I recognised the campus office on caller ID when the phone rang that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午手机响时，我从「来电号码显示」认出是校园办公室。

examples.en: The caller ID showed an unfamiliar number while I was waiting for my appointment.
examples.zh: 我等预约时，「来电号码显示」出了一个陌生号码。

words.enDefinition: an alert signalled by the camera light flashing on a device

examples.en: I saw the camera flash alert when a message reached my Android phone.
examples.zh: 我的 Android 手机收到消息时，我看到了「相机闪光灯提醒」。

examples.en: She turned off the camera flash alert before joining the film screening.
examples.zh: 她在去看电影放映前，关掉了「相机闪光灯提醒」。

words.enDefinition: the university group responsible for keeping campus information systems and accounts secure

examples.en: The campus IT security team published a warning after students reported suspicious messages.
examples.zh: 学生举报可疑消息后，「校园信息安全团队」发布了提醒。

examples.en: Our adviser asked the campus IT security team to confirm that the notice was genuine.
examples.zh: 顾问请「校园信息安全团队」确认这则通知确实是真的。

collocations: contact the campus IT security team
ask the campus IT security team
guidance from the campus IT security team

words.expression: can I make up the missed lab
words.lemma: can i make up the missed lab
words.zhGloss: 我能补上错过的实验课吗
words.enDefinition: asks if there is another opportunity to complete a missed lab
acceptedZhAnswers: 我能补上错过的实验课吗
acceptedEnVariants: can I make up the missed lab

examples.en: Can I make up the missed lab during one of next week's afternoon sessions, if there is room?
examples.zh: 如果还有空位，下周下午某节实验课上，「我能补上错过的实验课吗」？

examples.en: Can I make up the missed lab, or is there a separate worksheet I should complete?
examples.zh: 「我能补上错过的实验课吗」？还是有张单独的练习单要做？

collocations: ask to check if I can make up the missed lab
can I make up the missed lab this week
check if I can make up the missed lab

words.expression: can you confirm you received my attachment
words.lemma: can you confirm you received my attachment
words.zhGloss: 能确认收到我的附件了吗
words.enDefinition: asks someone to verify that an emailed file reached them
acceptedZhAnswers: 能确认收到我的附件了吗
acceptedEnVariants: can you confirm you received my attachment

examples.en: Can you confirm you received my attachment? The draft included three diagrams that are hard to resend.
examples.zh: 「能确认收到我的附件了吗」？草稿里有三张图，不太方便重发。

examples.en: Can you confirm you received my attachment before I send the other two parts of the project?
examples.zh: 我发项目的另两部分前，「能确认收到我的附件了吗」？

collocations: can you confirm you received my attachment for the report
ask if you can confirm you received my attachment
can you confirm you received my attachment on Monday

words.enDefinition: To stop sending the selected file or files before the upload finishes.

examples.en: I chose Cancel upload after noticing that I had selected the practice recording by mistake.
examples.zh: 发现自己误选了练习用的录音后，我选择了「取消上传」。

examples.en: The Cancel upload button was visible beside the video while our group checked the other files.
examples.zh: 我们小组查看其他文件时，视频旁仍显示「取消上传」按钮。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a subscription is set to end later

examples.en: The account displayed “Cancellation scheduled” next to the end date.
examples.zh: 账户在结束日期旁显示了「已安排取消订阅」。

examples.en: I saw “Cancellation scheduled” while the reading tools were still available.
examples.zh: 阅读工具仍可以用时，我看到了「已安排取消订阅」。

words.enDefinition: the space where you type text accompanying a photo or video

examples.en: I added a short description of the rehearsal in the caption field.
examples.zh: 我在「配文输入栏」里加了一段简短的排练说明。

examples.en: The caption field was just below the photos I had selected.
examples.zh: 「配文输入栏」就在我选好的照片下方。

words.enDefinition: the displayed size of captions on a video or device

examples.en: I increased the caption size so I could read the interview from farther away.
examples.zh: 我调大了「字幕字号」，这样坐得远一点也能看清访谈内容。

examples.en: The app lets viewers choose a caption size before they start playing the video.
examples.zh: 应用允许观众在播放视频前选择「字幕字号」。

words.enDefinition: the appearance of captions, such as their font, colour and background

examples.en: I changed the caption style to make the text clearer over the bright slides.
examples.zh: 我调整了「字幕样式」，让文字在明亮的幻灯片上更清楚。

examples.en: The new caption style added a dark background behind the words in the recording.
examples.zh: 新的「字幕样式」让录像中的字幕文字带上了深色背景。

words.enDefinition: a page requiring a sign-in or acceptance of terms before full internet access

examples.en: The station's captive portal appeared when I opened a browser before boarding the train.
examples.zh: 上火车前我打开浏览器，车站的「联网前认证页面」弹了出来。

examples.en: I could see the Wi-Fi icon even though the captive portal had not loaded.
examples.zh: 虽然「联网前认证页面」还没出来，我已经能看到无线网图标。

collocations: sign in through a captive portal

words.enDefinition: a post with several images or clips that viewers can slide through

examples.en: We used a carousel post for the pictures from three club events.
examples.zh: 我们用一条「滑动轮播帖」展示三场社团活动的照片。

examples.en: The last image in the carousel post listed the next practice date.
examples.zh: 这条「滑动轮播帖」最后一张图写了下次练习的日期。

words.enDefinition: device settings that tell a phone how to work with a mobile network

examples.en: The phone asked whether I wanted to update my carrier settings after changing plans.
examples.zh: 更换套餐后，手机询问我要不要更新「运营商配置」。

examples.en: The help desk checked the carrier settings before testing the new mobile line.
examples.zh: 技术服务台先核对了「运营商配置」，再测试新的手机线路。

words.enDefinition: to review alerts that arrived while you were doing something else

examples.en: I went outside to catch up on notifications after the study room closed.
examples.zh: 自习室关门后，我走到外面「补看未读通知」。

examples.en: My classmate needed to catch up on notifications after a long laboratory session.
examples.zh: 同学上了很久的实验课，需要「补看未读通知」。

collocations: time to catch up on notifications
need to catch up on notifications
pause to catch up on notifications

words.expression: catch up on the missed material
words.lemma: catch up on the missed material
words.enDefinition: to study what you did not cover because you were absent
acceptedEnVariants: catch up on the missed material

examples.en: Which slides should I read to catch up on the missed material before next week?
examples.zh: 下周之前该读哪些幻灯片，才能「补上缺课内容」？

examples.en: My tutor sent two links to help me catch up on the missed material that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，导师发来两个链接，帮我「补上缺课内容」。

collocations: want to catch up on the missed material
time to catch up on the missed material
help someone catch up on the missed material

words.enDefinition: the box for adding recipients who receive a visible copy

examples.en: The tutor's address was in the CC field for this discussion.
examples.zh: 这次讨论的邮件里，导师的地址在「抄送栏」里。

examples.en: I checked the CC field to see which staff members were included.
examples.zh: 我查看「抄送栏」，看看哪些教职人员收到了邮件。

collocations: add someone to the CC field

words.enDefinition: a tower supporting equipment that sends and receives mobile network signals

examples.en: We could see the cell tower from the bus stop next to campus.
examples.zh: 从学校旁的公交站，我们能看见「移动通信基站塔」。

examples.en: The company listed work on a nearby cell tower in its public maintenance notice.
examples.zh: 公司在公开维护通知里列出了附近一座「移动通信基站塔」的施工。

words.enDefinition: the wireless signal a mobile device receives from a cellular network

examples.en: The concrete walls made the cellular signal weaker in the back of the building.
examples.zh: 混凝土墙让楼后部的「蜂窝网络信号」更弱。

examples.en: My phone picked up a stronger cellular signal once I reached the open courtyard.
examples.zh: 走到开阔的庭院后，我的手机接收到更强的「蜂窝网络信号」。

words.enDefinition: To assign a different level of access to someone who already has a sharing role.

examples.en: Our project lead needed to change a sharing role before the tutor could comment on the draft.
examples.zh: 导师要在草稿里评论前，项目负责人需要「更改共享角色」。

examples.en: I asked who could change a sharing role when our teacher wanted to join the folder.
examples.zh: 老师想加入共享文件夹时，我问谁可以「更改共享角色」。

collocations: decide to change a sharing role
be allowed to change a sharing role
ask the owner to change a sharing role

words.enDefinition: to replace your current password with a different one

examples.en: The help page explains how to change your password from the university portal.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了如何从校园门户「更改密码」。

examples.en: If the service reports that your password has leaked, change your password there promptly.
examples.zh: 如果服务提醒密码已经泄露，请及时在该服务上「更改密码」。

collocations: change your password after a breach

words.enDefinition: a light, icon or other signal showing that a device is charging or its charging status

examples.en: The charging indicator lit up when I plugged in the tablet at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆给平板接上电源后，「充电指示灯」亮了。

examples.en: I checked the charging indicator after moving to a different seat in the study area.
examples.zh: 我在自习区换了一个座位后，查看了「充电指示标志」。

words.enDefinition: describes a device receiving power more slowly than expected or usual

examples.en: My tablet displayed Charging slowly when I connected it to the old docking station.
examples.zh: 我把平板接到旧扩展坞时，它显示「充电缓慢」。

examples.en: I noticed that the laptop was charging slowly while I finished my lab report.
examples.zh: 我写完实验报告的过程中注意到，笔记本「充电缓慢」。

collocations: ask why it is charging slowly

words.enDefinition: a linked series of messages belonging to one conversation

examples.en: I returned to the chat thread about the club's practice room.
examples.zh: 我回到讨论社团练习室的「聊天会话」。

examples.en: The chat thread held all the messages about our project meeting.
examples.zh: 有关项目会议的所有消息都在这个「聊天会话」里。

words.enDefinition: to look for newer versions of the apps on a device

examples.en: I wanted to check for app updates before our next study session.
examples.zh: 下次自习前，我想「检查应用更新」。

examples.en: The store menu showed how to check for app updates on my tablet.
examples.zh: 商店菜单介绍了怎样在我的平板上「检查应用更新」。

collocations: remember to check for app updates
let users check for app updates

words.enDefinition: to review several alerts together instead of checking each immediately

examples.en: I try to check notifications in batches between my morning and afternoon classes.
examples.zh: 我尽量在上午和下午的课之间「集中查看通知」。

examples.en: My roommate likes to check notifications in batches after finishing a chapter of reading.
examples.zh: 室友喜欢读完一章以后再「集中查看通知」。

collocations: choose to check notifications in batches
prefer to check notifications in batches
remember to check notifications in batches

words.enDefinition: to consult an organisation's published list for a person's or office's contact details

examples.en: Please check the official directory for the finance office's number before calling back.
examples.zh: 回电话前，请「查看官方通讯录」查财务处的号码。

examples.en: I decided to check the official directory when the extension in the message looked unfamiliar.
examples.zh: 消息里的分机号看着陌生，我决定「查看官方通讯录」。

collocations: check the official directory for a number
check the official directory before calling

words.enDefinition: to look at the address of a webpage to confirm its identity

examples.en: I paused to check the web address after opening the department's help page again.
examples.zh: 重新打开系里的帮助页面后，我停下来「核对网页地址」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to check the web address in the example on screen.
examples.zh: 导师请我们看屏幕上的示例，练习「核对网页地址」。

collocations: remember to check the web address
ask someone to check the web address

words.enDefinition: to find out precisely which pages have been assigned for reading

examples.en: I wanted to check which pages to read because my edition uses different numbers.
examples.zh: 我想「确认该读哪几页」，因为我手上的版本页码不同。

examples.en: Our group decided to check which pages to read before meeting on Tuesday evening.
examples.zh: 我们组决定在周二晚上见面前「确认该读哪几页」。

collocations: need to check which pages to read
want to check which pages to read
email to check which pages to read

words.enDefinition: a feed arranged by posting time rather than by recommendations

examples.en: I chose the chronological feed to see the updates in time order.
examples.zh: 我选择「按时间排序的信息流」，按发出时间看动态。

examples.en: The chronological feed showed my friend's latest painting first that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，「按时间排序的信息流」先显示了朋友最新的画作。

words.enDefinition: to remove all removable alerts from the current list at once

examples.en: I wanted to clear all notifications after checking the updated lecture times twice.
examples.zh: 我把新的上课时间核对两遍后，想「清除全部通知」。

examples.en: The phone displayed an option to clear all notifications below the list.
examples.zh: 手机在列表下方显示了「清除全部通知」选项。

words.enDefinition: a short email heading that tells the reader the message's purpose

examples.en: I wrote a clear subject line so my tutor could find my question easily.
examples.zh: 我写了个「清楚明确的邮件主题」，让导师容易找到我的问题。

examples.en: The writing centre helped me choose a clear subject line for my message.
examples.zh: 写作中心帮我给那封邮件拟了个「清楚明确的主题」。

collocations: check for a clear subject line

words.enDefinition: a list of selected people for sharing certain content with

examples.en: I made a close friends list for updates about my study break.
examples.zh: 我建了一个「密友名单」，用来分享学习间隙的近况。

examples.en: My roommate checked her close friends list before sharing a short video.
examples.zh: 分享短视频前，室友查看了「密友名单」。

collocations: add someone to your close friends list

words.enDefinition: the final sentence of the message before the writer signs off

examples.en: I added a closing line saying when I would be next on campus.
examples.zh: 我加了「结尾一句」，说明自己下次什么时候在学校。

examples.en: The closing line thanked the teaching team for checking the handout.
examples.zh: 「结尾一句」感谢授课团队检查讲义。

words.enDefinition: An online location where people can store, organize, and open files.

examples.en: I uploaded the field notes to our cloud drive after getting back to campus.
examples.zh: 回学校后，我把实地考察笔记上传到了我们的「云盘」。

examples.en: My roommate checked her cloud drive for the presentation she had left open at home.
examples.zh: 室友去「云盘」里找她在家时还开着的那份演示文稿。

collocations: save a file to a cloud drive

words.enDefinition: A folder stored in an online file service.

examples.en: We used a cloud folder to collect the photographs for our group's final presentation.
examples.zh: 我们用一个「云端文件夹」收集小组期末展示要用的照片。

examples.en: My classmate renamed the cloud folder after we decided on a new project title.
examples.zh: 我们确定新的项目名称后，同学给「云端文件夹」改了名。

words.enDefinition: The maximum amount of cloud storage available to a user, group, or account.

examples.en: Our class project folder reached its cloud storage quota after we added the rehearsal recordings.
examples.zh: 加入排练录像后，课程项目文件夹达到了「云存储配额」上限。

examples.en: The workshop coordinator explained the cloud storage quota before assigning each team a shared folder.
examples.zh: 工作坊协调员在给各组分配共享文件夹前解释了「云存储配额」。

words.enDefinition: To make changes to the same document together with another person.

examples.en: We can co-edit a document after class while the rest of our group runs the survey.
examples.zh: 下课后我们可以「共同编辑文档」，小组其他成员负责做调查。

examples.en: I learned to co-edit a document with my lab partner during our first research project.
examples.zh: 第一次做研究项目时，我学会了和实验搭档「共同编辑文档」。

collocations: co-edit a document with a partner

words.enDefinition: A marker showing another person's current position in a shared document.

examples.en: I saw a collaborator cursor beside the table where my partner was checking the figures.
examples.zh: 我看到表格旁有一个「协作者光标」，搭档正在那里核对数字。

examples.en: The screen showed a collaborator cursor moving through the first paragraph during our group call.
examples.zh: 小组通话时，屏幕上有一个「协作者光标」正在第一段里移动。

words.enDefinition: to hide an expanded group of replies from the current view

examples.en: I chose to collapse replies so I could see the next comment.
examples.zh: 我选择「收起回复」，好继续看下一条评论。

examples.en: The app let me collapse replies by tapping the small arrow again.
examples.zh: 我再点一次小箭头，应用就能「收起回复」。

words.enDefinition: a setting that changes how colours are displayed to make some colours easier to distinguish

examples.en: I tried a colour filter to tell the different lines apart on the chart.
examples.zh: 我试着用「色彩滤镜」区分图表中的不同线条。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the tablet's colour filter was listed in the menu.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了菜单中的平板「色彩滤镜」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: how warm or cool the overall colour of a light or display appears

examples.en: I adjusted the colour temperature until the projector no longer made the slides look blue.
examples.zh: 我调整了「色温」，直到投影上的幻灯片不再偏蓝。

examples.en: The device lets you choose a warmer colour temperature when you read late at night.
examples.zh: 深夜阅读时，设备允许你选偏暖的「色温」。

words.enDefinition: the total amount of screen use counted across multiple devices

examples.en: My combined screen time was longer once I included the tablet.
examples.zh: 把平板算进去以后，我的「合计屏幕使用时长」更长了。

examples.en: The report gave a combined screen time for the phone and the laptop.
examples.zh: 报告给出了手机和笔记本的「合计屏幕使用时长」。

words.enDefinition: The place in a file to which a comment is attached.

examples.en: The comment anchor pointed to the number in the caption instead of the number in the table.
examples.zh: 「批注锚点」指向的是图注里的数字，不是表格里的数字。

examples.en: I could not find the comment anchor after our group removed the paragraph it belonged to.
examples.zh: 小组删掉对应的段落后，我找不到「批注锚点」了。

words.enDefinition: the number of comments recorded for a post

examples.en: The comment count changed after I reopened the club's photo album.
examples.zh: 我重新打开社团的相册后，「评论数量」变了。

examples.en: The app put the comment count beside the small speech bubble.
examples.zh: 应用把「评论数量」放在小对话气泡旁边。

collocations: the comment count on a post

words.enDefinition: An alert that someone added, mentioned you in, or replied to a comment.

examples.en: I got a comment notification while I was on the bus home from the library.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆坐公交回家时收到了一条「批注通知」。

examples.en: The comment notification took me straight to my partner's question under the diagram we made.
examples.zh: 这条「批注通知」把我直接带到了搭档在我们那张示意图下提出的问题。

words.enDefinition: to give feedback on how convincingly a point is developed

examples.en: Could you comment on the argument before I spend more time editing the wording?
examples.zh: 在我花更多时间改措辞前，您能先「点评一下论证」吗？

examples.en: My writing tutor agreed to comment on the argument after reading the first page.
examples.zh: 写作导师同意读完第一页后「点评一下论证」。

collocations: ask someone to comment on the argument
happy to comment on the argument
comment on the argument in the draft

words.enDefinition: Permission to read and leave comments on a file without changing its main content.

examples.en: Our tutor gave reviewers comment-only access while two group members edited the project report.
examples.zh: 我们组两名成员在编辑项目报告，辅导老师给了评阅人「可查看和批注的权限」。

examples.en: I had comment-only access, so I left a question beside the table about survey responses.
examples.zh: 我有「可查看和批注的权限」，就把关于问卷答案的问题留在了表格旁边。

collocations: review a draft with comment-only access

words.enDefinition: the area below or beside a post where comments appear

examples.en: I opened the comment section to check whether rehearsal had moved.
examples.zh: 我打开「评论区」，看排练时间有没有改。

examples.en: The comment section had useful suggestions from students in other groups.
examples.zh: 「评论区」里有其他小组同学提出的建议。

collocations: a reply in the comment section

words.enDefinition: a comment and the linked responses to it

examples.en: The volunteer answered my question in the comment thread below the photo.
examples.zh: 志愿者在照片下方的「评论串」里回答了我的问题。

examples.en: I followed the comment thread until I found the updated meeting time.
examples.zh: 我顺着「评论串」看，找到了更新后的会议时间。

words.enDefinition: An area beside the document where comments and replies can be viewed or managed.

examples.en: I opened the comments pane so I could see all the feedback beside the draft.
examples.zh: 我打开「批注窗格」，这样就能在草稿旁看到所有反馈。

examples.en: The comments pane hid part of our diagram when we shared the file on a small screen.
examples.zh: 我们在小屏幕上展示文件时，「批注窗格」遮住了示意图的一部分。

collocations: read replies in the comments pane

words.enDefinition: to check the differences between available service options

examples.en: I used “Compare plans” to see which options included extra templates.
