words.enDefinition: a target for time spent focusing on tasks each day

examples.en: I set a daily focus goal for the week before my final exams.
examples.zh: 期末考试前一周，我设定了「每日专注目标」。

examples.en: The app showed that I had reached my daily focus goal that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，应用显示我已经达到了「每日专注目标」。

words.enDefinition: a personal target for how much screen use is acceptable daily

examples.en: I set a daily screen time goal that still made room for online classes.
examples.zh: 我设了「每日屏幕时长目标」，同时给网课留了时间。

examples.en: My daily screen time goal changed after I began reading more material on paper.
examples.zh: 开始更多地读纸质材料后，我的「每日屏幕时长目标」也改了。

collocations: set a daily screen time goal
track a daily screen time goal
review a daily screen time goal

words.enDefinition: a graph showing device or app use for one day

examples.en: I opened the daily usage chart to look at the afternoon in detail.
examples.zh: 我打开「每日使用图表」，仔细看下午的情况。

examples.en: The daily usage chart showed a longer session during our online tutorial.
examples.zh: 「每日使用图表」显示，上网辅导课时有一段较长的使用记录。

words.enDefinition: the amount of data provided within a mobile plan for a stated period

examples.en: My data allowance was smaller while I was travelling under the temporary plan.
examples.zh: 我旅行期间用临时套餐，「套餐内流量」比较少。

examples.en: I compared the data allowance before choosing a new plan for the next semester.
examples.zh: 选下学期的新套餐前，我比较了「套餐内流量」。

words.enDefinition: an incident in which private or protected data is accessed or disclosed without authorisation

examples.en: The university notified former students after a data breach at an outside service provider.
examples.zh: 一家外部服务商发生「数据泄露事件」后，学校通知了往届学生。

examples.en: The student newspaper explained what information was affected by the data breach last month.
examples.zh: 校报解释了上个月的「数据泄露事件」影响了哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying data usage is near or at a set limit

examples.en: The data limit alert appeared while I was viewing a lecture away from campus.
examples.zh: 我在校外看讲课视频时，弹出了「流量额度提醒」。

examples.en: I received a data limit alert before using the rest of the monthly allowance.
examples.zh: 我用完本月剩余流量前收到了「流量额度提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a SIM for mobile internet access without ordinary voice service

examples.en: I used a data-only SIM in my tablet on the way to campus.
examples.zh: 去校园的路上，我在平板里用了一张「仅供上网的手机卡」。

examples.en: The data-only SIM worked with my device but didn't give me a voice line.
examples.zh: 「仅供上网的手机卡」适用于我的设备，但不提供普通语音通话线路。

words.enDefinition: carrying unused mobile data from one allowance period into a later one

examples.en: The data rollover gave me extra allowance when I travelled the following month.
examples.zh: 下个月出行时，「剩余流量结转」给我增加了可用流量。

examples.en: I asked how data rollover worked before changing to the cheaper plan for summer.
examples.zh: 换成暑假更便宜的套餐前，我问了「剩余流量结转」怎么计算。

words.enDefinition: a mode that reduces the amount of data used by a device or application

examples.en: I switched on data saver before opening the news app on the train.
examples.zh: 坐火车时，我先开启了「节省流量功能」，再打开新闻应用。

examples.en: The app explained why images loaded differently when data saver was enabled that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，应用解释开启「节省流量功能」时图片加载方式为什么不同。

words.enDefinition: an extra amount of mobile data bought after or alongside the regular allowance

examples.en: I bought a data top-up to watch my online lecture on a long train ride.
examples.zh: 坐长途火车看在线课程前，我买了一个「流量加购包」。

examples.en: The data top-up showed separately from my usual allowance in the carrier's app.
examples.zh: 运营商应用把「流量加购包」与我平时的流量额度分开显示。

words.enDefinition: the recurring period over which a device or plan counts data use

examples.en: I updated the data usage cycle to match the date on my account statement.
examples.zh: 我更新了「流量用量统计周期」，让它和账户对账单的日期一致。

examples.en: The settings showed the start of the next data usage cycle on Monday.
examples.zh: 设置显示，下一个「流量用量统计周期」从周一开始。

words.enDefinition: the arrangement of day, month and year in a written date

examples.en: I changed the date format in my planner after the term started.
examples.zh: 学期开始后，我改了计划工具里的「日期显示格式」。

examples.en: The date format made the labels on my calendar easier to understand.
examples.zh: 这一「日期显示格式」让日历上的标签更容易看懂。

words.enDefinition: the app automatically chosen for a particular action or file type

examples.en: I made my usual reader the default app for lecture notes.
examples.zh: 我把常用的阅读器设成了打开讲义的「默认应用」。

examples.en: The tablet asked which programme should become the default app for pictures.
examples.zh: 平板问用哪个程序作图片的「默认应用」。

collocations: the default app for a file type

words.enDefinition: the mobile line normally used for outgoing voice calls when none is selected

examples.en: After changing phones, I checked which number was set as the default voice line.
examples.zh: 换手机后，我查看了哪个号码设为「默认通话号码」。

examples.en: The settings listed my default voice line separately from the line used for mobile data.
examples.zh: 设置把「默认通话号码」和用于手机流量的线路分开列出。

words.enDefinition: to take down a post you published

examples.en: I decided to delete a post when I noticed it was a duplicate.
examples.zh: 发现那条内容重复后，我决定「删除帖子」。

examples.en: The settings explained what happens when you delete a post from your profile.
examples.zh: 设置页面解释了从主页「删除帖子」后会发生什么。

collocations: confirm you want to delete a post
an option to delete a post

words.enDefinition: an option removing a message from your view of a conversation

examples.en: The menu offered “Delete for me” when I held down the message.
examples.zh: 我长按消息时，菜单提供了「仅为自己删除」。

examples.en: I chose “Delete for me” to remove the duplicate from my own view.
examples.zh: 我选了「仅为自己删除」，这样自己就看不到重复的消息了。

words.enDefinition: to stop a pending sign-in by indicating that it should not be approved

examples.en: I chose to deny a sign-in request because I had not tried to log in.
examples.zh: 我没有尝试登录，所以选择「拒绝登录请求」。

examples.en: The adviser demonstrated how to deny a sign-in request during the account safety workshop.
examples.zh: 顾问在账户安全工作坊上演示了如何「拒绝登录请求」。

collocations: choose to deny a sign-in request
deny a sign-in request you do not recognise
learn how to deny a sign-in request

words.enDefinition: a shared email address for sending questions to a university department

examples.en: My tutor gave me the department contact address for questions about changing sections.
examples.zh: 导师给了我「院系联系邮箱」，方便我问换班的事。

examples.en: The department contact address was printed at the bottom of the handout.
examples.zh: 讲义底部印着「院系联系邮箱」。

collocations: write to the department contact address

words.enDefinition: to explain what is going wrong and when or where it happens

examples.en: I tried to describe the problem without guessing what had caused the screen to flash.
examples.zh: 我尽量「描述问题」，没有去猜屏幕闪烁的原因。

examples.en: The form asks you to describe the problem before adding a screenshot or error code.
examples.zh: 表单要求先「描述问题」，再添加截图或错误代码。

collocations: ask someone to describe the problem

words.enDefinition: a version of software designed for laptop or desktop computers

examples.en: I chose the desktop version so I could work on a larger screen.
examples.zh: 我选了「桌面版」，好在更大的屏幕上操作。

examples.en: The desktop version had a menu bar above the drawing tools.
examples.zh: 「桌面版」在绘画工具上方有一栏菜单。

words.enDefinition: the website run by the people or organisation that built an app

examples.en: I found a short guide on the developer website before installing the app.
examples.zh: 安装应用前，我在「开发者网站」找到了简短的指南。

examples.en: The developer website listed the new drawing tools and explained their names.
examples.zh: 「开发者网站」列出了新的绘画工具，并解释了名称。

words.enDefinition: a check of whether a device can work with the provider's service

examples.en: I completed a device compatibility check before ordering a SIM for my old tablet.
examples.zh: 为旧平板订购手机卡之前，我做了「设备兼容性检查」。

examples.en: The device compatibility check asked for the model name rather than the colour.
examples.zh: 「设备兼容性检查」要求提供型号名称，没有问设备颜色。

words.enDefinition: tests and checks that provide information about the condition or performance of a device

examples.en: The technician ran device diagnostics before issuing another laptop for my final project.
examples.zh: 技术员先运行了「设备诊断」，然后为我的期末项目借出另一台笔记本。

examples.en: I checked where to find device diagnostics in the university's equipment support guide.
examples.zh: 我在学校的设备支持指南里查了去哪里找「设备诊断」。

words.enDefinition: describes a device that does not react to normal controls or input

examples.en: "Which buttons still work when the device is unresponsive?" the adviser asked during startup.
examples.zh: 设备启动时，支持人员问：「设备无响应」的情况下，还有哪些键能用？

examples.en: Our equipment guide explains what information to collect when the device is unresponsive in class.
examples.zh: 设备指南说明了课堂上「设备无响应」时要收集哪些信息。

collocations: the device is unresponsive after startup
check whether the device is unresponsive
the device is unresponsive to touch

words.enDefinition: the maximum number of devices a licence or subscription covers

examples.en: I checked the device limit before adding the software to another tablet.
examples.zh: 把软件装到另一台平板之前，我查了「设备数量上限」。

examples.en: The terms listed a device limit for this version of the app.
examples.zh: 条款列出了这个应用版本的「设备数量上限」。

collocations: a device limit for a plan

words.enDefinition: a code entered to unlock a phone, tablet or similar device

examples.en: I entered my device passcode after restarting the tablet for my morning lecture notes.
examples.zh: 为了看上午的课堂笔记，我重启了平板，然后输入「设备解锁密码」。

examples.en: The new device passcode was different from the password for my university account.
examples.zh: 新的「设备解锁密码」和我的校园账户密码不同。

words.enDefinition: a count of how often someone picks up a device

examples.en: My iPhone report listed device pickups at different times of the day.
examples.zh: iPhone 的报告列出了不同时段「拿起设备的次数」。

examples.en: The graph showed more device pickups between lectures than in the morning.
examples.zh: 图表显示，两堂课之间「拿起设备的次数」比上午更多。

words.enDefinition: a code assigned to a particular physical device to identify it

examples.en: The assistant copied the device serial number onto the form when I returned the tablet.
examples.zh: 我归还平板时，工作人员把「设备序列号」抄到了表上。

examples.en: Support asked for the device serial number so they could check which computer I had borrowed.
examples.zh: 支持人员请我提供「设备序列号」，以确认我借的是哪台电脑。

words.enDefinition: a period when someone voluntarily avoids using digital devices or services

examples.en: I tried a digital detox during a weekend spent with my cousins.
examples.zh: 和表亲一起过周末时，我试了试「暂时远离电子设备」。

examples.en: My classmate called her day away from social media a digital detox.
examples.zh: 同学把不看社交媒体的一天称为「暂时远离电子设备」。

words.enDefinition: an Android tool for reviewing and managing everyday device use

examples.en: I checked Digital Wellbeing to see which apps took the most time.
examples.zh: 我查看了「数字健康管理」，看哪些应用占用的时间最多。

examples.en: My phone has Digital Wellbeing options for making a bedtime schedule.
examples.zh: 我的手机有「数字健康管理」选项，可以安排就寝时间表。

words.enDefinition: an app icon shown less brightly to indicate restricted availability

examples.en: I noticed a dimmed app icon after my daily time allowance ran out.
examples.zh: 当天的使用额度用完后，我看到一个「变灰的应用图标」。

examples.en: The dimmed app icon reminded me that the game was paused for studying.
examples.zh: 这个「变灰的应用图标」提醒我，学习时那款游戏被暂停了。

words.enDefinition: Access granted to a specific account itself, rather than through a sharing link.

examples.en: The tutor had direct access to our folder after the owner added her account.
examples.zh: 所有者添加导师的账号后，她就有了这个文件夹「直接授予的权限」。

examples.en: I checked which group members had direct access before deciding who still needed an invitation.
examples.zh: 决定还要邀请谁之前，我查了哪些组员已有「直接授予的权限」。

collocations: a list of people with direct access

words.enDefinition: to remove an unfinished post you do not want to keep

examples.en: I chose to discard a draft after finding a newer version that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午找到新版本后，我选择「舍弃一份草稿」。

examples.en: The app asked whether I wanted to discard a draft before closing.
examples.zh: 关闭前，应用问我要不要「舍弃一份草稿」。

collocations: decide whether to discard a draft
confirm you want to discard a draft

words.enDefinition: to remove an alert from its display without opening it

examples.en: I meant to dismiss a notification, but I opened the app instead.
examples.zh: 我本来想「划掉一条通知」，却点进了应用。

examples.en: You can dismiss a notification after reading its first sentence on the screen.
examples.zh: 在屏幕上看完第一句话后，可以「划掉一条通知」。

words.enDefinition: an external device that connects equipment with different video interfaces

examples.en: I borrowed a USB-C to HDMI display adapter for the projector in our classroom.
examples.zh: 我借了一个 USB-C 转 HDMI 的「视频接口转接器」，用来连教室里的投影仪。

examples.en: The technician checked the display adapter before we began the student presentations that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午学生演示开始前，技术员检查了「视频接口转接器」。

words.enDefinition: showing the same image on two or more screens at once

examples.en: We turned on display mirroring so the audience could see the same slides.
examples.zh: 我们开启了「屏幕镜像」，这样观众就能看到同一份幻灯片。

examples.en: The presentation station supports display mirroring with both the projector and the monitor.
examples.zh: 演示台支持投影仪和显示器同时使用「屏幕镜像」。

words.enDefinition: the number of pixels used to make up a displayed image, usually given as width by height

examples.en: I adjusted the display resolution after the text looked blurry on the borrowed monitor.
examples.zh: 借来的显示器上文字有点模糊，我调了「显示分辨率」。

examples.en: The helpdesk asked which display resolution I had selected for the classroom projector.
examples.zh: 服务台问我为教室投影仪选了哪个「显示分辨率」。

words.enDefinition: options that control how content appears on a screen

examples.en: I opened display settings before connecting my laptop to the screen in class.
examples.zh: 把笔记本连上教室的屏幕之前，我打开了「显示设置」。

examples.en: The lab assistant reset the display settings after the projector showed a stretched image.
examples.zh: 投影画面变形后，机房助理重置了「显示设置」。

words.enDefinition: a setting that changes how large the device's interface appears across the screen

examples.en: I increased display zoom so the app icons were easier to see from farther away.
examples.zh: 我调大了「显示缩放」，这样离得远一点也更容易看清应用图标。

examples.en: My tablet's display zoom made the menu items larger while I was reading in class.
examples.zh: 上课阅读时，我用平板的「显示缩放」把菜单选项放大了。

words.enDefinition: Information about actions that people have taken on a document.

examples.en: The document activity helped me check whether the diagram was added before or after our meeting.
examples.zh: 我通过「文档活动记录」查看示意图是在开会之前还是之后添加的。

examples.en: Our project lead checked document activity after noticing that two sections had moved overnight.
examples.zh: 项目组长发现有两节内容在夜里换了位置，就查看了「文档活动记录」。

words.expression: does the word count include references
words.lemma: does the word count include references
words.enDefinition: asks whether references count towards an assignment's word total
acceptedEnVariants: does the word count include references

examples.en: Does the word count include references for the reflection we have to submit next week?
examples.zh: 下周要交的那篇反思作业，「参考文献计入字数吗」？

examples.en: Does the word count include references? The example in the handout has a separate list.
examples.zh: 「参考文献计入字数吗」？讲义里的例子有单独的参考文献表。

collocations: does the word count include references and footnotes
ask if the word count includes references
question saying does the word count include references

words.enDefinition: the registered name used as an address for a site or internet service

examples.en: The browser displayed the domain name at the top of the page near the tab.
examples.zh: 浏览器在页面顶部的标签旁显示了「域名」。

examples.en: I asked the librarian whether that domain name belonged to our university's new service.
examples.zh: 我问图书管理员那个「域名」是不是我们学校的新服务使用的。

words.zhGloss: 以 ZIP 压缩包下载
words.enDefinition: To download one or more files packaged as a ZIP archive.
acceptedZhAnswers: 以 ZIP 压缩包下载

examples.en: Our class materials were available to download as a ZIP containing all three practice worksheets.
examples.zh: 课程材料可以「以 ZIP 压缩包下载」，里面有三份练习工作表。

examples.en: I chose Download as a ZIP so I could take the reference images home together.
examples.zh: 我选择了「以 ZIP 压缩包下载」，这样就能把参考图片一起带回家。

collocations: the download as a ZIP option

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that a program prevented a file from being downloaded

examples.en: The browser showed Download blocked when I tried to retrieve the old workshop file.
examples.zh: 我试着下载以前的工作坊文件时，浏览器显示「下载已拦截」。

examples.en: I asked the helpdesk about Download blocked after the course materials stopped opening.
examples.zh: 课程材料打不开后，我去问服务台「下载已拦截」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A status message indicating that the file transfer to your device has finished.

examples.en: The Download complete notification appeared just before I unplugged my laptop in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我在教室拔掉笔记本电脑电源前，刚好看到了「下载已完成」的通知。

examples.en: I saw Download complete after saving the spreadsheet we needed for our afternoon group exercise.
examples.zh: 保存下午小组练习要用的电子表格时，我看到了「下载已完成」。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a download stopped unexpectedly before all the data reached the device.

examples.en: I saw Download interrupted beside the class video when my laptop briefly lost its connection.
examples.zh: 我的笔记本电脑短暂断网时，我看到课程视频旁显示「下载已中断」。

examples.en: The Download interrupted message appeared just before the library closed, so I left the file for tomorrow.
examples.zh: 图书馆快关门时出现了「下载已中断」的提示，所以我打算明天再处理这个文件。

collocations: see download interrupted beside a file

words.enDefinition: The directory or place on a device where a downloaded file is saved.

examples.en: I checked the download location because the worksheet was not on my desktop as expected.
examples.zh: 工作表没有像预想的那样出现在桌面上，我去查看了「下载位置」。

examples.en: The lab computer used a different download location from the one I use on my laptop.
examples.zh: 实验室电脑的「下载位置」和我笔记本电脑上用的不同。

words.enDefinition: To transfer more than one selected file to a device in a single operation.

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to download multiple files for the workshop before their shared links expired.
examples.zh: 辅导老师请我们趁共享链接过期前「下载多个文件」，供工作坊使用。

examples.en: I needed to download multiple files so I could mark the five practice worksheets at home.
examples.zh: 我需要「下载多个文件」，好回家批改五份练习作业。

collocations: download multiple files from a folder

words.enDefinition: a status indicating a download is waiting to begin

examples.en: The tablet showed “Download queued” beside the new language practice app.
examples.zh: 平板在新语言练习应用旁显示「下载已排队」。

examples.en: I saw “Download queued” while the first study tool was still downloading.
examples.zh: 第一款学习工具还在下载时，我看到了「下载已排队」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of data transferred to download an app

examples.en: I checked the download size while browsing the app's listing.
examples.zh: 我浏览应用详情页时，查了「下载文件大小」。

examples.en: The store showed the download size beneath the supported language list.
examples.zh: 商店在支持语言列表下方显示了「下载文件大小」。

words.enDefinition: a notice that a scheduled period of restricted use is near

examples.en: I received a downtime reminder while saving the last slide on my iPad.
examples.zh: 我在 iPad 上保存最后一页幻灯片时，收到了「停用时段开始提醒」。

examples.en: The downtime reminder appeared before the scheduled restrictions began that night.
examples.zh: 那晚预定的限制开始前，出现了「停用时段开始提醒」。

words.enDefinition: the area holding content saved before publication

examples.en: I found yesterday's unfinished announcement in the drafts folder after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在「草稿箱」里找到了昨天没写完的公告。

examples.en: The drafts folder showed two versions of the update about rehearsals.
examples.zh: 「草稿箱」里有两版关于排练的动态。

collocations: a post in the drafts folder

words.enDefinition: scheduled time when students may visit an instructor without booking

examples.en: The tutor told me she would hold drop-in office hours after class.
examples.zh: 导师告诉我，课后会有「无需预约的答疑时间」。

examples.en: I asked about drop-in office hours because I couldn't plan ahead that week.
examples.zh: 我问了「无需预约的答疑时间」，因为那周没法提前安排。

words.enDefinition: a device feature supporting two SIM-based mobile lines on the same phone

examples.en: The dual SIM feature let me keep a separate number for my part-time job.
examples.zh: 有了「双卡功能」，我能为兼职保留一个单独的号码。

examples.en: I chose a handset with dual SIM because I studied in two different countries.
examples.zh: 我在两个不同国家读书，所以选了具有「双卡功能」的手机。

words.enDefinition: An extra file that has the same content as another file.

examples.en: I found a duplicate file while checking which readings we already had in the class folder.
examples.zh: 我在检查班级文件夹里有哪些阅读材料时，发现了一个「重复文件」。

examples.en: The search results included a duplicate file with the same diagram under a slightly different name.
examples.zh: 搜索结果里有一个「重复文件」，名字略有不同，但里面是同一张示意图。

words.enDefinition: a fee that may apply when a contract ends before its agreed term

examples.en: I checked the early termination charge before asking about moving to a different phone provider.
examples.zh: 询问转到另一家手机运营商之前，我查了「提前终止合同费用」。

examples.en: The letter listed the early termination charge separately from my usual monthly service fee.
examples.zh: 信上把「提前终止合同费用」与平时的月服务费分开列出。

words.enDefinition: to change the text of a message you already sent

examples.en: After I spotted the typo, I looked for the option to edit a sent message.
examples.zh: 发现错别字后，我找了一下「编辑已发送的消息」的选项。

examples.en: The app gave me an option to edit a sent message in our chat.
examples.zh: 应用把「编辑已发送的消息」选项放在了我们的聊天里。

collocations: choose to edit a sent message
ask how to edit a sent message
an option to edit a sent message

words.enDefinition: a label showing that the content of a message has been changed

examples.en: I saw the edit indicator beside the corrected date in our chat.
examples.zh: 我在聊天里改过的日期旁看到了「已编辑标识」。

examples.en: The edit indicator appeared after my classmate corrected the room number.
examples.zh: 同学改正房间号后，出现了「已编辑标识」。

collocations: an edit indicator beside a message

words.enDefinition: an option for changing the details shown on a profile

examples.en: I tapped “Edit profile” to update the text below my picture.
examples.zh: 我点了「编辑个人资料」，更新头像下方的文字。

examples.en: The “Edit profile” option let our committee change the club's introduction.
examples.zh: 「编辑个人资料」选项让我们委员会能修改社团介绍。

words.enDefinition: A stored date and time that identifies when an edit was made.

examples.en: The edit timestamp helped us match the revised title to the notes from our group call.
examples.zh: 「编辑时间戳」帮助我们将修订后的标题与小组通话记录对照起来。

examples.en: I noted the edit timestamp next to the figures so my tutor could find the revision later.
examples.zh: 我记下数字旁的「编辑时间戳」，方便辅导老师之后找到这次修改。

words.enDefinition: A control that temporarily prevents a file or part of a file from being edited.

examples.en: An editing lock appeared on the worksheet while the project coordinator was updating the grade totals.
examples.zh: 项目协调员更新成绩总分时，工作表上出现了一个「编辑锁」。

examples.en: The notes said the editing lock was temporary and the reading link would still work.
examples.zh: 说明中说「编辑锁」是暂时的，阅读链接仍然有效。

words.enDefinition: A document mode in which you can make changes directly to the content.

examples.en: Nina switched to editing mode and fixed the spelling of our guest speaker's name.
examples.zh: 妮娜切换到「编辑模式」，改正了特邀讲者名字的拼写。

examples.en: The demo started in editing mode so everyone could watch me change the section headings.
examples.zh: 演示开始时处于「编辑模式」，所以大家都能看见我修改各节的标题。

words.enDefinition: A period during which someone has a document open for editing.

examples.en: Our editing session lasted until the library closed and someone reminded us to pack up.
examples.zh: 我们「这次编辑」一直持续到图书馆关门，有人提醒我们收拾东西才结束。

examples.en: During my editing session, we decided to move the diagram to the beginning of the report.
examples.zh: 在我「这次编辑」时，我们决定把示意图挪到报告开头。

words.enDefinition: a label for an app recommended by a store's editorial team

examples.en: The planner had an “Editor's choice” label beside its description.
examples.zh: 这款计划工具的说明旁有个「编辑精选」标识。

examples.en: I recognised the “Editor's choice” badge on the language learning app.
examples.zh: 我认出了语言学习应用上的「编辑精选」徽标。

words.enDefinition: a Wi-Fi roaming service for students and staff at participating education and research institutions

examples.en: I could use eduroam when I visited another university for a workshop in June.
examples.zh: 六月去另一所大学参加工作坊时，我能用「教育科研无线漫游网」。

examples.en: The orientation guide listed eduroam under wireless networks available near the library and residence.
examples.zh: 迎新指南把「教育科研无线漫游网」列为图书馆和宿舍附近可用的无线网络。

words.enDefinition: the main written content between the opening and closing of a message

examples.en: I included my section number in the email body so she could check.
examples.zh: 我在「邮件正文」里写了班号，方便她核对。

examples.en: The lecturer put the corrected reading list in the email body.
examples.zh: 老师把更正后的阅读清单放在了「邮件正文」里。

collocations: paste text into the email body

words.enDefinition: a short closing phrase used immediately before an email signature

examples.en: I chose a simple email sign-off for my first message to the lecturer.
examples.zh: 我第一次给老师写信，选了个简短的「邮件结尾敬语」。

examples.en: The writing tutor explained how an email sign-off differs from your name.
examples.zh: 写作导师解释了「邮件结尾敬语」和签自己的名字有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: to send an electronic message to the person teaching your course

examples.en: You can email your instructor if the online instructions for the worksheet are unclear.
examples.zh: 如果网上的练习说明不清楚，你可以「给任课老师发邮件」。

examples.en: I asked when to email your instructor about a missed lab session.
examples.zh: 我问错过实验课后，什么时候「给任课老师发邮件」合适。

collocations: email your instructor about the assignment

words.enDefinition: a phone status indicating ordinary service is unavailable but emergency calling may be possible

examples.en: My phone showed emergency calls only when I checked it inside the station tunnel.
examples.zh: 我在车站隧道里查看手机时，显示「仅限紧急呼叫」。

examples.en: A message marked emergency calls only appeared after the phone stopped finding its usual network.
examples.zh: 手机找不到常用网络以后，出现了「仅限紧急呼叫」的提示。

words.enDefinition: to stop a timed focus period before its planned ending

examples.en: I had to end a focus session early when our seminar room became available.
examples.zh: 研讨课教室空出来时，我不得不「提前结束专注时段」。

examples.en: My laptop offered to end a focus session early before the original timer ran out.
examples.zh: 原来的定时还没结束，电脑提供了「提前结束专注时段」的选项。

collocations: choose to end a focus session early
need to end a focus session early
option to end a focus session early

words.enDefinition: to sign an account out of a currently connected session

examples.en: I used my account page to end an active session on the library computer.
examples.zh: 我用账户页面「结束当前登录会话」，那次登录是在图书馆电脑上。

examples.en: Our adviser explained how to end an active session after using a shared device.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了使用公用设备后，如何「结束当前登录会话」。

collocations: choose to end an active session
end an active session on a shared device

words.enDefinition: a reference, often made of numbers or letters, identifying a particular kind of error

examples.en: The support adviser asked me to read the error code from the screen.
examples.zh: 支持人员请我念一下屏幕上的「错误代码」。

examples.en: I included the error code when I reported the problem with the loan tablet.
examples.zh: 我报告借来的平板有问题时，一并提供了「错误代码」。

words.enDefinition: a notification or text explaining that something went wrong during an operation

examples.en: I copied the error message into my support request before closing the application.
examples.zh: 关闭应用前，我把「错误提示」复制到了求助单里。

examples.en: The error message appeared whenever I moved the folder to the external drive.
examples.zh: 每次我把文件夹移到外接存储盘时，都会出现这条「错误提示」。

words.enDefinition: downloaded information that connects an eSIM to a specific mobile service

examples.en: The support page described each eSIM profile by the name of its mobile network.
examples.zh: 帮助页用运营商网络的名称来区分每个「电子SIM服务配置」。

examples.en: My phone displayed the eSIM profile for the mobile plan I used abroad last summer.
examples.zh: 手机显示了我去年暑假在国外用的套餐的「电子SIM服务配置」。

words.enDefinition: a cable used to connect a computer or other device to a wired network

examples.en: I found an Ethernet cable in the drawer beside my old laptop charger.
examples.zh: 我在装旧笔记本电脑充电器的抽屉里找到了「以太网网线」。

examples.en: The helper handed me an Ethernet cable for the desktop in our shared study room.
examples.zh: 辅导员递给我一根「以太网网线」，供我们合用自习室的台式机使用。

words.enDefinition: a socket used to connect a device through an Ethernet cable

examples.en: I found an Ethernet port on the wall behind the desk in my room.
examples.zh: 我在房间书桌后面的墙上找到了一个「以太网接口」。

examples.en: The new laptop did not have an Ethernet port for our wired connection.
examples.zh: 新笔记本电脑没有连接我们有线网络用的「以太网接口」。

words.enDefinition: a meeting arranged to discuss comments or results from an exam

examples.en: I requested an exam feedback appointment to talk about two of my answers.
examples.zh: 我申请了「考试反馈约见」，想谈谈其中两道题的答案。

examples.en: My exam feedback appointment took place after the last lecture of term.
examples.zh: 「考试反馈约见」安排在本学期最后一堂大课之后。

words.enDefinition: to open an alert further so more details become visible

examples.en: I had to expand a notification before I could read the room number.
examples.zh: 我得先「展开一条通知」，才能看到教室号。

examples.en: The tablet let me expand a notification without opening the course app.
examples.zh: 我的平板能「展开一条通知」，不用打开课程应用。

words.enDefinition: A link that is set to stop working after a specified time.

examples.en: Our tutor used an expiring link to share the practice files for that week's workshop.
examples.zh: 导师用「会到期的链接」共享那周研讨活动的练习文件。

examples.en: My classmate asked when the expiring link would stop working before opening the course material.
examples.zh: 同学打开课程资料之前，先问了「会到期的链接」什么时候会失效。

words.enDefinition: an area for browsing content from sources you might not follow

examples.en: I found the pottery club in the explore tab while looking for workshops.
examples.zh: 我找工作坊时，在「发现标签页」找到了陶艺社。

examples.en: The explore tab displayed short clips organised by topic that day.
examples.zh: 那天，「发现标签页」按主题展示了一些短片。

collocations: find a post in the explore tab

words.enDefinition: to add another screen as extra workspace for a different part of the desktop

examples.en: I chose to extend the display so I could keep my notes separate from the slides.
examples.zh: 我选择「扩展显示」，这样笔记可以和幻灯片分开显示。

examples.en: The assistant explained how to extend the display on the study room's computer.
examples.zh: 工作人员讲了怎么在自习室的电脑上「扩展显示」。

collocations: extend the display to a second monitor
learn how to extend the display

words.enDefinition: a screen connected to a device rather than built into it

examples.en: I used an external display so I could keep the assignment instructions visible too.
examples.zh: 我用了「外接显示器」，这样还能一直看着作业要求。

examples.en: The classroom computer recognised the external display as soon as we connected the cable.
examples.zh: 我们一接上连接线，教室电脑就认出了「外接显示器」。

words.enDefinition: a separate keyboard that connects to a computer, tablet or other device

examples.en: I connected an external keyboard to the tablet before taking notes in the lecture.
examples.zh: 在讲堂里记笔记之前，我给平板接了一个「外接键盘」。

examples.en: The library lent me an external keyboard that worked with the tablet I borrowed.
examples.zh: 图书馆给我借了一个和那台借来的平板兼容的「外接键盘」。

words.enDefinition: a notice that an email came from outside your organisation

examples.en: Emails from outside my university often display an external sender warning above the subject.
examples.zh: 我学校以外的机构或个人发来的邮件，常在主题上方显示「外部发件人提示」。

examples.en: The email carried an external sender warning because the guest was using a personal address.
examples.zh: 来宾用的是个人邮箱，所以邮件带有「外部发件人提示」。

words.enDefinition: Giving people outside a school, team, or organization access to materials.

examples.en: The coordinator checked whether the folder allowed external sharing with the class's invited guest reviewer.
examples.zh: 课程协调员查看了文件夹能否通过「向组织外共享」让受邀校外评阅人访问。

examples.en: Our tutor discussed external sharing when a mentor from another university joined our final project.
examples.zh: 另一所大学的一位导师加入期末项目时，我们的导师讲了「向组织外共享」。

words.enDefinition: rules that limit unusually heavy use of a service even on some inclusive plans

examples.en: I read the fair use policy to see what it said about reduced speeds.
examples.zh: 我看了「通信合理使用政策」，想知道里面怎么说降速。

examples.en: The provider explained which parts of the fair use policy applied when I travelled.
examples.zh: 运营商解释了我旅行时适用「通信合理使用政策」中的哪些条款。

words.enDefinition: a deceptive message claiming a transaction was made when it was not

examples.en: The help desk saved a copy of the fake payment confirmation for its report.
examples.zh: 技术服务台保存了一份「伪造的付款确认」，用于撰写报告。

examples.en: My classmate recognised the fake payment confirmation after checking the account record directly.
examples.zh: 同学直接查了账户记录，识破了「伪造的付款确认」。

words.enDefinition: a page that pretends to be a genuine service's sign-in screen

examples.en: I closed the tab after the browser flagged a possible fake sign-in page.
examples.zh: 浏览器提示可能是「仿冒登录页面」后，我关掉了标签页。

examples.en: The university notice showed how to recognise a fake sign-in page using a fictional example.
examples.zh: 学校通知借一个虚构示例说明怎样识别「仿冒登录页面」。

collocations: warning about a fake sign-in page

words.enDefinition: the account holder who manages a family sharing group

examples.en: My sister was the family organiser for our shared reading tools.
examples.zh: 我姐姐是我们共享阅读工具的「家庭组组织者」。

examples.en: The family organiser could see which apps were included in the group.
examples.zh: 「家庭组组织者」可以查看组里包含哪些应用。

words.enDefinition: a mobile plan that includes service for several lines on one account

examples.en: My sister and I shared a family phone plan while attending different universities.
examples.zh: 姐姐和我在不同的大学读书期间，共用一个「家庭手机套餐」。

examples.en: I checked whether our family phone plan still covered the old tablet's line.
examples.zh: 我确认了「家庭手机套餐」是不是还包含旧平板那条线路。

words.enDefinition: a feature for sharing eligible apps or services with a family group

examples.en: I checked whether family sharing included the drawing app before setting it up.
examples.zh: 设置之前，我查了「家庭共享」是否涵盖那个绘画应用。

examples.en: The instructions explained family sharing on a page separate from individual plans.
examples.zh: 说明在与个人套餐不同的页面上解释了「家庭共享」。

words.enDefinition: a cable that does not carry power or signals properly

examples.en: The technician replaced the faulty cable before we started the presentations in class.
examples.zh: 课堂演示开始前，技术员换掉了「有故障的线缆」。

examples.en: We labelled the faulty cable so nobody would take it from the spare equipment drawer.
examples.zh: 我们给「有故障的线缆」贴了标签，免得有人从备用器材抽屉里拿走用。

words.enDefinition: an app given prominent placement by a store

examples.en: I noticed a featured app for planning reading sessions on the front page.
examples.zh: 我在首页看到一款安排阅读时间的「精选应用」。

examples.en: The featured app changed after the end of the study week.
examples.zh: 学习周结束后，展示的「精选应用」换了。

collocations: a featured app on the front page

words.enDefinition: a tab that opens a particular stream of posts

examples.en: I tapped the feed tab after updating the details on our page.
examples.zh: 更新完页面资料后，我点了「信息流标签页」。

examples.en: The feed tab was just to the left of my profile.
examples.zh: 「信息流标签页」就在个人主页入口的左边。

words.enDefinition: comments about how a piece of writing is organised

examples.en: I'd appreciate feedback on the structure before I spend time checking the references.
examples.zh: 在我花时间核对参考文献前，希望先得到「对文章结构的意见」。

examples.en: My tutor gave me feedback on the structure of the literature review on Monday.
examples.zh: 周一，导师提了些「对文献综述结构的意见」。

collocations: ask for feedback on the structure

words.enDefinition: Information about a file such as its location, size, owner, or modification date.

examples.en: I opened the file details to check whether the survey spreadsheet belonged to our group.
examples.zh: 我打开「文件详细信息」，查问卷电子表格是否属于我们小组。

examples.en: The file details showed that the diagram had been moved into our folder after Tuesday's class.
examples.zh: 「文件详细信息」显示，周二下课后，那张示意图被移入了我们的文件夹。

collocations: view file details in a side panel

words.enDefinition: The person or account identified as responsible for a file in a service.

examples.en: I asked the file owner whether the project outline was ready for the tutor to read.
examples.zh: 我问「文件所有者」，项目提纲现在能不能给导师看了。

examples.en: The file owner rearranged the folders after we finished collecting the photographs for our report.
examples.zh: 我们把报告要用的照片收集完后，「文件所有者」重新整理了文件夹。

collocations: a message from the file owner

words.enDefinition: A window or interface for choosing a file to open, add, or upload.

examples.en: The file picker opened in my Downloads folder when I tried to add the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我试着添加工作表时，「文件选择器」打开了我的下载文件夹。

examples.en: I selected both images in the file picker and checked their names before the upload started.
examples.zh: 我在「文件选择器」里选了两张图，在上传开始前确认了它们的名称。

collocations: choose a file in the file picker
select multiple files in the file picker

words.enDefinition: A small image showing a preview or pictorial representation of a file.

examples.en: I recognized our poster by its file thumbnail even though the name had been shortened.
examples.zh: 虽然文件名缩短了，我还是通过「文件缩略图」认出了我们的海报。

examples.en: The file thumbnail made it easier to pick the illustrated handout among the other reading files.
examples.zh: 「文件缩略图」让我更容易从一堆阅读材料里找出带图的讲义。

words.enDefinition: a Windows accessibility feature that can ignore brief or repeated key presses

examples.en: I turned on Filter Keys because I kept pressing some keys twice by accident.
examples.zh: 我经常不小心把某些键按两次，所以打开了「筛选键」。

examples.en: The help document explains which types of key press Filter Keys can ignore.
examples.zh: 帮助文档解释了「筛选键」可以忽略哪些按键操作。

words.enDefinition: alerts that use a blinking light or screen to signal arrival

examples.en: My Android phone offered flash notifications for times when sound wasn't useful.
examples.zh: 我的 Android 手机可以用「闪光通知」，适合提示音不方便的情况。

examples.en: I tested flash notifications before using the device in our editing room.
examples.zh: 在剪辑室用这台设备之前，我测试了「闪光通知」。

words.enDefinition: an Apple setting choosing which app content is shown during focus

examples.en: I used a focus filter to show only the calendar for classes.
examples.zh: 我用了一个「专注模式筛选条件」，只显示上课用的日历。

examples.en: The focus filter hid my personal calendar while I worked on campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校忙时，「专注模式筛选条件」隐藏了个人日历。

collocations: use a focus filter for a calendar

words.enDefinition: a record of previous sessions completed using a focus tool

examples.en: I checked my focus history to see which study sessions I'd completed.
examples.zh: 我查看「专注时段历史」，看自己完成了哪些自习时段。

examples.en: The timer saved all my previous sessions in its focus history.
examples.zh: 计时器把我以前的所有时段都保存在「专注时段历史」中。

words.enDefinition: a visible highlight showing which control will respond to keyboard input

examples.en: The focus indicator showed which button I had reached after pressing the Tab key.
examples.zh: 按下 Tab 键后，「焦点指示标记」显示了当前选中的是哪个按钮。

examples.en: We made the focus indicator easier to see on the society's sign-up page.
examples.zh: 我们让社团报名页的「焦点指示标记」更显眼了。

words.enDefinition: a device mode that reduces distractions while you work

examples.en: I use focus mode when I need to finish a reading without interruptions.
examples.zh: 想不受打扰地读完材料时，我会用「专注模式」。

examples.en: My phone showed that focus mode was active during the morning lecture.
examples.zh: 手机显示，上午上大课时「专注模式」已开启。

words.enDefinition: a schedule for automatically starting and ending a focus mode

examples.en: I edited my focus schedule after our lab moved to Friday mornings.
examples.zh: 实验课改到周五上午后，我改了「专注模式时间表」。

examples.en: My focus schedule started later on days when I had evening classes.
examples.zh: 有晚课的日子，我的「专注模式时间表」安排得更晚才启动。

words.enDefinition: a timed period for working with fewer digital distractions

examples.en: I started a focus session before drafting my part of the report.
examples.zh: 动笔写我负责的报告部分前，我开启了一个「专注时段」。

examples.en: My laptop showed how much time was left in the focus session.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑显示了这个「专注时段」还剩多少时间。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a focus mode is currently silencing alerts

examples.en: My friend could see my focus status before sending another message.
examples.zh: 朋友在发下一条消息前，能看到我的「专注模式状态」。

examples.en: I checked the focus status shown beside my classmate's conversation.
examples.zh: 我看了看同学对话旁边显示的「专注模式状态」。

words.enDefinition: a timer showing how much time remains in a focus session

examples.en: The focus timer showed that I had time for one more question.
examples.zh: 「专注计时器」显示，我还有时间再做一题。

examples.en: I kept the focus timer visible while checking the last two references.
examples.zh: 核对最后两条参考文献时，我让「专注计时器」保持可见。

words.enDefinition: The ordered list of folder names that identifies where a folder is located.

examples.en: I sent the folder path to my lab partner because we had two folders named Results.
examples.zh: 因为我们有两个都叫 Results 的文件夹，所以我把「文件夹路径」发给了实验搭档。

examples.en: The folder path showed that the sample images were inside a different week's lesson folder.
examples.zh: 「文件夹路径」显示示例图片在另一周的课程文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: A visual display of a set of folders and the folders nested inside them.

examples.en: I expanded the folder tree to find the files our tutor added under Week Three.
examples.zh: 我展开「文件夹树」，找辅导老师放在 Week Three 下的文件。

examples.en: The folder tree helped us see where the research notes were stored alongside the transcripts.
examples.zh: 「文件夹树」帮我们看出来，研究笔记和访谈文字稿存在一起。

words.enDefinition: To have a shared canvas or whiteboard show the area another participant is viewing.

examples.en: I chose to follow a collaborator while she walked us through the survey map on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 队友在白板上讲解调查地图时，我选择了「跟随协作者视图」。

examples.en: You can follow a collaborator during the demo so everyone sees the same part of the board.
examples.zh: 演示时可以「跟随协作者视图」，这样大家看到的是白板的同一区域。

collocations: follow a collaborator on the board

words.enDefinition: to choose to see more posts marked with a particular topic tag

examples.en: I decided to follow a hashtag used by the students' drawing group.
examples.zh: 我决定「关注学生绘画小组用的一个话题标签」。

examples.en: The app let me follow a hashtag for the community garden.
examples.zh: 应用让我可以「关注社区花园的话题标签」。

collocations: follow a hashtag for an event

words.enDefinition: to follow an account that has already followed you

examples.en: Two students followed the club, so I used its account to follow back.
examples.zh: 有两名同学关注了社团，我就用社团账号「回关」了他们。

examples.en: I chose to follow back after recognising the account from my seminar.
examples.zh: 我认出那是研讨课同学的账号后，选择了「回关」。

collocations: follow back from the club account

words.enDefinition: a request to follow an account that approves followers

examples.en: I received a follow request from someone in my history seminar.
examples.zh: 我收到了历史研讨课一位同学的「关注请求」。

examples.en: My roommate left the follow request pending until she recognised the account.
examples.zh: 在认出是谁的账号之前，室友暂时没有处理那条「关注请求」。

words.enDefinition: the number of accounts following a profile

examples.en: I checked the follower count before and after inviting people to the page.
examples.zh: 邀请大家访问主页前后，我都看了「关注者人数」。

examples.en: The follower count was shown directly below the club's profile photo.
examples.zh: 「关注者人数」显示在社团头像正下方。

words.enDefinition: the list of accounts that currently follow a profile

examples.en: I searched the follower list to see whether my roommate was there.
examples.zh: 我在「关注者列表」里找了一下，看室友在不在。

examples.en: The club's follower list included several students from our evening class.
examples.zh: 社团的「关注者列表」里有晚课上的几位同学。

words.enDefinition: a setting limiting viewing to people who follow an account

examples.en: I chose “Followers only” for the short update about our craft group.
examples.zh: 我把那条手作小组的简短动态设为「仅关注者可见」。

examples.en: The post was marked “Followers only” just below the photo.
examples.zh: 照片正下方的帖子标识写着「仅关注者可见」。

collocations: share a post with followers only

words.enDefinition: a stream of posts from accounts you follow

examples.en: I switched to the following feed to find the club's latest post.
examples.zh: 我切换到「关注账号信息流」，找社团最新发的帖子。

examples.en: The following feed included posts from both of the groups I had joined.
examples.zh: 「关注账号信息流」里有我加入的两个小组发的帖子。

collocations: a post in the following feed

words.enDefinition: the list of accounts you currently follow

examples.en: I opened my following list to find the student radio account again.
examples.zh: 我打开「正在关注的列表」，想重新找到学生广播的账号。

examples.en: The following list showed both clubs I had joined that term.
examples.zh: 「正在关注的列表」里有我那学期加入的两个社团。

collocations: an account on your following list

words.expression: following up on my office-hours request
words.lemma: following up on my office-hours request
words.enDefinition: refers to a previous request to meet during office hours
acceptedEnVariants: following up on my office-hours request

examples.en: I'm following up on my office-hours request about the last question on the exam paper.
examples.zh: 关于试卷最后一道题，「我想跟进约答疑的请求」。

examples.en: I put "Following up on my office-hours request" in the subject line of the second email.
examples.zh: 我在第二封邮件的主题行里写了「跟进我约答疑的请求」。

collocations: email saying following up on my office-hours request
I'm following up on my office-hours request
subject heading following up on my office-hours request

words.enDefinition: to make a device shut down and restart when its usual controls do not respond

examples.en: The support team told me when to force restart the tablet that had stopped responding.
examples.zh: 平板没反应后，支持团队告诉我什么时候可以「强制重启」。

examples.en: I asked how to force restart the loan device without losing my saved notes.
examples.zh: 我询问如何「强制重启」借来的设备，同时保住已经保存的笔记。

words.zhGloss: 移除此网络的保存信息
words.enDefinition: a setting that removes a previously saved wireless network from a device
acceptedZhAnswers: 移除此网络的保存信息

examples.en: The settings offered forget this network for the hotspot I'd used while travelling.
examples.zh: 设置中，我旅行时用过的热点有「移除此网络的保存信息」这个选项。

examples.en: I tapped forget this network for a connection I no longer used on campus.
examples.zh: 我对一个在校园里已经不用的连接点了「移除此网络的保存信息」。

words.enDefinition: a label indicating a message was passed on from elsewhere

examples.en: The forwarded label appeared above the timetable when my roommate shared it.
examples.zh: 室友分享时间表时，时间表上方出现了「转发标识」。

examples.en: I noticed the forwarded label before asking where the photo came from.
examples.zh: 我先注意到了「转发标识」，才询问照片从哪儿来的。

collocations: a forwarded label above a message

words.enDefinition: a level of service available without a subscription fee

examples.en: I used the free tier for the planner during my first term.
examples.zh: 第一学期，我用的是计划工具的「免费档位」。

examples.en: The free tier included the tools I needed for my reading notes.
examples.zh: 「免费档位」包含做阅读笔记需要的工具。

words.enDefinition: available to get without paying a download price

examples.en: The vocabulary app was free to download when I found it in the store.
examples.zh: 我在商店里找到那款词汇应用时，它「可免费下载」。

examples.en: I checked whether the app was free to download on both devices.
examples.zh: 我查了应用在两台设备上是否都「可免费下载」。

collocations: make an app free to download
an app that is free to download

words.enDefinition: a picture of a gear commonly used for opening settings

examples.en: I tapped the gear icon to look for the app's language options.
examples.zh: 我点了「齿轮图标」，想找应用的语言选项。

examples.en: The gear icon was beside the title on the reading app's home page.
examples.zh: 「齿轮图标」在阅读应用首页的标题旁边。

words.enDefinition: a section containing options applying to the app or device overall

examples.en: I found the calendar display under general settings in the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用的「通用设置」里找到了日历显示选项。

examples.en: General settings included a choice for the first day of the week.
examples.zh: 「通用设置」里有个选择一周从哪天开始的选项。

words.enDefinition: using swipes or other touch gestures to move around a device's interface

examples.en: I switched to gesture navigation on the tablet so it worked like my phone.
examples.zh: 我在平板上切换成「手势导航」，这样用起来就和手机一样。

examples.en: The support page shows how to return to the home screen with gesture navigation.
examples.zh: 支持页面演示了怎样用「手势导航」回到主屏幕。

words.enDefinition: the control for starting an app download in some stores

examples.en: I tapped the Get button beside the class timetable app.
examples.zh: 我点了课程表应用旁边的「获取按钮」。

examples.en: The Get button appeared below the name of the drawing app.
examples.zh: 「获取按钮」显示在绘画应用名称的下方。

words.enDefinition: to return to the first form of something that was changed, such as its wording or design

examples.en: I suggested we go back to the original after everyone agreed that the first layout was clearer.
examples.zh: 大家都认为初版布局更清楚后，我提议把布局「改回最初的样子」。

examples.en: Can we go back to the original for the heading and leave the rest of the page unchanged?
examples.zh: 标题能「改回最初的样子」，页面其他内容照旧吗？

collocations: go back to the original wording
go back to the original design
decide to go back to the original

words.enDefinition: To give someone permission to open a file or shared workspace.

examples.en: Our tutor agreed to grant access to the student who joined our group that week.
examples.zh: 导师同意「授予访问权限」，让那周加入小组的同学也能查看文件。

examples.en: I asked the file owner to grant access to our second reviewer before the workshop.
examples.zh: 研讨活动前，我请文件所有者「授予访问权限」，让第二位评阅人也能查看文件。

words.enDefinition: a bedtime setting that displays the screen without its colours

examples.en: I tried grayscale at bedtime and could still read my evening timetable.
examples.zh: 我试了「就寝时切换为灰度」，还是能看清晚上的课表。

examples.en: My phone offered grayscale at bedtime as part of its bedtime display options.
examples.zh: 手机把「就寝时切换为灰度」列为就寝显示选项之一。

words.enDefinition: a display setting that shows the screen in shades from black to white

examples.en: I switched to grayscale mode before checking whether the handout relied on colour alone.
examples.zh: 我先切换到「灰度显示模式」，再检查讲义是否只靠颜色区分内容。

examples.en: The screenshots still looked clear in grayscale mode when we reviewed the instructions together.
examples.zh: 我们一起看操作说明时，截图在「灰度显示模式」下仍然清楚。

collocations: view a page in grayscale mode

words.enDefinition: a member with permission to manage parts of a group chat

examples.en: The group admin added the new rehearsal link to our chat details.
examples.zh: 「群管理员」把新的排练链接加到了我们群的详细信息里。

examples.en: I asked the group admin to check the spelling of our club name.
examples.zh: 我请「群管理员」核对社团名称的拼写。

words.enDefinition: a short explanation of what a group is for

examples.en: The group description said we used the chat mainly to arrange practice.
examples.zh: 「群组简介」里写着，这个群主要用来安排练习。

examples.en: My classmate updated the group description after the club changed its meeting day.
examples.zh: 社团改了活动日期后，同学更新了「群组简介」。

words.enDefinition: the page showing such details as a group's name and members

examples.en: I opened group info to check the name of the new rehearsal group.
examples.zh: 我打开「群组信息」，查看新排练群叫什么名字。

examples.en: The group info page showed when the reading group had started.
examples.zh: 「群组信息」页面显示了读书小组是什么时候建的。

collocations: details on the group info screen

words.enDefinition: a text message sent to a group of people, or a conversation made up of such messages

examples.en: My classmates sent a group text when our usual meeting room was suddenly closed.
examples.zh: 我们平时碰头的房间突然关闭，同学们发了条「群发短信」。

examples.en: I found the bus departure time in the group text from my study friends.
examples.zh: 我在学习伙伴的「群组短信」中找到了公交车发车时间。

words.enDefinition: a notification felt through a vibration or tap on a device

examples.en: I felt a haptic alert on my watch during the presentation.
examples.zh: 展示过程中，我感觉到手表上的「触觉提醒」。

examples.en: The timer ended with a haptic alert instead of a sound.
examples.zh: 计时结束时发出「触觉提醒」，没有声音。

words.enDefinition: a fault or difficulty involving the physical components or connections of a device

examples.en: The technician suspected a hardware issue after trying the monitor with another computer.
examples.zh: 用另一台电脑试过显示器后，技术员怀疑有「硬件问题」。

examples.en: I reported a possible hardware issue with the keyboard in the student computer lab.
examples.zh: 我报修了学生机房键盘可能存在的「硬件问题」。

words.enDefinition: a word or phrase preceded by a hash sign to group related posts

examples.en: We used a hashtag to collect everyone's photos from the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们用同一个「话题标签」汇集大家拍的展览照片。

examples.en: I searched the hashtag to find posts from my sketching group.
examples.zh: 我搜了那个「话题标签」，找速写小组发的帖子。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that the device has recognised a connected pair of headphones

examples.en: The computer showed "Headphones detected" as soon as I plugged them in for class.
examples.zh: 为了上课，我刚插上耳机，电脑就显示「检测到耳机」。

examples.en: I still saw "Headphones detected" after removing the headphones from the study station.
examples.zh: 从自习工位电脑上拔掉耳机后，我仍然看到了「检测到耳机」的提示。

words.enDefinition: the ability of a device to work suitably with certain hearing aids

examples.en: I checked hearing aid compatibility before choosing a phone from the university's loan programme.
examples.zh: 从学校借用计划里选手机前，我查看了「助听器兼容性」。

examples.en: The support page describes hearing aid compatibility and lists the device models students can borrow.
examples.zh: 支持页面说明了「助听器兼容性」，并列出了学生可以借的设备型号。

words.enDefinition: to exclude a certain person from a post's chosen audience

examples.en: I checked whether I could hide a post from someone without changing its other viewers.
examples.zh: 我确认能不能「对某人隐藏一条帖子」，同时保留其他人查看的权限。

examples.en: The help page explained how to hide a post from someone in your list.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了怎样「对名单里的某人隐藏一条帖子」。

collocations: choose to hide a post from someone
learn to hide a post from someone
an option to hide a post from someone

words.enDefinition: an option to stop showing a post in your own feed

examples.en: I selected “Hide from feed” when I saw the duplicate announcement.
examples.zh: 我看到重复公告时，选了「不在信息流中显示」。

examples.en: The menu showed “Hide from feed” beside the option to save.
examples.zh: 菜单把「不在信息流中显示」放在收藏选项旁。

words.enDefinition: conceals private details in notifications displayed on a locked screen

examples.en: I selected "Hide sensitive content" before lending my phone to a classmate.
examples.zh: 我把手机借给同学前，选择了「隐藏敏感内容」。

examples.en: The lock screen setting let me hide sensitive content while keeping alert icons visible.
examples.zh: 锁屏设置允许我「隐藏敏感内容」，同时保留提醒图标。

collocations: hide sensitive content on your lock screen

words.enDefinition: to conceal status marks on application icons in the taskbar

examples.en: I chose to hide taskbar badges during my timed writing practice on Windows.
examples.zh: 在 Windows 上做限时写作练习时，我选择「隐藏任务栏角标」。

examples.en: Focus could hide taskbar badges until my practice session came to an end.
examples.zh: 专注功能可以「隐藏任务栏角标」，直到练习时段结束。

words.enDefinition: to keep the total number of likes from appearing in view

examples.en: I chose to hide the like count on the photos from our exhibition.
examples.zh: 我选择对展览照片「隐藏点赞数」。

examples.en: The options let me hide the like count before sharing the picture.
examples.zh: 我分享图片之前，可以在选项里「隐藏点赞数」。

collocations: choose to hide the like count
an option to hide the like count
hide the like count on a post

words.enDefinition: a strong visual difference between elements such as text and the background

examples.en: I prefer high contrast when reading long course documents on my laptop in daylight.
examples.zh: 我在白天用笔记本看较长的课程文件时，更喜欢「高对比度」。

examples.en: The campus website uses high contrast for the labels in its navigation menu.
examples.zh: 校园网站的导航菜单标签采用了「高对比度」。

words.enDefinition: the minimum time a touch must be held before the device treats it as input

examples.en: I increased the hold duration to avoid opening items when I brushed the screen.
examples.zh: 我调长了「按住时长」，免得擦到屏幕时误打开项目。

examples.en: The guide explains how hold duration changes the way the tablet responds to your touch.
examples.zh: 指南解释了「按住时长」如何改变平板对触碰的反应。

words.enDefinition: high-speed internet service supplied to a house or other residence

examples.en: Our home broadband was ready the week before I moved into the flat.
examples.zh: 我搬进公寓的前一周，我们的「家庭宽带」就开通了。

examples.en: I compared home broadband with a cellular connection for working from the residence.
examples.zh: 我比较了「家庭宽带」和蜂窝连接在宿舍里工作的表现。

words.enDefinition: the main stream of posts shown when an app opens

examples.en: My home feed showed two photos from our society's exhibition that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早晨，我的「首页信息流」显示了两张社团展览的照片。

examples.en: I went back to the home feed after reading the comments.
examples.zh: 看完评论后，我回到了「首页信息流」。

collocations: a post in the home feed

words.enDefinition: a password used to let another device join a wireless hotspot

examples.en: I checked the hotspot password before sharing the connection with my own laptop.
examples.zh: 我连接自己的笔记本电脑共享网络前，先查了「热点连接密码」。

examples.en: The phone showed the hotspot password in the settings under the network name.
examples.zh: 手机设置在网络名称下方显示了「热点连接密码」。

words.enDefinition: a small symbol indicating a time-related limit or waiting period

examples.en: An hourglass icon appeared next to the apps restricted on my iPhone.
examples.zh: 我的 iPhone 上受限应用旁出现了一个「沙漏图标」。

examples.en: I asked why the hourglass icon was next to my game.
examples.zh: 我问为什么我的游戏旁边有个「沙漏图标」。

collocations: check the hourglass icon by an app

words.expression: how should I send the appendices
words.lemma: how should i send the appendices
words.enDefinition: asks how or where to submit material supplementary to a report
acceptedEnVariants: how should I send the appendices

examples.en: How should I send the appendices for the project if they include several large tables?
examples.zh: 如果项目的附录有几张大表，「附录要怎么交」？

examples.en: How should I send the appendices? The course page only has room for the main file.
examples.zh: 「附录要怎么交」？课程页面只能放主文件。

collocations: how should I send the appendices for the report
ask how I should send the appendices
how should I send the appendices separately

words.expression: how should we cite the handout
words.lemma: how should we cite the handout
words.enDefinition: asks what citation is expected for material from a class handout
acceptedEnVariants: how should we cite the handout

examples.en: How should we cite the handout when it doesn't name the author on the first page?
examples.zh: 第一页没有写作者姓名，「我们该怎么引用讲义」？

examples.en: How should we cite the handout for the section of our report about the lab method?
examples.zh: 写报告中关于实验方法的部分时，「我们该怎么引用讲义」？

collocations: ask how we should cite the handout
how should we cite the handout in the essay
confirm how we should cite the handout

words.enDefinition: reports that feedback cannot be found or opened

examples.en: I can't see the feedback for my lab report on the course site yet.
examples.zh: 在课程网站上，「我还看不到实验报告的反馈」。

examples.en: I emailed because I can't see the feedback even though my grade was posted.
examples.zh: 虽然分数已经公布，但「我看不到反馈」，所以发了封邮件。

collocations: I can't see the feedback in the gradebook
tell the instructor I can't see the feedback
I can't see the feedback on the report

words.enDefinition: an option used to tell a service that you did not carry out an action it recorded

examples.en: I selected I don't recognize this activity after checking the time shown in the alert.
examples.zh: 我核对提醒上的时间后，选了「这不是我的操作」。

examples.en: The support page explains what happens after you tap I don't recognize this activity.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了点按「这不是我的操作」之后会发生什么。

collocations: an option that says "I don't recognize this activity"

words.expression: I have a class during your office hours
words.lemma: i have a class during your office hours
words.enDefinition: explains that an office-hours appointment overlaps with your other class
acceptedEnVariants: I have a class during your office hours

examples.en: I have a class during your office hours. Is another day possible before the report is due?
examples.zh: 「您的答疑时间我有课」。报告到期前，还能改到别的日子吗？

examples.en: I have a class during your office hours on Mondays, but I can meet later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 周一「您的答疑时间我有课」，但我下午晚些时候可以见面。

collocations: mention I have a class during your office hours
I have a class during your office hours on Tuesday
explain that I have a class during your office hours

words.expression: I have a question about the syllabus
words.lemma: i have a question about the syllabus
words.zhGloss: 我对课程大纲有个问题
words.enDefinition: introduces a specific question about the course outline or policies
acceptedZhAnswers: 我对课程大纲有个问题
acceptedEnVariants: I have a question about the syllabus

examples.en: I have a question about the syllabus. Which date applies to the morning seminar group this term?
examples.zh: 「我对课程大纲有个问题」。这学期上午研讨小组用哪个日期？

examples.en: I have a question about the syllabus before I pick a topic for the first assignment.
examples.zh: 选第一次作业的主题之前，「我对课程大纲有个问题」。

collocations: I have a question about the syllabus for this term
I have a question about the syllabus before classes start
email saying I have a question about the syllabus

words.enDefinition: tells the reader to expect the next version of your draft

examples.en: I'll send the next draft once I've checked the table on the last page.
examples.zh: 最后一页的表格核对完，「我会发下一版草稿」。

examples.en: I'll send the next draft before we meet in the library on Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 周四下午在图书馆见面前，「我会发下一版草稿」。

collocations: I'll send the next draft tomorrow
I'll send the next draft before we meet
write I'll send the next draft

words.expression: I'm following up about my proposal
words.lemma: i'm following up about my proposal
words.enDefinition: reopens an earlier discussion about a proposal you sent
acceptedEnVariants: I'm following up about my proposal

examples.en: I'm following up about my proposal, which I sent before our discussion about research questions.
examples.zh: 「我想跟进我发的方案」，就是讨论研究问题之前发给您的那份。

examples.en: I'm following up about my proposal because the project team needs to choose a topic soon.
examples.zh: 「我想跟进我发的方案」，因为项目组很快就得选题。

collocations: I'm following up about my proposal from last week
I'm following up about my proposal for the final project
say I'm following up about my proposal

words.enDefinition: identifies the class group in which the instructor teaches you

examples.en: I'm in your lecture section on Tuesdays and had a question about today's example.
examples.zh: 「我在您周二那组大课上课」，想问一下今天的例子。

examples.en: I'm in your lecture section this term and spoke with you after class yesterday.

examples.en: I'm in your tutorial group on Fridays and wanted to ask about last week's worksheet.
examples.zh: 「我是您周五辅导小组的学生」，想问问上周的练习单。

examples.en: I'm in your tutorial group this term and left my notebook in the classroom yesterday.
examples.zh: 这学期「我是您辅导小组的学生」，昨天把笔记本忘在教室了。

collocations: I'm in your tutorial group on Fridays

words.enDefinition: introduces an email whose topic is a piece of coursework

examples.en: I'm writing about the assignment on the field trip, particularly the section on sources.
examples.zh: 「我写信是想问实地考察作业」，尤其是资料来源那一部分。

examples.en: I'm writing about the assignment from yesterday, because two examples seem to use different formats.
examples.zh: 「我写信是想问昨天布置的作业」，两个例子似乎用了不同格式。

collocations: I'm writing about the assignment for next week
I'm writing about the assignment due tomorrow
I'm writing about the assignment in our module

words.enDefinition: corrects what the reader may think your earlier question meant

examples.en: I meant to ask about the written reflection, not the group presentation next month.
examples.zh: 「我原本想问的是」书面反思，不是下个月的小组展示。

examples.en: In my earlier email, I meant to ask about the morning seminar group only.
examples.zh: 上一封邮件里，「我原本只想问」上午的研讨小组。

collocations: I meant to ask about the reading
I meant to ask about the first assignment
to clarify, I meant to ask about

words.expression: I mixed up the two deadlines
words.lemma: i mixed up the two deadlines
words.zhGloss: 我把两个截止日期弄混了
words.enDefinition: explains that you confused the dates for two different submissions
acceptedZhAnswers: 我把两个截止日期弄混了
acceptedEnVariants: I mixed up the two deadlines

examples.en: I mixed up the two deadlines when I wrote to you about the essay yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天发邮件问论文时，「我把两个截止日期弄混了」。

examples.en: I realised I mixed up the two deadlines after checking the calendar for our module.
examples.zh: 查看课程日历后，我才发现「我把两个截止日期弄混了」。

collocations: say I mixed up the two deadlines
I realised I mixed up the two deadlines
explain that I mixed up the two deadlines

words.expression: I took your course last term
words.lemma: i took your course last term
words.enDefinition: reminds an instructor that you were in their class previously
acceptedEnVariants: I took your course last term

examples.en: I took your course last term and wanted to ask about the reading you recommended.
examples.zh: 「我上学期修过您的课」，想问问您推荐的读物。

examples.en: I took your course last term and spoke to you once about working in the archive.
examples.zh: 「我上学期修过您的课」，有一次还跟您聊过在档案馆做研究的事。

collocations: mention I took your course last term
write I took your course last term
start with I took your course last term

words.enDefinition: tells an instructor where to find the questions in a message

examples.en: I've added my questions below so you don't have to open another document to see them.
examples.zh: 「我把问题写在下面了」，这样不用再打开别的文档来看。

examples.en: I've added my questions below, starting with the part of the reading I didn't understand.
examples.zh: 「我把问题写在下面了」，先从读不懂的那部分讲起。

collocations: I've added my questions below the outline
I've added my questions below your comments
say I've added my questions below

words.enDefinition: tells someone you revised the work in response to their feedback

examples.en: I've addressed your comments on the argument and added a second source to that section.
examples.zh: 关于论证的部分，「我按您的意见改过了」，又给那一节加了一个来源。

examples.en: I've addressed your comments from our last meeting in the version attached here.
examples.zh: 这次附带的版本，「我按上次开会时您的意见改过了」。

collocations: I've addressed your comments on the introduction
I've addressed your comments in the new draft

words.zhGloss: 我附上了修改后的草稿
words.enDefinition: tells a reader that the updated draft is attached
acceptedZhAnswers: 我附上了修改后的草稿

examples.en: I've attached my revised draft for our meeting on Thursday about the research proposal.
examples.zh: 「我附上了修改后的草稿」，供周四讨论研究计划时使用。

examples.en: I've attached my revised draft as a PDF so the original layout stays the same.
examples.zh: 「我附上了修改后的草稿」，是 PDF 格式，这样排版不会变。

collocations: I've attached my revised draft for review
I've attached my revised draft as a PDF
I've attached my revised draft for your comments

words.enDefinition: says that the file sent with the email is incorrect

examples.en: I've attached the wrong file, so I'll send the final version in a moment.
examples.zh: 「我附错文件了」，稍后会发来最终版本。

examples.en: I think I've attached the wrong file because this is an earlier version of my essay.
examples.zh: 我想「我附错文件了」，因为这是论文之前的版本。

collocations: I realised I've attached the wrong file
sorry, I've attached the wrong file
I just noticed I've attached the wrong file

words.enDefinition: tells the reader that the specific section is marked for attention

examples.en: I've highlighted the relevant passage so you can see why I asked about the citation.
examples.zh: 「我标出了相关段落」，这样您能看出我为什么问那个引用。

examples.en: I've highlighted the relevant passage in the copy I sent along with my questions.
examples.zh: 我在和问题一起发送的副本中「标出了相关段落」。

collocations: I've highlighted the relevant passage in the attachment
I've highlighted the relevant passage in the reading
say I've highlighted the relevant passage

words.expression: I've included a link to my draft
words.lemma: i've included a link to my draft
words.enDefinition: tells the reader where to open the draft online
acceptedEnVariants: I've included a link to my draft

examples.en: I've included a link to my draft so you can see the latest version before class.
examples.zh: 「我附上了草稿链接」，这样您在课前就能看到最新版。

examples.en: I've included a link to my draft below the two questions I mentioned after the seminar.
examples.zh: 我在研讨课后提到的两个问题下方「附上了草稿链接」。

collocations: I've included a link to my draft below
I've included a link to my draft at the end
I've included a link to my draft for review

words.expression: I've left a question in the margin
words.lemma: i've left a question in the margin
words.enDefinition: tells the reader you wrote a question beside the main text
acceptedEnVariants: I've left a question in the margin

examples.en: I've left a question in the margin about the survey results on the second page of my draft.
examples.zh: 「我在草稿第二页的页边留了个问题」，想问问调查结果。

examples.en: I've left a question in the margin where I'm unsure how to explain the table to readers.
examples.zh: 不知道怎么向读者解释表格的地方，「我在页边留了个问题」。

collocations: I've left a question in the margin about the claim
I've left a question in the margin on page two
note saying I've left a question in the margin

words.expression: I won't be able to attend class
words.lemma: i won't be able to attend class
words.enDefinition: informs the instructor that you cannot be present for a class
acceptedEnVariants: I won't be able to attend class

examples.en: I won't be able to attend class next Thursday because my train was moved to the afternoon.
examples.zh: 「我下周四不能来上课」，因为我的火车改到了下午。

examples.en: I won't be able to attend class tomorrow, but I will read the assigned chapter before Friday.
examples.zh: 「我明天不能来上课」，但会在周五前读完指定章节。

collocations: I won't be able to attend class on Thursday
email saying I won't be able to attend class
I won't be able to attend class this week

words.enDefinition: an accessibility setting that treats multiple taps in a short time as one touch

examples.en: I turned on Ignore Repeat because quick double taps were causing problems in the app.
examples.zh: 我打开了「忽略重复触控」，因为快速连点两下会影响使用。

examples.en: The setup guide showed how to adjust Ignore Repeat on the device we borrowed.
examples.zh: 设置指南说明了怎样在借来的设备上调整「忽略重复触控」。

words.enDefinition: a setting that shows an alert as soon as it arrives

examples.en: I chose immediate delivery for the room changes sent by my university.
examples.zh: 我为学校发的教室变更提醒选了「通知即时送达」。

examples.en: The app's settings offered immediate delivery and a later batch for reminders.
examples.zh: 应用设置给提醒提供了「通知即时送达」和延后成批送达两种选择。

words.enDefinition: a scam in which someone claims to be a trusted person or organisation

examples.en: My roommate reported an impersonation scam after checking with the university finance office.
examples.zh: 室友向学校财务处核实后，举报了一起「冒充身份诈骗」。

examples.en: The university posted advice about an impersonation scam on its official student website.
examples.zh: 学校在正式学生网站上发布了有关「冒充身份诈骗」的防范建议。

words.enDefinition: an item or feature sold from within an app

examples.en: The extra drawing templates were offered as an in-app purchase.
examples.zh: 额外的绘画模板被列为「应用内购买项目」。

examples.en: I checked what the in-app purchase would add to my reading app.
examples.zh: 我确认了这个「应用内购买项目」会给阅读应用增加什么。

words.enDefinition: an area inside an app offering items or extra features

examples.en: I opened the in-app store to see the extra drawing brushes.
examples.zh: 我打开「应用内商店」，看看有哪些额外的绘画笔刷。

examples.en: The in-app store grouped the extra templates by theme and subject.
examples.zh: 「应用内商店」按主题和题材给额外模板分了类。

collocations: an item in the in-app store

words.expression: in my previous message about the report
words.lemma: in my previous message about the report
words.zhGloss: 在我上封关于报告的邮件中
words.enDefinition: refers to information already given in an earlier email about a report
acceptedZhAnswers: 在我上封关于报告的邮件中
acceptedEnVariants: in my previous message about the report

examples.en: I listed my two questions in my previous message about the report before sending the draft.
examples.zh: 我发草稿之前，「在上封关于报告的邮件中」列出了两个问题。

examples.en: As I noted in my previous message about the report, our group is still checking one result.
examples.zh: 如我「在上封关于报告的邮件中」提到的，我们组还在核查一项结果。

collocations: as mentioned in my previous message about the report
as explained in my previous message about the report
details in my previous message about the report

words.enDefinition: directs someone to information inside a file sent with a message

examples.en: The revised dates are in the attached document under the heading for week three.
examples.zh: 修改后的日期「在所附文件里」，列在第三周的标题下面。

examples.en: You'll find my comments in the attached document next to the relevant paragraphs.
examples.zh: 您会「在所附文件里」找到我的意见，就写在相关段落旁。

collocations: see the details in the attached document
find the table in the attached document
read the notes in the attached document

words.expression: include the course code in the subject line
words.lemma: include the course code in the subject line
words.zhGloss: 在主题行写上课程代码
words.enDefinition: to identify the class by putting its code in the subject
acceptedZhAnswers: 在主题行写上课程代码
acceptedEnVariants: include the course code in the subject line

examples.en: Our instructor said to include the course code in the subject line when asking about assignments.
examples.zh: 老师说，询问作业时要「在主题行写上课程代码」。

examples.en: Please include the course code in the subject line so the tutor can identify your class.
examples.zh: 请「在主题行写上课程代码」，这样导师能知道你是哪门课的。

collocations: remember to include the course code in the subject line
ask students to include the course code in the subject line
please include the course code in the subject line

words.enDefinition: to mention the name of a file in your message

examples.en: My supervisor asked me to include the file name when reporting the missing page.
examples.zh: 导师让我报告缺页的问题时「写上文件名」。

examples.en: Please include the file name so I can find the correct attachment easily.
examples.zh: 请「写上文件名」，这样我就能轻松找到正确的附件。

collocations: remember to include the file name
ask students to include the file name
include the file name in the reply

words.enDefinition: functions provided as part of a particular option

examples.en: I read the included features before choosing the app for our group.
examples.zh: 给小组选应用之前，我看了「套餐包含的功能」。

examples.en: The included features were listed beside each plan's name on the page.
examples.zh: 页面在各个套餐名称旁列了「套餐包含的功能」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of calling time covered by the price of a phone plan

examples.en: I read the terms for included minutes before calling the admissions office from home.
examples.zh: 在家打电话给招生处之前，我看了「套餐内通话分钟数」的条款。

examples.en: The app showed how many included minutes I had left after calling the student services office.
examples.zh: 给学生服务办公室打完电话后，应用显示我还剩多少「套餐内通话分钟数」。

words.enDefinition: a subscription option designed for one person to use

examples.en: I chose the individual plan because only I needed the drawing tools.
examples.zh: 我选了「个人套餐」，因为只有我需要这些绘画工具。

examples.en: The individual plan was shown beside the option for a family group.
examples.zh: 「个人套餐」显示在家庭组的选项旁边。

words.enDefinition: the area or quality of a mobile network signal inside buildings

examples.en: I checked the indoor coverage at my new address before choosing a provider.
examples.zh: 选择运营商前，我查了新住址的「室内网络覆盖」。

examples.en: The provider warned that indoor coverage might vary between different floors of the building.
examples.zh: 运营商提醒，楼里不同楼层的「室内网络覆盖」可能不同。

words.enDefinition: Access to an item that comes from permissions on its containing folder or space.

examples.en: The file showed inherited access because it was already inside our seminar's shared folder.
examples.zh: 该文件已经在研讨课的共享文件夹里，所以显示了「继承的访问权限」。

examples.en: The sharing panel marked inherited access beside my name when I checked the folder.
examples.zh: 我检查文件夹时，共享面板在我姓名旁标了「继承的访问权限」。

collocations: review inherited access on a file

words.enDefinition: hardware that sends information to a computer, such as a keyboard, pointer or microphone

examples.en: The borrowed microphone appeared as a new input device when I opened the audio settings.
examples.zh: 我打开音频设置时，借来的麦克风显示为新的「输入设备」。

examples.en: The classroom tablet let us choose which input device to use when taking notes.
examples.zh: 教室里的平板允许我们选择记笔记时使用哪种「输入设备」。

words.enDefinition: the port or device from which a display is set to receive its picture

examples.en: We picked the correct input source on the projector before opening the first slide.
examples.zh: 打开第一张幻灯片前，我们在投影仪上选了正确的「输入信号源」。

examples.en: The monitor listed two options for the input source on its settings screen.
examples.zh: 显示器在设置页面上列出了两个「输入信号源」选项。

words.enDefinition: to add an app to a device so it can be opened

examples.en: Our tutor showed where to install an app from the class link.
examples.zh: 导师告诉我们，可以在哪里通过班级链接「安装一款应用」。

examples.en: I wanted to install an app for editing my sketches between classes.
examples.zh: 我想「安装一款应用」，好在课间编辑自己的速写。

collocations: install an app on a tablet
a guide to install an app

words.enDefinition: to add software you use to a second device

examples.en: I checked whether my licence let me install on another device.
examples.zh: 我查了自己的许可允许不允许「安装到另一台设备上」。

examples.en: The store showed which apps I could install on another device.
examples.zh: 商店列出了哪些应用我可以「安装到另一台设备上」。

collocations: be allowed to install on another device
decide to install on another device
check whether you can install on another device

words.enDefinition: a status showing an app is currently being installed

examples.en: The screen said “Installation in progress” when I checked my tablet.
examples.zh: 我查看平板时，屏幕上写着「正在安装」。

examples.en: I waited after “Installation in progress” appeared next to the app name.
examples.zh: 应用名称旁出现「正在安装」后，我等了一会儿。

words.enDefinition: a list of the apps already present on a device

examples.en: I checked the installed app list before borrowing the classroom tablet.
examples.zh: 借用课堂平板之前，我看了「已安装应用列表」。

examples.en: The new drawing tool appeared in the installed app list that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，新的绘画工具出现在「已安装应用列表」里。

collocations: an app on the installed app list

words.enDefinition: the amount of storage an app takes up once installed

examples.en: The installed size was larger than the number shown before downloading.
examples.zh: 「安装后占用空间」比下载前显示的数字大。

examples.en: I compared the installed size of the two note apps on my tablet.
examples.zh: 我对比了平板上两款笔记应用的「安装后占用空间」。

words.enDefinition: a condition or message indicating that there is not enough space for an operation

examples.en: The app showed Insufficient storage when I tried to save the workshop recording.
examples.zh: 我试着保存工作坊录像时，应用显示「存储空间不足」。

examples.en: Because of insufficient storage, my tablet could not keep another copy of the presentation.
examples.zh: 由于「存储空间不足」，我的平板存不下演示文稿的另一份副本。

words.enDefinition: Sharing materials with people within the same school, team, or organization.

examples.en: The project notes were marked for internal sharing among people in our seminar group.
examples.zh: 项目笔记标为「组织内共享」，只供我们研讨小组成员使用。

examples.en: We discussed internal sharing before deciding where the supervisor could leave feedback on our draft.
examples.zh: 决定导师在哪儿给草稿留反馈前，我们先谈了「组织内共享」。

words.enDefinition: the storage built into a device where it keeps apps, files and system data

examples.en: I checked the tablet's internal storage before saving the videos for our class.
examples.zh: 保存课堂视频前，我查看了平板的「内部存储」。

examples.en: The support guide shows how much internal storage the operating system already uses.
examples.zh: 支持指南说明了操作系统已经占用了多少「内部存储」。

words.enDefinition: an add-on supplying specified allowance or rates for calls to other countries

examples.en: I added an international calling bundle because I rang my family every weekend.
examples.zh: 因为每周末都给家里打电话，我加订了「国际通话组合包」。

examples.en: The international calling bundle did not include calls made while I was abroad.
examples.zh: 我的「国际通话组合包」不包含我在国外时打的电话。

words.enDefinition: a plan allowance of time for calling telephone numbers in other countries

examples.en: I checked my remaining international minutes before calling my parents from the residence.
examples.zh: 从宿舍给父母打电话前，我查看了剩余的「国际通话分钟数」。
