examples.en: The account listed international minutes separately from the time available for domestic calls.
examples.zh: 账户把「国际通话分钟数」和国内通话可用时长分开列出。

words.enDefinition: using mobile service on another provider's network while abroad

examples.en: I checked the international roaming section before going on my university exchange trip.
examples.zh: 参加学校的出国交流之前，我查看了「国际漫游」一栏。

examples.en: The support agent explained where international roaming was included in my plan.
examples.zh: 客服解释了我的套餐在哪些地方包含「国际漫游」。

words.enDefinition: to reverse displayed colours so that light areas become dark and other colours change too

examples.en: I tried Invert Colors because the white background was too bright in the rehearsal room.
examples.zh: 排练室里看纯白背景有些刺眼，我试了「反转颜色」。

examples.en: The support page explains why some pictures look different after you tap Invert Colors.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了为什么点了「反转颜色」后，有些图片看起来会不同。

words.enDefinition: A message asking someone to join a file as a person who can edit it.

examples.en: I received an invitation to edit after offering to check the captions for our presentation.
examples.zh: 我提出可以校对展示文稿的图片说明之后，收到了「编辑邀请」。

examples.en: My teammate accepted the invitation to edit while we were meeting at the library.
examples.zh: 我们在图书馆碰头时，队友接受了「编辑邀请」。

words.enDefinition: a web address that opens an invitation to join a group

examples.en: I sent the invite link to the three members who had asked to join.
examples.zh: 那三位成员提出想加入，我就把「邀请链接」发给了他们。

examples.en: The group admin copied the invite link for our new study partner.
examples.zh: 群管理员复制了「邀请链接」，准备发给新学习伙伴。

words.enDefinition: Someone invited to access or contribute to a shared file or workspace.

examples.en: The project tutor joined as an invited collaborator to read our draft before class.
examples.zh: 项目导师作为「受邀协作者」加入，在课前阅读我们的草稿。

examples.en: Each invited collaborator had a name beside their role on the sharing panel for our document.
examples.zh: 我们文档的共享面板上，每位「受邀协作者」的姓名旁都显示了相应角色。

collocations: an invited collaborator on a file

words.enDefinition: asks whether an idea is appropriate for a particular assignment

examples.en: Is this topic suitable for a short paper with only three required sources?
examples.zh: 短论文只要求三个资料来源，「这个选题合适吗」？

examples.en: Is this topic suitable, or should I narrow it to one university department?
examples.zh: 「这个选题合适吗」？还是我该把范围缩到一个院系？

collocations: check if this topic is suitable
is this topic suitable for the essay
is this topic suitable for our project

words.enDefinition: to connect a device to an available wired or wireless network

examples.en: I checked the name before trying to join a network in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 在会议室尝试「连接某个网络」前，我核对了名称。

examples.en: My laptop asked if it should join a network without a password automatically.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑问，要不要自动「连接到不设密码的网络」。

words.enDefinition: to move your view straight to the newest item in a chat

examples.en: I tapped the arrow to jump to the latest message from our club.
examples.zh: 我点了一下箭头，就在社团聊天里「跳转到了最新消息」。

examples.en: My phone let me jump to the latest message after searching through older messages.
examples.zh: 搜索过旧消息后，我的手机让我可以「跳转到最新消息」。

collocations: tap to jump to the latest message
a shortcut to jump to the latest message
choose to jump to the latest message

words.enDefinition: To save both files when a copy operation or conflict could otherwise replace one of them.

examples.en: The app offered to keep both copies when I added the slides with the same name.
examples.zh: 我添加同名幻灯片时，应用提供了「保留两份副本」的选项。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to keep both copies so the groups could compare their answers later.
examples.zh: 辅导老师请我们「保留两份副本」，好让各组以后比较答案。

collocations: keep both copies of a file

words.enDefinition: To retain a local copy of a cloud file so it can be opened offline.

examples.en: I chose Keep on this device so the reading would be available during my train ride.
examples.zh: 我选择了「保留在此设备上」，这样坐火车时也能看阅读材料。

examples.en: The project brief showed a Keep on this device option beside the campus map in our folder.
examples.zh: 项目说明展示了文件夹中校园地图旁的「保留在此设备上」选项。

collocations: the keep on this device option
mark a file to keep on this device

words.enDefinition: To retain the unchanged source file when making or editing another file.

examples.en: Please keep the original so we can compare the transcript with our edited practice script.
examples.zh: 请「保留原件」，这样我们可以把文字记录和改过的练习稿对照着看。

examples.en: We wanted to keep the original when we made a smaller copy of the campus map.
examples.zh: 我们把校园地图复制并缩小了一份，同时想「保留原件」。

collocations: keep the original in a separate folder

words.enDefinition: to leave an email's heading unchanged when sending a reply

examples.en: I decided to keep the original subject line when replying about the same assignment.
examples.zh: 回复同一份作业的问题时，我决定「保留原邮件主题」。

examples.en: Please keep the original subject line so the lecturer can find the earlier messages.
examples.zh: 请「保留原邮件主题」，这样老师能找到之前的邮件。

collocations: remember to keep the original subject line
prefer to keep the original subject line
keep the original subject line in a reply

words.enDefinition: to regularly tell the people teaching a course about relevant developments

examples.en: I wanted to keep the teaching team informed about our group's problem with the equipment.
examples.zh: 我想就设备问题「让授课团队了解情况」。

examples.en: The tutor told us how to keep the teaching team informed if the dates changed.
examples.zh: 导师告诉我们，如果日期有变化，要怎么「让授课团队了解情况」。

collocations: need to keep the teaching team informed
try to keep the teaching team informed
ask students to keep the teaching team informed

words.expression: keep your phone out of reach
words.lemma: keep your phone out of reach
words.zhGloss: 把手机放在够不到的地方
words.enDefinition: to put your phone somewhere you cannot easily grab it
acceptedZhAnswers: 把手机放在够不到的地方
acceptedEnVariants: keep your phone out of reach

examples.en: It's easier to notice habits when you keep your phone out of reach for a while.
examples.zh: 暂时「把手机放在够不到的地方」，更容易留意自己的使用习惯。

examples.en: My classmate suggested we keep your phone out of reach during our shared reading hour.
examples.zh: 同学建议，共同阅读的那一小时里「把手机放在够不到的地方」。

collocations: choose to keep your phone out of reach
try to keep your phone out of reach
keep your phone out of reach while reading

words.enDefinition: moving between controls and using a device or website with the keyboard

examples.en: I used keyboard navigation to reach the search field without touching the mouse.
examples.zh: 我用「键盘导航」移到了搜索框，全程没碰鼠标。

examples.en: The student portal guide lists which keys are used for keyboard navigation in the menu.
examples.zh: 学生门户指南列出了菜单中用于「键盘导航」的按键。

words.enDefinition: a courteous closing phrase used before your name in an email

examples.en: I ended my question about the tutorial with "Kind regards" and my name.
examples.zh: 我在问辅导课的邮件末尾写了「致以问候」，随后署上姓名。

examples.en: My professor used "Kind regards" before signing her name in the reply.
examples.zh: 教授回复时，在签名之前写了「致以问候」。

collocations: end a message with kind regards
use kind regards in an email

words.enDefinition: an orientation in which the screen or content is wider than it is tall

examples.en: I switched to landscape orientation to see the entire timetable without scrolling sideways.
examples.zh: 我切换成「横向显示」，这样不用横向滚动就能看见整个时间表。

examples.en: The diagram was easier to follow in landscape orientation on the classroom tablet.
examples.zh: 在教室平板上用「横向显示」看那张图，内容更容易看懂。

words.enDefinition: a collection of translated interface material for software

examples.en: I saw a language pack listed in the downloads for the classroom app.
examples.zh: 我在课堂应用的下载列表里看到一个「语言包」。

examples.en: The teacher checked whether a language pack existed for the drawing programme.
examples.zh: 老师查了绘画软件有没有「语言包」。

words.enDefinition: A label identifying the person who most recently edited a file.

examples.en: The Last edited by label showed my tutor's name even though I originally created the file.
examples.zh: 虽然文件是我最初创建的，但「上次编辑者」一栏显示的是辅导老师的名字。

examples.en: Look under Last edited by to see who changed the reading notes after the workshop.
examples.zh: 查看「上次编辑者」一栏，就能知道工作坊结束后是谁改了阅读笔记。

collocations: check the last edited by field

words.enDefinition: A label showing when the file was most recently saved.

examples.en: I checked the Last saved time before sending the updated orientation schedule to our project group.
examples.zh: 我先查看「最近保存时间」，然后把更新过的迎新活动日程发给项目小组。

examples.en: The Last saved label showed midnight, which matched when my roommate finished editing the document.
examples.zh: 「最近保存时间」显示为午夜，和我室友完成文档编辑的时间吻合。

words.enDefinition: the delay between sending data and its arrival or the return of a response

examples.en: The technician noticed higher latency when our class started a video call that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午我们班开始视频通话时，技术人员发现「网络延迟」变高了。

examples.en: I asked whether the reported latency affected our online discussion more than download speed.
examples.zh: 我问，检测到的「网络延迟」是不是比下载速度更影响我们的网络讨论。

words.enDefinition: the most recent release available for a piece of software

examples.en: I checked whether the latest version included the reading list we needed.
examples.zh: 我查了「最新版本」里有没有我们需要的阅读书单功能。

examples.en: The class guide showed screenshots from the latest version of the app.
examples.zh: 班级指南里放的是这款应用「最新版本」的截图。

words.enDefinition: to stop being a member of a group conversation

examples.en: I decided to leave a group chat after the project finished.
examples.zh: 项目结束后，我决定「退出群聊」。

examples.en: My friend checked where to leave a group chat she rarely opened.
examples.zh: 朋友几乎不看那个聊天群，就查了在哪里能「退出群聊」。

collocations: choose to leave a group chat
decide to leave a group chat
an option to leave a group chat

words.enDefinition: To write your observations or suggestions directly in the file being reviewed.

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to leave feedback in the document before the next writing workshop started.
examples.zh: 辅导老师请我们在下一场写作工作坊开始前「在文档里留反馈」。

examples.en: If the dates look wrong, please leave feedback in the document while you have it open.
examples.zh: 如果日期看起来有问题，请趁文件开着时「在文档里留反馈」。

collocations: leave feedback in the document itself
leave feedback in the shared document
leave brief feedback in the document

words.enDefinition: the relative volume of the sound sent to the left and right channels

examples.en: I adjusted the left-right audio balance while listening to the practice recording in the studio.
examples.zh: 我在录音室听练习录音时，调整了「左右声道平衡」。

examples.en: The tablet keeps its left-right audio balance setting on the same page as mono audio.
examples.zh: 平板的「左右声道平衡」与单声道音频设置在同一个页面。

words.enDefinition: the number of likes currently shown or recorded for content

examples.en: I checked the like count while looking at the club's recent posts.
examples.zh: 我浏览社团近期帖子时，看了「点赞数」。

examples.en: The like count appeared next to the heart below the photo.
examples.zh: 「点赞数」显示在照片下方爱心的旁边。

collocations: a like count below a post

words.enDefinition: to set one time allowance for apps of the same kind

examples.en: My tablet can limit time by category for different sets of apps I use.
examples.zh: 我的平板可以给我用的不同应用「按应用类别限时」。

examples.en: I chose to limit time by category rather than setting every game separately.
examples.zh: 我选择「按应用类别限时」，不用逐一给每款游戏设限制。

collocations: choose to limit time by category
prefer to limit time by category
option to limit time by category

words.enDefinition: a state in which a device connects to a network but has restricted or no access to the internet

examples.en: My laptop reported limited connectivity on the wired network at my study station.
examples.zh: 笔记本接上自习工位的有线网络后，提示「网络连接受限」。

examples.en: The support desk said limited connectivity explained why our shared documents would not open.
examples.zh: 技术服务台说，「网络连接受限」是共享文档打不开的原因。

words.enDefinition: a clickable address placed in the short description on a profile

examples.en: The club caption said the link in bio opened the rehearsal sign-up form.
examples.zh: 社团配文说，「简介里的链接」通往排练报名表。

examples.en: The post said to use the link in bio for more pictures.
examples.zh: 帖子说，要看更多照片就点「简介里的链接」。

words.enDefinition: The actions a sharing link allows someone to take, such as viewing or editing.

examples.en: I checked the link permissions before forwarding the handout to the rest of my seminar.
examples.zh: 把讲义转给研讨课其他同学之前，我查看了「共享链接权限」。

examples.en: The link permissions let our reviewers see the draft while they were away from campus.
examples.zh: 凭这条链接的「共享链接权限」，即使不在校园里，评阅人也能看草稿。

words.enDefinition: a small display summarising what a shared link opens

examples.en: The link preview showed the article title under our club's message.
examples.zh: 「链接预览卡片」在社团消息下方显示了文章标题。

examples.en: I removed the link preview because the image looked cropped on my phone.
examples.zh: 预览图在我手机上被裁掉了一部分，我就删了「链接预览卡片」。

collocations: a link preview with an image

words.enDefinition: Settings that control how a file's sharing link works.

examples.en: We checked the link settings before sending the project draft to our seminar group.
examples.zh: 把项目草稿发给研讨小组之前，我们查看了「链接设置」。

examples.en: The link settings appeared in a separate panel on the page for the document.
examples.zh: 文档页面有个单独的面板，里面显示了「链接设置」。

words.enDefinition: a clickable sticker that opens a linked page from a post or story

examples.en: The club added a link sticker for the workshop sign-up page.
examples.zh: 社团加了一个通往工作坊报名页的「链接贴纸」。

examples.en: I tapped the link sticker to read the full rehearsal schedule.
examples.zh: 我点了「链接贴纸」，查看完整的排练安排。

collocations: a link sticker in a story

words.enDefinition: A display layout that presents files in rows, often with columns for file details.

examples.en: I switched to list view so I could compare the sizes of our classmates' videos.
examples.zh: 我切换到「列表视图」，这样就能比较同学们上传的视频大小。

examples.en: The tutor used list view to show which of the workshop files had changed since Tuesday.
examples.zh: 辅导老师用「列表视图」展示了哪些工作坊文件在周二以后有修改。

collocations: open a folder in list view

words.enDefinition: text generated as people speak or audio plays, displayed on screen with little delay

examples.en: I turned on live captions while watching the student society's talk in a noisy room.
examples.zh: 在嘈杂的房间观看学生社团的讲座时，我开启了「实时字幕」。

examples.en: The lecturer reminded us that live captions sometimes miss specialised terms and names from class.
examples.zh: 讲师提醒我们，「实时字幕」有时会漏掉课上的专业术语和人名。

words.enDefinition: A copy of a file stored on the device you are using rather than solely online.

examples.en: I kept a local copy of the handout for the bus ride to our field site.
examples.zh: 坐公交去实地考察地点前，我留了一份讲义的「本地副本」。

examples.en: The local copy on my laptop was older than the copy my classmates opened online.
examples.zh: 我笔记本电脑上的「本地副本」比同学在线打开的那一份旧。

words.enDefinition: a label associating a post with a selected place

examples.en: I added a location tag for the park where we met.
examples.zh: 我给帖子加了我们见面的公园的「位置标签」。

examples.en: The location tag showed where the study group had taken its photo.
examples.zh: 「位置标签」显示了学习小组在哪儿拍的照片。

words.enDefinition: an alert shown while the device's screen is locked

examples.en: A lock screen notification reminded me to return the library book that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，一条「锁屏通知」提醒我还图书馆的书。

examples.en: I noticed the lock screen notification before unlocking my phone after class.
examples.zh: 下课后解锁手机前，我注意到了那条「锁屏通知」。

words.enDefinition: the approximate geographical location associated with an account sign-in

examples.en: The login location appeared to be different while I was using the campus network.
examples.zh: 我在用校园网络时，显示的「登录位置」似乎并不是我所在的地方。

examples.en: I checked the login location against the city where I attended the workshop.
examples.zh: 我看了「登录位置」是否与参加工作坊的城市一致。

words.enDefinition: the process of checking that someone is allowed to sign in to an account

examples.en: The portal requires login verification when you use a device outside the campus network.
examples.zh: 在校园网外的设备上使用门户时，需要进行「登录身份验证」。

examples.en: I completed login verification before the library app displayed the books I had borrowed.
examples.zh: 我完成「登录身份验证」后，图书馆应用才显示我借的书。

words.enDefinition: a domain name resembling another that may be mistaken for the genuine one

examples.en: Campus IT reported a lookalike domain after checking the address in the suspicious message.
examples.zh: 校园 IT 部门检查了可疑消息里的地址，举报了一个「仿冒官方的近似域名」。

examples.en: I recognised the name from the security alert about a lookalike domain targeting our university.
examples.zh: 我从针对我们学校的「仿冒官方的近似域名」安全提醒里认出了这个名称。

words.enDefinition: a physical connection that does not fit securely and may interrupt power or a signal

examples.en: A loose connection made the sound cut out whenever someone moved the computer.
examples.zh: 只要有人移动电脑，「松动的连接」就会导致声音中断。

examples.en: The technician checked for a loose connection after the picture disappeared from the projector.
examples.zh: 投影画面消失后，技术员检查有没有「松动的连接」。

words.enDefinition: a situation in which sound captured by the microphone is quieter than needed

examples.en: My partner noticed low microphone volume when we listened to the first practice recording.
examples.zh: 我们听第一段练习录音时，搭档发现了「麦克风输入音量过低」的问题。

examples.en: The helpdesk guide explains several common reasons for low microphone volume on borrowed laptops.
examples.zh: 服务台指南解释了借用笔记本出现「麦克风输入音量过低」的几种常见原因。

words.zhGloss: 第四代移动通信技术之一
words.enDefinition: a mobile network technology widely used for 4G service
acceptedZhAnswers: 第四代移动通信技术之一

examples.en: My phone displayed LTE when I checked whether the data connection was active.
examples.zh: 我确认数据连接是否启用时，手机显示了「LTE」。

examples.en: The carrier's map marked LTE coverage along the main road into the university town.
examples.zh: 运营商的地图标出了通往大学城的主路沿线的「LTE」覆盖范围。

words.enDefinition: an update bringing substantial changes to software

examples.en: A major update moved the planner's calendar to a separate screen.
examples.zh: 一次「重大更新」把计划工具的日历移到了单独的页面。

examples.en: The developer described the new drawing workspace as a major update.
examples.zh: 开发者把新的绘画工作区称为一次「重大更新」。

words.enDefinition: To create a new file with the same contents as the original.

examples.en: Our lecturer asked everyone to make a copy of the worksheet before entering their own answers.
examples.zh: 讲师请大家先为工作表「创建副本」，再在里面填写自己的答案。

examples.en: Can we make a copy for the practice session and keep the presentation file as it is?
examples.zh: 我们能「创建副本」来排练，让正式演示文件保持原样吗？

collocations: make a copy of a template

words.expression: make a note of your comments
words.lemma: make a note of your comments
words.enDefinition: to record the comments someone makes so you can use them later
acceptedEnVariants: make a note of your comments

examples.en: I will make a note of your comments when we go through the draft tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天讨论草稿时，我会「记下您的评语」。

examples.en: May I make a note of your comments so I don't forget the changes we discussed?
examples.zh: 我能「记下您的评语」吗？免得忘了刚讨论的改动。

collocations: want to make a note of your comments
remember to make a note of your comments
make a note of your comments during our meeting

words.enDefinition: a link intended to lead users to harmful content or a deceptive site

examples.en: The campus IT team confirmed that the email contained a malicious link that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，校园 IT 团队确认邮件里有「恶意链接」。

examples.en: A warning page blocked the malicious link when the security test was displayed in class.
examples.zh: 课上演示安全测试时，警告页面拦截了那个「恶意链接」。

words.enDefinition: To review who can open a file and control the roles they have.

examples.en: I opened “Manage access” to check whether our tutor was on the list for the draft.
examples.zh: 我打开「管理访问权限」，检查导师是不是在草稿的共享名单里。

examples.en: The group leader showed me the panel labeled “Manage access” on the project file.
examples.zh: 组长给我看了项目文件中标为「管理访问权限」的面板。

collocations: use manage access to review roles

words.enDefinition: to view or change the subscriptions linked to an account

examples.en: I selected “Manage subscriptions” to check the plans on my account.
examples.zh: 我选了「管理订阅」，查看自己账号名下的套餐。

examples.en: The store put “Manage subscriptions” below the account information screen.
examples.zh: 商店把「管理订阅」放在账户信息页面下方。

words.enDefinition: an account administered by an organisation such as a school

examples.en: Our department supplied a managed account for the shared drawing programme.
examples.zh: 系里为共用的绘画软件提供了一个「机构管理的账户」。

examples.en: The managed account showed the name of the university beside my details.
examples.zh: 「机构管理的账户」在我的资料旁显示了大学名称。

words.enDefinition: an update an app requires before allowing normal use

examples.en: The timetable app displayed a mandatory update before opening the new term's schedule.
examples.zh: 课表应用在打开新学期课表前提示有一项「必须安装的更新」。

examples.en: I saw a message about a mandatory update on the store page.
examples.zh: 我在商店页面上看到一则关于「必须安装的更新」的消息。

collocations: a notice about a mandatory update

words.zhGloss: 标记为垃圾邮件或消息
words.enDefinition: to label a message as unwanted so the service can filter it accordingly
acceptedZhAnswers: 标记为垃圾邮件或消息

examples.en: Use Mark as spam on the unwanted advertisement at the top of your inbox.
examples.zh: 对收件箱顶端那条不想要的广告，点「标记为垃圾邮件」。

examples.en: I clicked Mark as spam when the same advertisement appeared for the third time.
examples.zh: 同一条广告第三次出现时，我点了「标记为垃圾邮件」。

words.enDefinition: to change an opened message so it appears unread again

examples.en: I chose "Mark as unread" so I would remember to answer after class.
examples.zh: 我选择「标为未读」，好记得课后回复。

examples.en: I used the option to mark as unread on the message about reading lists.
examples.zh: 我把关于阅读清单的邮件「标为未读」。

collocations: mark as unread in your inbox

words.enDefinition: a file in which edits and comments are shown explicitly

examples.en: My tutor emailed me a marked-up file for the introduction and conclusion.
examples.zh: 导师发给我一个「带修改标记的文件」，里面是引言和结论。

examples.en: I saved the marked-up file before making changes to the clean copy.
examples.zh: 我先保存了「带修改标记的文件」，再动手修改清稿。

words.zhGloss: 每项评分标准对应的分数
words.enDefinition: the points awarded separately for each requirement being assessed
acceptedZhAnswers: 每项评分标准对应的分数

examples.en: Could you show the marks for each criterion for the introduction and the conclusion?
examples.zh: 您能给我看看引言和结论「每项评分标准对应的分数」吗？

examples.en: I checked the marks for each criterion to see where I could improve.
examples.zh: 我核对了「每项评分标准对应的分数」，想看看哪里还能改进。

collocations: show the marks for each criterion
check the marks for each criterion
ask about the marks for each criterion

words.enDefinition: the main password that unlocks a password manager or other protected store

examples.en: My master password unlocks the vault where I keep the rest of my logins.
examples.zh: 我的「主密码」用来解锁保管其他登录信息的保险库。

examples.en: The guide explains what to do if you forget the master password for your vault.
examples.zh: 指南解释了忘记保险库的「主密码」时该怎么办。

words.expression: may I submit a corrected copy
words.lemma: may i submit a corrected copy
words.zhGloss: 我可以再交一份更正稿吗
words.enDefinition: asks permission to hand in a copy with mistakes fixed
acceptedZhAnswers: 我可以再交一份更正稿吗
acceptedEnVariants: may I submit a corrected copy

examples.en: May I submit a corrected copy? I noticed that two tables have the wrong headings.
examples.zh: 「我可以再交一份更正稿吗」？我发现两张表格的标题不对。

examples.en: May I submit a corrected copy of the bibliography before you begin marking the reports?
examples.zh: 在您给报告评分前，「我可以再交一份更正稿吗」？要更正的是参考文献表。

collocations: may I submit a corrected copy after class
may I submit a corrected copy by email
ask if I may submit a corrected copy

words.enDefinition: keys on a keyboard for media actions such as playing, pausing or changing volume

examples.en: I used the media keys to pause the lecture recording without switching away from my notes.
examples.zh: 我用「媒体控制键」暂停了课堂录音，没切走笔记页面。

examples.en: The media keys on the keyboard worked with the player we used in the language lab.
examples.zh: 键盘上的「媒体控制键」可以控制我们在语言实验室用的播放器。

words.enDefinition: To identify a collaborator by name or account tag in a document note or discussion.

examples.en: I used the comment box to mention a collaborator who had the original interview notes.
examples.zh: 我在批注框里「提及了一名协作者」，原始访谈笔记在她手上。

examples.en: When I mention a collaborator in the draft, I usually include the question for them.
examples.zh: 我在草稿中「提及协作者」时，通常会把想问对方的问题写上。

collocations: mention a collaborator in a comment

words.enDefinition: settings controlling who can link your account name in their text

examples.en: I checked the mention permissions before opening the club page to more people.
examples.zh: 让更多人访问社团页面之前，我检查了「提及权限」。

examples.en: The mention permissions let me choose who could mention me in a comment.
examples.zh: 在「提及权限」里，我可以选择谁能在评论中提及我。

words.enDefinition: a label showing someone referenced your account in their text

examples.en: I saw “Mentioned you” beside the student's comment on our club photo.
examples.zh: 我在同学对社团照片的评论旁看到了「提到了你」。

examples.en: The app showed “Mentioned you” next to the text about the workshop.
examples.zh: 应用在工作坊相关文字旁显示「提到了你」。

words.enDefinition: a strip containing menus arranged next to one another

examples.en: The menu bar was above the drawing space on my laptop.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑上，「菜单栏」在绘画区上方。

examples.en: I opened the settings menu from the menu bar after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我从「菜单栏」打开了设置菜单。

collocations: an item in the menu bar

words.enDefinition: a single command or choice in a menu

examples.en: I selected the menu item that opened information about the app.
examples.zh: 我选了打开应用信息的那个「菜单项」。

examples.en: The menu item appeared only when the drawing tool was open.
examples.zh: 只有绘画工具打开时，这个「菜单项」才会出现。

words.enDefinition: To bring edits from separate copies or versions together into one file.

examples.en: Our partners had edited separate copies, so we met to merge changes before submitting the report.
examples.zh: 搭档们分别改了不同副本，所以我们见面「合并修改」后再提交报告。

examples.en: We could merge changes to the bibliography because our two groups had checked different sources.
examples.zh: 两组核对的是不同的资料来源，因此我们可以把参考文献的「修改合并」。

collocations: merge changes into the main draft

words.enDefinition: a rounded area around an individual chat message

examples.en: I could see the photo inside the message bubble below my reply.
examples.zh: 我能看到回复下方「消息气泡」里的照片。

examples.en: The message bubble became wider after I turned my phone sideways.
examples.zh: 我把手机横过来后，「消息气泡」就变宽了。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that the message reached its destination

examples.en: The app displayed “Message delivered” under the link I shared with my roommate.
examples.zh: 应用在我发给室友的链接下方显示「消息已送达」。

examples.en: I saw “Message delivered” before my friend had opened the chat.
examples.zh: 朋友还没打开聊天时，我已经看到了「消息已送达」。

words.enDefinition: a status saying that the app could not send a message from the sender's device

examples.en: The screen showed "Message failed to send" when I tried replying with no connection.
examples.zh: 我在没有网络连接时尝试回复，屏幕显示「消息发送失败」。

examples.en: I noticed “Message failed to send” after checking the conversation again.
examples.zh: 我重新查看会话时，发现显示「消息发送失败」。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a message failed to reach its intended recipient

examples.en: My phone showed message not delivered after I sent the address from the subway.
examples.zh: 我在地铁里发送地址后，手机提示「消息未送达」。

examples.en: The app displayed message not delivered before asking whether I wanted to try again.
examples.zh: 应用显示「消息未送达」，接着问我要不要重试。

collocations: message not delivered to the recipient

words.enDefinition: a short extract showing part of a message before you open it

examples.en: The message preview showed the new rehearsal time beside the club name.
examples.zh: 「消息预览」在社团名称旁显示了新的排练时间。

examples.en: I read the message preview and opened the conversation for more detail.
examples.zh: 我看完「消息预览」，打开会话了解更多细节。

words.enDefinition: a small symbol added to an existing message to express a response

examples.en: I used a message reaction to show I had seen the rehearsal plan.
examples.zh: 我加了一个「消息表情回应」，表示已看到排练安排。

examples.en: A message reaction appeared beneath the picture my classmate had shared.
examples.zh: 同学分享的图片下方出现了一个「消息表情回应」。

collocations: a message reaction below a photo

words.enDefinition: an inbox area holding messages you may choose whether to accept

examples.en: I checked message requests after the new committee member said she wrote.
examples.zh: 新任委员会成员说给我发了消息后，我去看了「消息请求」。

examples.en: The invitation was under message requests rather than in my main inbox.
examples.zh: 那条邀请在「消息请求」里，主收件箱里没有。

words.enDefinition: the recorded time attached to a message

examples.en: I checked the message timestamp to see whether I had read the latest plan.
examples.zh: 我查看了「消息时间戳」，确认自己看的是不是最新安排。

examples.en: The app showed a message timestamp above the pictures from our trip.
examples.zh: 应用在我们出游照片的上方显示了一个「消息时间戳」。

collocations: a message timestamp in the chat

words.zhGloss: 按流量计量的网络连接
words.enDefinition: an internet connection whose use is tracked and may count toward charges or limits
acceptedZhAnswers: 按流量计量的网络连接

examples.en: I used a metered connection while the usual campus network was unavailable that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚常用的校园网无法使用，我用了「按流量计量的网络连接」。

examples.en: The laptop asked whether the new Wi-Fi should be treated as a metered connection.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑询问，新的无线网要不要视为「按流量计量的网络连接」。

words.enDefinition: a physical control for turning a microphone's input off or on

examples.en: I pressed the microphone mute button on my headset before moving the chair.
examples.zh: 挪椅子之前，我按了耳麦上的「麦克风静音按钮」。

examples.en: The microphone mute button had a red light while I was setting up the recording.
examples.zh: 我准备录音时，「麦克风静音按钮」亮着红灯。

words.enDefinition: scrolling through online content without paying much attention or having a purpose

examples.en: I noticed some mindless scrolling after finishing a difficult practice question.
examples.zh: 做完一道难练习题后，我发现自己在「漫无目的地刷屏」。

examples.en: My usage report made me think about mindless scrolling between classes.
examples.zh: 使用报告让我想起课间「漫无目的地刷屏」的情况。

words.enDefinition: the initial agreed period you must stay on a service contract to avoid a possible charge for leaving early

examples.en: I compared the minimum contract term with the length of my exchange programme abroad.
examples.zh: 我把「合同最短履行期限」与在国外交换学习的时长做了比较。

examples.en: The provider showed the minimum contract term on the page before I selected a plan.
examples.zh: 我选套餐前，运营商在页面上显示了「合同最短履行期限」。

words.enDefinition: the oldest operating system release supported by an app

examples.en: The listing gave the minimum OS version below the supported device models.
examples.zh: 详情页在支持的设备型号下方列出了「最低操作系统版本」。

examples.en: I checked the minimum OS version for the classroom tablet before downloading.
examples.zh: 下载前，我核对了课堂平板上的「最低操作系统版本」要求。

words.enDefinition: the least hardware and software needed to use an app

examples.en: I read the minimum system requirements before downloading the drawing software.
examples.zh: 下载绘画软件之前，我看了「最低系统要求」。

examples.en: The minimum system requirements were listed below the screenshots for the app.
examples.zh: 「最低系统要求」列在应用截图下方。

words.enDefinition: an update making relatively small changes to software

examples.en: The minor update changed how section labels appeared in the menu.
examples.zh: 这次「小幅更新」改变了区块名称在菜单里的显示方式。

examples.en: I read about a minor update to the app's reading tools.
examples.zh: 我看了阅读工具的一次「小幅更新」的说明。

words.enDefinition: to fail to see, hear, or notice an incoming alert

examples.en: I worried I would miss an alert about the room change again.
examples.zh: 我担心自己又会「漏看一条提醒」，没看到教室改了。

examples.en: It was easy to miss an alert with my headphones still on.
examples.zh: 还还戴着耳机时，很容易「漏掉一条提醒」。

collocations: worry that you'll miss an alert

words.enDefinition: a mobile messaging service that can include pictures, audio, or video

examples.en: The photo arrived as an MMS rather than through the app we usually used.
examples.zh: 照片是以「多媒体短信」收到的，不是通过我们常用的应用。

examples.en: My older plan listed a separate charge for each MMS I sent abroad.
examples.zh: 我的旧套餐对我在国外发出的每条「多媒体短信」单独收费。

words.enDefinition: high-speed internet access provided through a cellular network

examples.en: The residence used mobile broadband while the building's wired connection was being repaired.
examples.zh: 楼里的有线网络维修期间，宿舍使用了「移动宽带」。

examples.en: My flatmate borrowed a device with mobile broadband during a weekend trip away.
examples.zh: 室友周末外出时借了一台带「移动宽带」的设备。

words.enDefinition: a company that provides mobile network service to customers

examples.en: My mobile carrier sent a notice about coverage near the university's new building.
examples.zh: 我的「移动通信运营商」发了一条关于学校新楼附近网络覆盖的通知。

examples.en: I asked which mobile carrier offered service on the train route to my hometown.
examples.zh: 我问去老家的铁路沿线哪家「移动通信运营商」提供服务。

words.enDefinition: money stored on a prepaid mobile account for future use

examples.en: I still had enough mobile credit to make a call after my class ended.
examples.zh: 下课后，我的「预付手机账户余额」还够打一次电话。

examples.en: The app showed my remaining mobile credit next to the history of recent top-ups.
examples.zh: 应用在近期充值记录旁显示了我剩余的「预付手机账户余额」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of internet data a phone uses over its cellular service

examples.en: I checked mobile data usage after watching several lectures on the bus that week.
examples.zh: 那周坐公交看了几节课后，我查看了「手机流量用量」。

examples.en: The phone listed mobile data usage by application for the current billing cycle.
examples.zh: 手机按应用列出了本计费周期的「手机流量用量」。

words.enDefinition: the process of keeping the same mobile number when changing service providers

examples.en: I read about mobile number porting before switching to a cheaper monthly plan.
examples.zh: 换成更便宜的月费套餐前，我了解了「手机号码携号转网」。

examples.en: The provider explained how mobile number porting affected the temporary number it had supplied.
examples.zh: 运营商说明了「手机号码携号转网」会怎样影响它提供的临时号码。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement with a provider for mobile calls, texts, or data

examples.en: I compared my mobile phone plan with the options listed at the student fair.
examples.zh: 我把自己的「手机通信套餐」与学生展会上列出的选项作了比较。

examples.en: The mobile phone plan included calls but gave me less data than I expected.
examples.zh: 「手机通信套餐」包含通话，给我的流量比预期少。

words.enDefinition: a version of software designed for phones or tablets

examples.en: I opened the mobile version to see how the timetable fit.
examples.zh: 我打开「移动端版本」，看看课表在小屏幕上怎么显示。

examples.en: The mobile version used shorter labels for the same drawing tools.
examples.zh: 同样的绘画工具，在「移动端版本」里用的标签更短。

collocations: a feature in the mobile version

words.enDefinition: a mobile service provider that uses another company's network infrastructure

examples.en: I had not heard of the mobile virtual network operator listed in the campus brochure.
examples.zh: 我以前没听说过校园宣传册中列出的那家「虚拟移动通信运营商」。

examples.en: The mobile virtual network operator used a larger provider's network in our area.
examples.zh: 这家「虚拟移动通信运营商」在我们这一带使用较大的运营商的网络。

collocations: choose a mobile virtual network operator
services from a mobile virtual network operator

words.enDefinition: a cable that carries video signals between a computer and a monitor

examples.en: I connected the monitor cable before opening the presentation notes on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我先接好「显示器连接线」，再打开笔记本上的演示备注。

examples.en: The monitor cable was missing from the equipment kit we borrowed for class.
examples.zh: 我们为课堂借来的设备套装里没有「显示器连接线」。

collocations: check both ends of the monitor cable

words.enDefinition: sound combined into a single channel so both sides can play the same information

examples.en: I enabled mono audio so I could hear both audio channels through one earbud.
examples.zh: 我启用了「单声道音频」，这样只戴一只耳机也能听到两个声道的内容。

examples.en: The support adviser showed us where mono audio was listed in the accessibility menu.
examples.zh: 支持人员给我们指出了无障碍菜单中「单声道音频」的位置。

words.enDefinition: a service plan that continues one month at a time without a longer fixed term

examples.en: I chose a monthly rolling plan because my placement ended halfway through the year.
examples.zh: 我实习年中就结束了，所以选了「逐月续期套餐」。

examples.en: The shop explained which features came with the monthly rolling plan for my phone.
examples.zh: 商店解释了我的手机「逐月续期套餐」包含哪些功能。

collocations: switch to a monthly rolling plan

words.enDefinition: the applications a person spent the most time using

examples.en: My most used apps changed during exams because I did more reading online.
examples.zh: 考试期间我在网上读的材料增多了，「使用最多的应用」也变了。

examples.en: I noticed my note editor among my most used apps this week.
examples.zh: 我注意到，笔记编辑器是这周我「使用最多的应用」之一。

words.enDefinition: an accessibility feature that lets keys on the keyboard move the mouse pointer

examples.en: I enabled Mouse Keys when I needed to move the pointer without a trackpad.
examples.zh: 我需要在不用触控板的情况下移动指针，于是启用了「鼠标键」。

examples.en: The tutor explained how to operate the pointer with Mouse Keys during the accessibility session.
examples.zh: 无障碍讲座上，导师讲解了如何用「鼠标键」控制指针。

words.enDefinition: To change a file's location in the folders of a device or cloud service.

examples.en: I needed to move a file into our archive once the revised drawing was ready to share.
examples.zh: 改好的图纸可以分享后，我需要把一份「文件移动」到我们的归档区。

examples.en: Please let the group know before you move a file that we use in our weekly workshop.
examples.zh: 如果要移动我们每周工作坊用到的文件，请在「移动文件」前告诉小组。

collocations: move a file into an archive
move a file to a shared location

words.enDefinition: To put a file in the place where a service holds deleted items.

examples.en: I saw Move to trash beside the old handout when I opened its file menu.
examples.zh: 我打开旧讲义的文件菜单时，在旁边看到了「移到回收站」。

examples.en: I checked which worksheet was mine before selecting Move to trash for the extra copy.
examples.zh: 我先确认哪张工作表是我的，才给多出来的一份选择「移到回收站」。

collocations: see the move to trash option

words.enDefinition: sign-in protection that requires proof from at least two different types of authentication factor

examples.en: Our student portal uses multi-factor authentication, especially when people sign in from new devices.
examples.zh: 学生门户采用「多因素身份验证」，尤其是用户换了设备登录时。

examples.en: The helpdesk ran a workshop on multi-factor authentication before the new term began.
examples.zh: 新学期开始前，服务台开了一场关于「多因素身份验证」的工作坊。

words.enDefinition: to silence alerts temporarily for roughly sixty minutes

examples.en: I chose to mute for an hour so I could finish the practice exam.
examples.zh: 我选择「静音一小时」，好做完模拟卷。

examples.en: The alert menu offered an option to mute for an hour during my presentation.
examples.zh: 我做展示时，提醒菜单提供了「静音一小时」选项。

collocations: choose to mute for an hour
option to mute for an hour

words.expression: my grade appears to be missing
words.lemma: my grade appears to be missing
words.enDefinition: reports that a grade is not visible where expected
acceptedEnVariants: my grade appears to be missing

examples.en: My grade appears to be missing from the gradebook, though the assignment feedback is visible.
examples.zh: 「我好像查不到成绩」，不过成绩册里的作业反馈能看到。

examples.en: My grade appears to be missing for last week's quiz, but I submitted it in class.
examples.zh: 「我好像查不到上周小测的成绩」，不过我是当堂交的。

collocations: my grade appears to be missing online
say my grade appears to be missing
my grade appears to be missing from the course page

words.enDefinition: A saved version with a descriptive name that helps people recognize it later.

examples.en: Our final rehearsal had a named version so we could find it again before presenting.
examples.zh: 我们为最后一次排练保存了一个「已命名版本」，方便在正式展示前找回来。

examples.en: I opened a named version labeled Workshop Draft to check a suggestion from last month's class.
examples.zh: 我打开一个标签为 Workshop Draft 的「已命名版本」，核对上个月课堂上收到的建议。

words.enDefinition: a very small physical SIM card used in certain mobile devices

examples.en: The shop checked that my phone took a nano-SIM before handing over the packet.
examples.zh: 店家先确认我的手机使用「最小规格的手机卡」，才把卡包交给我。

examples.en: I found the spare nano-SIM in the drawer with my old student cards.
examples.zh: 我在装旧学生证的抽屉里找到了备用的「最小规格的手机卡」。

words.enDefinition: a component or device allowing a computer to connect to a network

examples.en: My flatmate borrowed a network adapter for the older laptop in the common room.
examples.zh: 室友为公共休息室里的旧笔记本电脑借了一个「网络适配器」。

examples.en: The technician checked which network adapter my computer was using for its wired connection.
examples.zh: 技术人员查看了我的电脑用哪个「网络适配器」进行有线连接。

words.enDefinition: slowdowns or delays when more traffic uses a network than it can handle well

examples.en: I noticed network congestion during the first week when everyone was online after dinner.
examples.zh: 第一周大家晚饭后都上网，我注意到了「网络拥塞」。

examples.en: The provider listed network congestion as a possible reason for slower speeds during the festival.
examples.zh: 运营商把「网络拥塞」列为节庆期间网速变慢的一种可能原因。

words.enDefinition: a map showing where a provider expects its service to be available

examples.en: The network coverage map showed an area of weaker reception behind the campus library.
examples.zh: 「网络覆盖地图」显示校园图书馆后面有一块信号较弱的区域。

examples.en: I compared the network coverage map with what I noticed during my train commute.
examples.zh: 我对照了「网络覆盖地图」和自己坐火车通勤时的实际感受。

words.enDefinition: the identifier used for a wireless network, which can be displayed to nearby devices

examples.en: The library guide printed its network name beside the opening hours at the entrance.
examples.zh: 图书馆指南在入口开放时间旁印了「网络名称」。

examples.en: I checked the network name before joining the guest connection at the careers fair.
examples.zh: 招聘会上，我先核对了「网络名称」，才连接访客无线网。

words.enDefinition: a period when a network service is unavailable to some or all users

examples.en: The notice reported a network outage in the study building before my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午的课开始前，通知说自习楼里出现了「网络服务中断」。

examples.en: Our class moved offline during the network outage and met in the usual room.
examples.zh: 在「网络服务中断」期间，我们班改成线下，还是在平时的教室见面。

words.enDefinition: a menu listing the available mobile networks or the way to select them

examples.en: I opened the network selection menu after my bus crossed into the next region.
examples.zh: 公交车驶入下一个地区后，我打开了「移动网络选择菜单」。

examples.en: The network selection menu showed the names of two compatible providers in the area.
examples.zh: 「移动网络选择菜单」显示本地有两家兼容的运营商。

collocations: return to the network selection menu

words.enDefinition: options for changing how a device connects to communication networks

examples.en: The help desk asked me to check my network settings before our next video tutorial.
examples.zh: 下次视频辅导课前，服务台请我检查「网络设置」。

examples.en: I found the setting for the wired connection under network settings on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我在笔记本电脑的「网络设置」里找到了有线连接的选项。

words.enDefinition: intentional slowing of network traffic by a provider under certain conditions

examples.en: The help article mentioned network throttling when explaining a limit in my mobile plan.
examples.zh: 帮助文章在解释我套餐的一项限制时，提到了「运营商主动限速」。

examples.en: I asked whether the slower connection was due to network throttling or local congestion.
examples.zh: 我问网络变慢是因为「运营商主动限速」还是本地网络拥塞。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a particular network cannot currently be reached or used

examples.en: The printer showed network unavailable just before our group was due to hand in its poster.
examples.zh: 我们小组快交海报时，打印机显示「网络不可用」。

examples.en: The phone displayed network unavailable after moving out of range of the usual campus connection.
examples.zh: 手机离开平时校园网的覆盖范围后，显示「网络不可用」。

words.zhGloss: 切勿把验证码告诉别人
words.enDefinition: a notice telling users to keep an authentication code private
acceptedZhAnswers: 切勿把验证码告诉别人

examples.en: The message said never share your code above the entry for my recent sign-in.
examples.zh: 消息在最近一次登录的记录上方写着「切勿把验证码告诉别人」。

examples.en: I saw never share your code in the help article the bank sent me.
examples.zh: 银行发给我的帮助文章里写着「切勿把验证码告诉别人」。

collocations: remember never to share your code

words.enDefinition: a notification that an account has been used on a device not seen before

examples.en: I expected a new device alert when I signed in on my replacement phone.
examples.zh: 我用换的新手机登录时，就知道会收到「新设备登录提醒」。

examples.en: A new device alert appeared on my tablet during the library's computer orientation.
examples.zh: 图书馆讲解电脑使用时，我的平板弹出了一条「新设备登录提醒」。

words.enDefinition: a control for starting to compose another post

examples.en: I selected “New post” to share the first photograph from our walk.
examples.zh: 我点了「新建帖子」，想分享我们散步时拍的第一张照片。

examples.en: The “New post” button sat right above the profile's photo grid.
examples.zh: 「新建帖子」按钮就在主页照片网格的上方。

words.enDefinition: an order showing the most recent items above earlier ones

examples.en: I selected “Newest first” to check the comments from that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我选了「最新内容排在前面」，想查看那天下午的评论。

examples.en: The menu offered “Newest first” along with its default sorting option.
examples.zh: 菜单上除了默认排序，还提供了「最新内容排在前面」。

words.enDefinition: a Windows display setting that makes screen colours warmer, manually or on a schedule

examples.en: I turned on Night Light to make the screen look warmer before evening study.
examples.zh: 晚上学习之前，我打开了「夜间暖色显示」，让屏幕颜色更暖。

examples.en: The lab computer had Night Light scheduled to start just after the library closed.
examples.zh: 机房那台电脑把「夜间暖色显示」设在图书馆关门后不久开启。

words.enDefinition: a display message indicating that the screen is receiving no video signal from the selected source

examples.en: The monitor showed "No signal" when I first sat down at the study station.
examples.zh: 我刚在自习工位坐下，显示器就显示「无信号」。

examples.en: I asked the attendant about "No signal" on the screen before starting my presentation.
examples.zh: 开始演示前，我向值班人员问起屏幕上的「无信号」提示。

collocations: see No signal on the monitor

words.enDefinition: describes the absence of audible output where sound would normally be expected

examples.en: There was no sound when I played the interview on the classroom computer.
examples.zh: 我在教室电脑上播放采访时，「没有声音」。

examples.en: I told the helpdesk that there was no sound from either speaker after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后我告诉服务台，两个扬声器都「没有声音」。

collocations: troubleshoot no sound from a device

words.enDefinition: describes a device that is not receiving charge or whose battery charge is not increasing

examples.en: The tablet showed Not charging even though it was connected to the dock.
examples.zh: 尽管平板已经接到底座上，还是显示「未在充电」。

examples.en: I told the library desk that the borrowed laptop was not charging anymore.
examples.zh: 我告诉图书馆服务台，借来的笔记本现在「充不上电」。

collocations: laptop plugged in but not charging

words.enDefinition: a message saying an app cannot be used on the current device

examples.en: The listing said “Not compatible with this device” when I opened it.
examples.zh: 我打开详情页时，看到了「与此设备不兼容」。

examples.en: I saw “Not compatible with this device” beside the older tablet's name.
examples.zh: 我在旧平板的名称旁看到了「与此设备不兼容」。

collocations: see a “Not compatible with this device” message

words.enDefinition: a feedback option saying you want fewer similar items recommended

examples.en: I tapped “Not interested” on a suggested post about an unrelated subject.
examples.zh: 我在一条无关主题的推荐帖子上点了「不感兴趣」。

examples.en: The menu offered “Not interested” below the other recommendation options.
examples.zh: 菜单把「不感兴趣」列在其他推荐选项下方。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen strip that displays an alert over other content

examples.en: A notification banner appeared while I was reading a paper on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我正在笔记本电脑上读论文时，弹出了一条「横幅通知」。

examples.en: I saw the notification banner before the alert disappeared from the screen again.
examples.zh: 提醒又从屏幕上消失前，我看到了那条「横幅通知」。

words.enDefinition: a group of alerts of one kind sent by an app

examples.en: My phone lets me adjust each notification category for the calendar app separately.
examples.zh: 我的手机可以分别调整日历应用的每个「通知类别」。

examples.en: The campus app had a separate notification category for timetable changes that term.
examples.zh: 那学期，校园应用有一个专门用于课表变更的「通知类别」。

words.enDefinition: a system panel where recent alerts are collected for viewing

examples.en: I checked the notification centre after I finished presenting the slides.
examples.zh: 讲完幻灯片后，我查看了「通知中心」。

examples.en: The notification centre held several updates about our change of classroom.
examples.zh: 「通知中心」里有几条关于我们换教室的更新。

words.enDefinition: a setting controlling when alerts are presented to the user

examples.en: I checked notification delivery after my course alerts arrived in batches.
examples.zh: 课程提醒一批一批送来后，我查看了「通知送达方式」。

examples.en: The phone showed two options for notification delivery in the settings.
examples.zh: 手机设置里显示了两种「通知送达方式」。

words.enDefinition: a small dot on an app icon indicating an alert

examples.en: I noticed a notification dot on the reading app after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后，我看到阅读应用上有个「通知提示点」。

examples.en: The notification dot appeared on my calendar icon when something changed.
examples.zh: 日历有更新时，图标上出现了「通知提示点」。

words.enDefinition: a rule allowing specified alerts through when others are restricted

examples.en: I set a notification exception for the campus calendar during revision week.
examples.zh: 复习周期间，我给校园日历设了一个「通知例外」。

examples.en: My phone treated reminders from my list as a notification exception.
examples.zh: 我的手机把名单里的提醒当作「通知例外」处理。

words.enDefinition: a setting that puts related alerts together on the screen

examples.en: I changed notification grouping so one app wouldn't fill the whole screen.
examples.zh: 我改了「通知分组」设置，避免一个应用把整块屏幕占满。

examples.en: The sample screenshot shows how notification grouping keeps the list shorter.
examples.zh: 示例截图显示，「通知分组」可以缩短列表。

words.enDefinition: a list of alerts that appeared earlier on your device

examples.en: I found the lecture update in notification history after dismissing it.
examples.zh: 关闭那条大课更新后，我又在「通知历史记录」里找到了它。

examples.en: My phone's notification history showed what arrived while I was in class.
examples.zh: 手机上的「通知历史记录」显示了我上课时收到的提醒。

words.enDefinition: the feeling of having too many alerts to deal with

examples.en: I felt notification overload after being added to several new class groups.
examples.zh: 加入好几个新班级群后，我感到了「通知过多带来的负担」。

examples.en: Changing the way alerts were grouped reduced my notification overload that week.
examples.zh: 那周改了通知分组方式后，「通知过多带来的负担」减轻了。

words.enDefinition: an app's authorisation to send alerts through the device system

examples.en: The timetable app asked for notification permission before sending alerts about class changes.
examples.zh: 课表应用在发送课程变更提醒前先请求了「通知权限」。

examples.en: I checked whether the calendar app still had notification permission on my tablet.
examples.zh: 我检查日历应用在平板上是否仍有「通知权限」。

words.enDefinition: a small portion of a message or event shown with an alert

examples.en: I could read the first few words in the notification preview.
examples.zh: 我能在「通知内容预览」里看到开头几个词。

examples.en: The notification preview showed a different room number for the seminar.
examples.zh: 「通知内容预览」显示研讨课换了教室。

words.enDefinition: the Android dropdown panel showing alerts and sometimes quick settings

examples.en: I pulled down the notification shade on Android to check a timetable change.
examples.zh: 我在 Android 手机上打开「下拉通知面板」，查看课表有没有变。

examples.en: The notification shade showed the notice from my language class at the top.
examples.zh: 「下拉通知面板」顶部显示了语言课的通知。

collocations: read alerts in the notification shade

words.enDefinition: an audio signal played when an alert arrives

examples.en: I heard the notification sound while I was packing for the seminar.
examples.zh: 收拾东西准备去研讨课时，我听到了「通知提示音」。

examples.en: Our tablets used the same notification sound, so I checked the wrong one.
examples.zh: 我们的平板用了同一个「通知提示音」，结果我看错了设备。

words.enDefinition: a layered display combining several alerts in one part of the screen

examples.en: I opened a notification stack to read several updates from the campus app.
examples.zh: 我打开一组「叠放的通知」，查看校园应用的几条更新。

examples.en: The notification stack kept the lock screen tidy during our group project.
examples.zh: 做小组项目期间，「叠放的通知」让锁屏看起来更整洁。

words.enDefinition: the loudness of the sounds used for incoming alerts

examples.en: My tablet's notification volume was lower than the sound of the video.
examples.zh: 平板的「通知提示音量」比视频声音小。

examples.en: I lowered the notification volume before the group recording began.
examples.zh: 小组录音开始前，我调低了「通知提示音量」。

words.enDefinition: a usage statistic counting how many alerts the device received

examples.en: The report listed notifications received from each app during my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 报告列出了我上午上大课时各个应用「收到的通知数」。

examples.en: I compared notifications received with the number of times I checked my screen.
examples.zh: 我拿「收到的通知数」和自己看屏幕的次数对比了一下。

words.enDefinition: a status saying someone has their notifications muted at present

examples.en: The conversation showed "Notifications silenced" beside my classmate's name that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，对话里同学的名字旁显示「通知已静音」。

examples.en: I saw "Notifications silenced" and saved my question for our next class.
examples.zh: 看到「通知已静音」后，我把问题留到了下次上课时再问。

words.enDefinition: a status confirming a number has been moved to its new provider

examples.en: I saw number transfer complete on the account page while riding home from campus.
examples.zh: 从校园坐车回家时，我在账户页面上看到了「号码转网已完成」。

examples.en: The carrier sent a message marked number transfer complete just before my seminar started.
examples.zh: 研讨课开始前不久，运营商发来了一条标有「号码转网已完成」的消息。

words.enDefinition: a status saying the request to move a number is still being processed

examples.en: The app displayed number transfer pending after the new plan appeared on my account.
examples.zh: 新套餐显示在账户上后，应用显示「号码转网待处理」。

examples.en: I asked about number transfer pending after seeing the same status the next day.
examples.zh: 第二天我看到状态还是「号码转网待处理」，就问了一下。

words.enDefinition: disabled automatically before anyone changes the setting

examples.en: The menu bar control was off by default on my new laptop.
examples.zh: 我的新笔记本上，菜单栏控件「默认关闭」。

examples.en: I learned that the larger calendar preview was off by default.
examples.zh: 我了解到，较大的日历预览「默认关闭」。

collocations: a setting that is off by default

words.expression: offer a few times to meet
words.lemma: offer a few times to meet
words.zhGloss: 提供几个可见面的时间
words.enDefinition: to suggest more than one possible meeting time
acceptedZhAnswers: 提供几个可见面的时间
acceptedEnVariants: offer a few times to meet

examples.en: I can offer a few times to meet if your usual office hours are already full.
examples.zh: 如果您的常规答疑已经约满了，我可以「提供几个可见面的时间」。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to offer a few times to meet before we confirmed the date.
examples.zh: 敲定日期前，导师请我「提供几个可见面的时间」。

collocations: ask someone to offer a few times to meet
happy to offer a few times to meet
remember to offer a few times to meet

words.enDefinition: an app marketplace operated or endorsed by a platform provider

examples.en: Our course guide named the official app store for our reading app.
examples.zh: 课程指南注明了阅读应用所在的「官方应用商店」。

examples.en: I found the campus timetable app in the official app store on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机的「官方应用商店」找到了校园课表应用。

collocations: find an app in the official app store

words.enDefinition: the communication information published by the organization itself

examples.en: I used the official contact details from the university website to verify the appointment.
examples.zh: 我用学校网站上的「官方联系方式」核实了预约。

examples.en: The adviser pointed me to the official contact details printed inside our student handbook.
examples.zh: 顾问给我指了学生手册里印的「官方联系方式」。

words.enDefinition: the internet domain actually used by an organization for its official services

examples.en: I compared the address on the message with the university's official domain before replying.
examples.zh: 回复之前，我把消息里的地址与学校的「官方域名」做了比较。

examples.en: The help desk confirmed the official domain listed in our orientation guide was still correct.
examples.zh: 技术服务台确认，迎新指南里列出的「官方域名」仍然正确。

words.enDefinition: Edits made while a device is not connected to the online copy of a file.

examples.en: My offline changes appeared beside my partner's notes when the document reconnected after our train ride.
examples.zh: 下火车后文档重新联网，我的「离线修改」出现在搭档的笔记旁。

examples.en: We checked the offline changes before merging our two sets of field notes into one report.
examples.zh: 把两份现场笔记合进同一份报告前，我们检查了「离线修改」。

words.enDefinition: enabled automatically before anyone changes the setting

examples.en: The week numbers were on by default when I opened the planner.
examples.zh: 我打开计划工具时，周数显示「默认开启」。

examples.en: I checked which display options were on by default on the shared tablet.
examples.zh: 我查了共用平板上哪些显示选项「默认开启」。

collocations: a feature that is on by default

words.enDefinition: a keyboard displayed on the screen whose keys are selected without using a physical keyboard

examples.en: I used the on-screen keyboard to enter my name on the library's touchscreen computer.
examples.zh: 我用「屏幕键盘」在图书馆的触屏电脑上输入了自己的名字。

examples.en: The on-screen keyboard stayed visible while I filled in the rest of the form.
examples.zh: 我填表格剩下的部分时，「屏幕键盘」一直显示在屏幕上。

words.enDefinition: a way of organising an email so each paragraph asks one question

examples.en: I tried to keep to one question per paragraph in my email about coursework.
examples.zh: 写邮件问课业时，我尽量「每段只问一个问题」。

examples.en: We used one question per paragraph so the professor could address each point separately.
examples.zh: 我们「每段只问一个问题」，以便教授逐项回复。

collocations: keep to one question per paragraph
aim for one question per paragraph

words.enDefinition: an alert kept visible while an associated activity is still running

examples.en: An ongoing notification showed that the lecture recording was still in progress.
examples.zh: 一条「持续任务通知」显示讲座录像还在继续。

examples.en: The ongoing notification disappeared once my audio app stopped playing in class.
examples.zh: 课上音频应用停止播放后，「持续任务通知」消失了。

words.enDefinition: A file listed on the device that normally needs an internet connection to open.

examples.en: The campus map was an online-only file, so it would not open without internet access on the train.
examples.zh: 校园地图是「仅在线可用的文件」，所以我在火车上断网时打不开。

examples.en: I recognized the online-only file by the cloud symbol beside it in our shared folder.
examples.zh: 我看共享文件夹里文件旁边的云朵标记，认出了那个「仅在线可用的文件」。

words.enDefinition: a dishonest scheme carried out online to obtain money or personal information

examples.en: The student newsletter described an online scam that several people had reported that week.
examples.zh: 学生通讯介绍了一起那周有多人举报的「网络诈骗」。

examples.en: I wasn't sure whether the message was an online scam, so I asked campus IT.
examples.zh: 我不确定这条消息是不是「网络诈骗」，就去问了校园 IT 部门。

words.enDefinition: a visibility option allowing only you to see the content

examples.en: I set the post to “Only me” while I checked the caption.
examples.zh: 核对配文时，我把帖子设成了「仅自己可见」。

examples.en: The “Only me” option was at the bottom of the audience list.
examples.zh: 「仅自己可见」选项在受众列表的最下面。

words.enDefinition: a setting letting an app start when you enter your device account

examples.en: I turned on “Open at login” for the planner I used every morning.
examples.zh: 我给每天早上用的计划工具开启了「登录系统时自动打开」。

examples.en: The menu offered “Open at login” near the other launch options.
examples.zh: 菜单把「登录系统时自动打开」放在其他启动选项旁。

words.enDefinition: To display a file or linked item in a web browser instead of a separate app.

examples.en: I chose Open in browser because I was working at a public computer in the library.
examples.zh: 因为当时用的是图书馆的公共电脑，我选择了「在浏览器中打开」。

examples.en: Open in browser was the option our tutor used when checking our slides from her laptop.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在笔记本电脑上查看我们的幻灯片时用的是「在浏览器中打开」选项。

collocations: open in browser from the menu
open a document in the browser

words.enDefinition: To display a cloud file in the installed desktop application associated with it.

examples.en: I selected Open in desktop app so I could see the spreadsheet on my larger screen.
examples.zh: 我选择了「在桌面应用中打开」，这样就能在大屏幕上看电子表格。

examples.en: The class handout showed an Open in desktop app option beside the spreadsheet on the portal.
examples.zh: 课堂讲义展示了门户中电子表格旁的「在桌面应用中打开」选项。

collocations: open a file in the desktop app
the open in desktop app option

words.enDefinition: a menu choice for selecting which app will open a file

examples.en: I used “Open with” to try the new programme on a picture.
examples.zh: 我用「打开方式」试着用新程序打开一张图片。

examples.en: The menu showed “Open with” beneath the picture's file information.
examples.zh: 菜单在图片的文件信息下方显示了「打开方式」。

words.enDefinition: the first full sentence that introduces an email or other text

examples.en: My opening line explained that I'd attended her lecture on coastal erosion.
examples.zh: 我的「开头一句」说明，我听过她讲海岸侵蚀的课。

examples.en: The tutor suggested shortening my opening line before I sent the question.
examples.zh: 导师建议我发问题邮件之前，把「开头一句」缩短些。

words.enDefinition: an extra feature that users may choose to add

examples.en: The extra handwriting tools were listed as an optional add-on for the app.
examples.zh: 额外的手写工具列为这款应用的「可选附加功能」。

examples.en: I checked what the optional add-on would change in my planner.
examples.zh: 我确认了这个「可选附加功能」会给计划工具带来什么变化。

words.enDefinition: an update you can choose to install now or leave for later

examples.en: The store showed an optional update for the reading app after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，商店显示阅读应用有一项「可选更新」。

examples.en: I read the notes about the optional update while waiting for my seminar.
examples.zh: 等研讨课开始时，我看了「可选更新」的说明。

collocations: wait to install an optional update

words.enDefinition: a fee for calls, texts, or data beyond what a plan includes

examples.en: The bill included an out-of-bundle charge for my call to an overseas number.
examples.zh: 账单上有我拨打海外号码产生的「套餐外费用」。

examples.en: I asked how the out-of-bundle charge appeared in the monthly statement for my plan.
examples.zh: 我问我的套餐每月对账单上怎样显示「套餐外费用」。

words.enDefinition: hardware that receives information from a computer, such as a speaker, display or printer

examples.en: I chose the headphones as the output device in the sound settings before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我在声音设置里把耳机选为「输出设备」。

examples.en: The computer identified the projector as a new output device after we connected it.
examples.zh: 我们接上投影仪后，电脑把它识别为新的「输出设备」。

words.zhGloss: 在您的常规答疑时间之外
words.enDefinition: at a time other than the instructor's usual student meeting period
acceptedZhAnswers: 在您的常规答疑时间之外

examples.en: Could we meet outside your regular office hours to discuss the group project briefly?
examples.zh: 我们能「在您的常规答疑时间之外」见一面，简单谈谈小组项目吗？

examples.en: I wanted to check whether you meet students outside your regular office hours that week.
examples.zh: 我想确认一下，那周您是否「在常规答疑时间之外」见学生。

collocations: meet outside your regular office hours
ask to meet outside your regular office hours
arrange a time outside your regular office hours

words.enDefinition: a menu holding actions that are not shown on the main toolbar

examples.en: I found the language choice in the overflow menu on the small screen.
examples.zh: 我在小屏幕的「更多选项菜单」里找到了语言选择。

examples.en: The overflow menu held a link to the app's version information.
examples.zh: 「更多选项菜单」里有个通往应用版本信息的链接。

collocations: an action in the overflow menu

words.enDefinition: a notice that the temperature of a device is higher than its intended operating range

examples.en: I saw an overheating warning after leaving the tablet in direct sunlight during lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时我把平板放在阳光直射处，后来看到了一条「设备过热警告」。

examples.en: The desk attendant asked when the overheating warning had appeared on the borrowed laptop.
examples.zh: 服务台人员问，我借的笔记本是什么时候弹出「设备过热警告」的。

words.enDefinition: To save new data over the current contents of a file.

examples.en: I did not want to overwrite a file that still held another group's original interview notes.
examples.zh: 我不想「覆盖这份文件」，因为里面还有另一小组的原始访谈笔记。

examples.en: The warning appeared when I tried to overwrite a file with my corrected lab table.
examples.zh: 我尝试用改好的实验表格「覆盖文件」时，屏幕上出现了警告。

collocations: overwrite a file with a newer copy
overwrite a file of the same name

words.enDefinition: a situation in which some transmitted data packets fail to reach their destination

examples.en: The report showed packet loss during the part of the call that kept cutting out.
examples.zh: 报告显示，通话反复断线的那一段出现了「数据包丢失」。

examples.en: I asked whether packet loss could explain why some words were missing from the audio.
examples.zh: 我问，音频里有些词听不到是否可能是「数据包丢失」导致的。

words.enDefinition: an app that costs money to obtain from a store

examples.en: I chose a paid app after comparing the tools listed for both options.
examples.zh: 对比两个选项列出的工具后，我选了一个「付费应用」。

examples.en: The paid app had the price next to its download button.
examples.zh: 「付费应用」的价格显示在下载按钮旁。

words.enDefinition: a paperclip-shaped symbol indicating where to add or find attachments

examples.en: I clicked the paperclip icon to attach my revised essay to the email.
examples.zh: 我点了「回形针图标」，把修改后的论文附在邮件里。

examples.en: The paperclip icon showed that the lecturer's message included a file.
examples.zh: 「回形针图标」表示老师的邮件附带了文件。

words.enDefinition: a scam that uses a false claim about a parcel or delivery

examples.en: The residence office warned students about a parcel delivery scam reported in our area.
examples.zh: 宿管办公室提醒学生，我们这一带已有人举报「快递投递诈骗」。

examples.en: I read the parcel delivery scam notice while waiting for my book order to arrive.
examples.zh: 等买的书送到时，我读了「快递投递诈骗」的提醒。

collocations: warning about a parcel delivery scam

words.enDefinition: The folder that directly contains a given folder.

examples.en: I went back to the parent folder to find our other worksheets from the spring workshop.
examples.zh: 我返回「上一级文件夹」，去找春季工作坊的其他工作表。

examples.en: The parent folder held three smaller folders named after the weeks in our group research schedule.
examples.zh: 「上一级文件夹」里有三个小文件夹，以小组研究日程中的周次命名。

words.enDefinition: a digital sign-in credential that uses cryptography and usually asks you to unlock a device

examples.en: I created a passkey for the reading app using the settings on my phone.
examples.zh: 我通过手机设置给阅读应用创建了「通行密钥」。

examples.en: Her passkey let her sign in without entering a password on the student website.
examples.zh: 有了「通行密钥」，她不用输入密码就登录了学生网站。

collocations: use a passkey to sign in

words.enDefinition: a relatively long password made from words or other memorable elements

examples.en: I chose a passphrase because I could remember several unrelated words more easily.
examples.zh: 我选了「密码短语」，因为几个互不相关的词更好记。

examples.en: Our tutor explained the idea of a passphrase during the student security workshop.
examples.zh: 导师在学生安全工作坊上解释了「密码短语」这个概念。

words.enDefinition: a feature that enters a stored password into a sign-in form for you

examples.en: I used password autofill when signing in to the university portal on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上登录校园门户时用了「自动填充密码」。

examples.en: The instructor demonstrated password autofill on a practice account during the workshop about accessibility.
examples.zh: 导师在无障碍工作坊上用练习账户演示了「自动填充密码」。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that you must set a new password to continue using a service

examples.en: I saw Password change required when I opened the portal after the winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假结束后我打开门户，看到了「必须更改密码」的提示。

examples.en: The helpdesk confirmed why Password change required appeared on the computer in the library.
examples.zh: 服务台确认了图书馆电脑上为什么会出现「必须更改密码」。

words.enDefinition: a tool that creates passwords, usually using randomly selected characters or words

examples.en: The password generator suggested a new password when I registered for the campus service.
examples.zh: 我注册校园服务时，「密码生成器」建议了一个新密码。

examples.en: I opened the password generator within my manager when making a new student account.
examples.zh: 创建新的学生账户时，我打开了密码管理器自带的「密码生成器」。

words.enDefinition: software that stores and manages login details, and often generates passwords

examples.en: I use a password manager to keep separate passwords for my student accounts.
examples.zh: 我用「密码管理器」为各个学生账户保存不同的密码。

examples.en: The helpdesk explained how a password manager differs from keeping passwords in a spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 服务台解释了用「密码管理器」和把密码记在表格里有什么不同。

words.enDefinition: the process of setting a new password, often because you cannot use the current one

examples.en: I requested a password reset after forgetting my login for the student portal.
examples.zh: 忘了学生门户的登录密码后，我申请了「密码重置」。

examples.en: The password reset took only a few minutes once I reached the helpdesk.
examples.zh: 联系上服务台后，「密码重置」只花了几分钟。

words.enDefinition: a link that opens the page where an account holder can set a replacement password

examples.en: The official support page said the password reset link would expire after a short time.
examples.zh: 官方支持页面说，「密码重设链接」会在短时间内失效。

examples.en: I requested another password reset link after the first one had stopped working.
examples.zh: 第一个链接失效后，我重新申请了一个「密码重设链接」。

words.enDefinition: a request to begin the process of setting a new password for an account

examples.en: I received a confirmation after submitting a password reset request on the official page.
examples.zh: 我在官方页面提交「密码重设请求」后，收到了一条确认通知。

examples.en: The helpdesk checked the status of my password reset request during the call.
examples.zh: 通话时，服务台查询了我的「密码重设请求」处理到哪一步。

words.enDefinition: using the same password for multiple accounts or services

examples.en: The campus security workshop explained why password reuse can put several accounts at risk.
examples.zh: 校园安全工作坊解释了为什么「重复使用密码」会让多个账户面临风险。

examples.en: I learned about password reuse after my old music account appeared in a breach notice.
examples.zh: 旧的音乐账户出现在泄露通知里之后，我才了解「重复使用密码」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a protected store for login information, typically provided by a password manager

examples.en: My password vault keeps the login records for both of my student accounts.
examples.zh: 我的「密码保险库」保管着两个学生账户的登录信息。

examples.en: The password vault locked when my laptop went to sleep during the lecture.
examples.zh: 我上课时电脑进入睡眠状态，「密码保险库」随之锁定。

collocations: store a login in a password vault

words.enDefinition: signing in without typing an account password, using another form of verification

examples.en: The student portal offered passwordless sign-in as an option alongside its existing password form.
examples.zh: 学生门户在原有的密码表单之外，提供了「无密码登录」选项。

examples.en: Our tutor demonstrated passwordless sign-in using a test account during the orientation session.
examples.zh: 入学培训时，导师用测试账户演示了「无密码登录」。

words.enDefinition: to make selected apps temporarily unavailable to avoid distraction

examples.en: I use Android Focus mode to pause distracting apps when I'm doing practice questions.
examples.zh: 我做练习题时，用 Android 专注模式「暂停干扰专注的应用」。

examples.en: Could my device pause distracting apps until our group planning session is over?
examples.zh: 我能不能用设备「暂停干扰专注的应用」，直到小组计划会结束？

collocations: use focus mode to pause distracting apps

words.enDefinition: to stop a timer temporarily without resetting its elapsed time

examples.en: I had to pause the timer when my tutor asked a question.
examples.zh: 导师提问时，我得「暂停计时器」。

examples.en: We agreed to pause the timer while another student found the handout.
examples.zh: 另一名同学找讲义时，我们同意先「暂停计时器」。

words.enDefinition: an app whose use and alerts have been paused temporarily

examples.en: The screen showed the game as a paused app during revision time.
examples.zh: 复习时，屏幕显示那款游戏是「已暂停的应用」。

examples.en: I couldn't open a paused app while my Android Focus mode was running.
examples.zh: Android 专注模式运行时，我打不开「已暂停的应用」。

words.enDefinition: A category for people who already have permission to open a file or folder.

examples.en: The dialog described “People with existing access” as one option when sharing our group notes.
examples.zh: 共享小组笔记时，对话框把「已有权限的人」列为一个选项。

examples.en: I picked a link for people with existing access because our whole team was already invited.
examples.zh: 我们组已经全员受邀，所以我选了面向「已有权限的人」的链接。

collocations: a link for people with existing access
available to people with existing access

words.enDefinition: To remove an item without leaving an ordinary option to restore it from the trash.

examples.en: I read the Permanently delete warning and asked our group which version they wanted to retain.
examples.zh: 我看到「永久删除」警告后，问了小组成员希望留哪个版本。

examples.en: The example screen showed Permanently delete near the bottom of the menu for an old draft.
examples.zh: 示例界面中，旧草稿菜单靠下的位置显示着「永久删除」。

collocations: a warning about permanently deleting files

words.enDefinition: a banner that remains visible until it is dismissed or opened

examples.en: A persistent banner covered the top of my screen until I dismissed it.
examples.zh: 「持续显示的横幅」一直挡着屏幕上方，直到我把它关掉。

examples.en: I picked a persistent banner for changes to the laboratory schedule.
examples.zh: 我为实验室课表变更选了「持续显示的横幅」。

words.enDefinition: fraudulent messages or sites that try to trick people into disclosing information or taking harmful actions

examples.en: The university's guide to phishing used a sample message that students could discuss in class.
examples.zh: 学校的「网络钓鱼」指南用了一个示例消息，学生可以在课堂上讨论。

examples.en: Our lecturer mentioned phishing after the help desk removed a suspicious email from student accounts.
examples.zh: 技术服务台从学生邮箱中移除一封可疑邮件后，讲师提到了「网络钓鱼」。

words.enDefinition: an instance of someone trying to trick a recipient through phishing

examples.en: The support desk treated the unexpected account request as a possible phishing attempt.
examples.zh: 技术服务台把那条意外收到的账户请求视为可能的「网络钓鱼企图」。

examples.en: The campus warning said a phishing attempt had been reported by several research students.
examples.zh: 校园警告写着，几名研究生举报了同一次「网络钓鱼企图」。

words.enDefinition: an email sent as part of a phishing attempt

examples.en: I reported the phishing email that had appeared to come from my course office.
examples.zh: 我举报了那封看起来来自课程办公室的「钓鱼邮件」。

examples.en: Campus IT confirmed the phishing email when I asked whether the notice was genuine.
examples.zh: 我询问通知是不是真的时，校园 IT 部门确认那是「钓鱼邮件」。

words.enDefinition: a fabricated invoice presented as though a genuine payment were owed

examples.en: The accounts office confirmed the phony invoice did not belong to our student society.
examples.zh: 财务办公室确认，那张「伪造的付款账单」与我们的学生社团无关。

examples.en: I asked the event organizer about the phony invoice after spotting a different address.
examples.zh: 我发现地址不同，就向活动组织者询问了那张「伪造的付款账单」。

words.enDefinition: a removable card that connects a mobile device to a subscriber's service

examples.en: My older phone still used a physical SIM even after I changed my plan.
examples.zh: 我更改套餐后，老手机仍使用「实体手机卡」。

examples.en: The assistant asked whether I needed a physical SIM for my spare phone.
examples.zh: 店员问备用手机需不需要「实体手机卡」。

words.expression: pick up your phone out of habit
words.lemma: pick up your phone out of habit
words.enDefinition: to reach for your phone automatically without having a particular reason
acceptedEnVariants: pick up your phone out of habit

examples.en: It's easy to pick up your phone out of habit when an online lecture stops briefly.
examples.zh: 网课短暂停下来时，很容易「习惯性拿起手机」。

examples.en: You might pick up your phone out of habit even before checking what time it is.
examples.zh: 你可能还没想看时间，就已经「习惯性拿起手机」了。

collocations: tend to pick up your phone out of habit
often pick up your phone out of habit
notice you pick up your phone out of habit

words.enDefinition: to keep a chat at the top of your conversation list

examples.en: I chose to pin a conversation with my project team for that week.
examples.zh: 那一周，我选择把项目组的「会话置顶」。

examples.en: I found an option to pin a conversation on my own chat list.
examples.zh: 我在自己的聊天列表里找到了「置顶会话」的选项。

collocations: an option to pin a conversation
pin a conversation for quick access

words.enDefinition: to move two fingers closer together or farther apart on a touchscreen to change the scale

examples.en: I used pinch to zoom to check the small labels on the campus map.
examples.zh: 我用「双指捏合缩放」看清了校园地图上的小字。

examples.en: The gallery app supports pinch to zoom when you are viewing a single photograph.
examples.zh: 单独查看一张照片时，相册应用支持「双指捏合缩放」。

words.enDefinition: a comment chosen to stay near the top of a discussion

examples.en: The pinned comment listed the date of our next book club meeting.
examples.zh: 「置顶评论」写了我们读书会下次见面的日期。

examples.en: I read the pinned comment before asking where the other photos were.
examples.zh: 询问其他照片在哪里之前，我先看了「置顶评论」。

collocations: a pinned comment below a post

words.enDefinition: wording introducing when the new subscription option becomes active

examples.en: The note explained when the plan change takes effect for my reading app.
examples.zh: 说明写明了阅读应用的「套餐变更生效时间」。

examples.en: I checked the date when the plan change takes effect on my account.
examples.zh: 我查了账户里「套餐变更生效」的日期。

collocations: check when the plan change takes effect
a date when the plan change takes effect
see when your plan change takes effect

words.enDefinition: a restriction on how much of something a plan allows

examples.en: I checked the plan limit before adding another workspace for my course.
examples.zh: 给课程再建一个工作区之前，我查了「套餐使用上限」。

examples.en: The guide listed the plan limit below the included features.
examples.zh: 指南把「套餐使用上限」列在套餐包含的功能下方。

words.enDefinition: a short summary of the service option and its main terms

examples.en: I opened the plan overview to check which drawing tools were included.
examples.zh: 我打开「套餐概览」，查看包含哪些绘画工具。

examples.en: The plan overview listed the access period beside the main features.
examples.zh: 「套餐概览」把可使用的期限和主要功能列在一起。

words.enDefinition: to produce an example audio signal to check that an output device is working

examples.en: I clicked the speaker icon to play a test sound before the seminar began.
examples.zh: 研讨课开始前，我点了扬声器图标「播放测试音」。

examples.en: The assistant asked the computer to play a test sound through both speakers in the room.
examples.zh: 工作人员让电脑通过房间里的两个音箱「播放测试音」。

collocations: choose to play a test sound
play a test sound through headphones
press the button to play a test sound

words.enDefinition: asks the reader to work with an updated copy instead

examples.en: Please use the revised version of the reading list for next Monday's seminar.
examples.zh: 下周一的研讨课「请用修改后的版本」的阅读清单。

examples.en: Please use the revised version that I sent later for your comments on chapter two.
examples.zh: 对第二章提意见时，「请用后来发的修改版」。

collocations: please use the revised version below
please use the revised version for marking
please use the revised version of the handout

words.enDefinition: the displayed size of the on-screen pointer that you move with a mouse or trackpad

examples.en: I increased the pointer size so students could follow it from the back row.
examples.zh: 我调大了「鼠标指针大小」，让后排学生也能跟上指针的位置。

examples.en: The classroom computer had a different pointer size from the one in the library.
examples.zh: 教室电脑的「鼠标指针大小」与图书馆那台不同。

words.enDefinition: an interactive element that adds a question with options to content

examples.en: We added a poll sticker to ask which time worked best for rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我们加了个「投票贴纸」，问大家哪个排练时间最方便。

examples.en: I tapped the poll sticker and chose the second option.
examples.zh: 我点了「投票贴纸」，选了第二项。

collocations: answer a question on a poll sticker

words.enDefinition: a timer alternating periods of focused work and short breaks

examples.en: I tried a Pomodoro timer as I worked through my reading list.
examples.zh: 我按阅读清单读材料时，试用了「番茄钟计时器」。

examples.en: Our study group used a Pomodoro timer during the library session.
examples.zh: 我们学习小组在图书馆自习时用了「番茄钟计时器」。

words.enDefinition: a UK code used to keep a mobile number when switching providers

examples.en: The UK information sheet described how the Porting Authorisation Code related to keeping the same number.
examples.zh: 英国的说明单描述了「英国携号转网授权码」和保留原号码之间的关系。

examples.en: The provider's reply included my Porting Authorisation Code and the date it would expire.
examples.zh: 运营商的回复里有「英国携号转网授权码」和它的到期日。

words.enDefinition: a request for an existing telephone number to be moved to another provider

examples.en: The provider acknowledged my porting request before giving me an expected transfer date.
