examples.zh: 运营商受理了我的「携号转网申请」，随后告知预计转网日期。

examples.en: I checked whether my porting request was still pending in the account that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚，我在账户里查看了自己的「携号转网申请」是否还在处理。

words.enDefinition: an orientation in which the screen or content is taller than it is wide

examples.en: I chose portrait orientation when reading the long list of workshops on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上看那份很长的工作坊列表时，选了「纵向显示」。

examples.en: The form fit the screen properly in portrait orientation after the update that morning.
examples.zh: 当天早上更新后，表单在「纵向显示」时能正确适配屏幕了。

words.enDefinition: the people allowed to see a particular post

examples.en: I checked the post audience before sharing pictures from our study group.
examples.zh: 我在分享学习小组的照片前，核对了「帖子可见范围」。

examples.en: The post audience was smaller after I changed the setting to friends.
examples.zh: 我把设置改为好友后，「帖子可见范围」缩小了。

words.enDefinition: the screen used to prepare a new post before publishing

examples.en: I opened the post composer to write a short update for our club.
examples.zh: 我打开「发帖编辑器」，给社团写一条简短动态。

examples.en: The post composer showed the attached pictures below my text.
examples.zh: 「发帖编辑器」在文字下方显示了我附上的图片。

collocations: an option in the post composer

words.enDefinition: a view showing how content is expected to look when posted

examples.en: The post preview showed that my picture had been cropped too tightly.
examples.zh: 「帖子预览」显示，我的图片裁得太紧了。

examples.en: I opened the post preview before sharing the committee's update.
examples.zh: 分享委员会的动态前，我先打开了「帖子预览」。

collocations: an image in the post preview

words.enDefinition: a status showing a moderator is still checking the post

examples.en: The club page showed “Post under review” after I sent in my picture.
examples.zh: 我提交图片后，社团页面显示「帖子正在审核」。

examples.en: I noticed “Post under review” below the title of my announcement.
examples.zh: 我注意到公告标题下方显示「帖子正在审核」。

words.enDefinition: a device that changes the incoming electrical supply to one suitable for another device

examples.en: I borrowed a compatible power adapter from the library desk when my laptop ran low.
examples.zh: 笔记本快没电时，我从图书馆服务台借了一个兼容的「电源适配器」。

examples.en: The power adapter for the loan tablet was listed separately on the return form.
examples.zh: 归还表上单独列出了借用平板的「电源适配器」。

words.enDefinition: to turn the power to equipment completely off and then bring it back on

examples.en: The technician asked me to power cycle the display before the seminar started.
examples.zh: 研讨课开始前，技术员请我给显示器「完全断电后重新通电」。

examples.en: We waited for the projector to cool before asking whether to power cycle it.
examples.zh: 我们等投影仪冷却下来后，才问能不能「完全断电后重新通电」。

collocations: instructions to power cycle a device

words.enDefinition: the mobile technology a device is set to use when available

examples.en: I checked my preferred network type after noticing the phone stayed on an older network.
examples.zh: 我发现手机一直连着较旧的网络，就查了「首选网络类型」。

examples.en: The handset showed the preferred network type below the names of both mobile lines.
examples.zh: 手机在两条线路的名称下方显示了「首选网络类型」。

words.enDefinition: a paid service option offering features beyond a basic level

examples.en: I tried the premium plan because it included extra handwriting tools.
examples.zh: 我试了「高级套餐」，因为里面有额外的手写工具。

examples.en: The premium plan included more drawing templates than my current option.
examples.zh: 「高级套餐」包含的绘画模板比我现在的选项多。

words.enDefinition: an attempt to make a person respond before they have time to think or check

examples.en: The student guide described pressure to act quickly as one warning sign in suspicious requests.
examples.zh: 学生指南把「催促立即采取行动」列为可疑请求的一项警示信号。

examples.en: The helpline asked whether I felt pressure to act quickly during the call.
examples.zh: 热线人员问，通话时对方是否让我感到被「催促立即采取行动」。

collocations: respond to pressure to act quickly

words.enDefinition: A state of a file from before its most recent changes.

examples.en: The previous version still had the notes we took before shortening the introduction last week.
examples.zh: 「早期版本」还保留着我们上周缩短引言前记下的笔记。

examples.en: I found a previous version with all the figures from our original library survey intact.
examples.zh: 我找到一个「早期版本」，里面完整保留了我们最初做图书馆调查时的数据。

words.enDefinition: the main mobile line a person uses on a device with multiple lines

examples.en: I kept my work number as the primary line while studying near campus.
examples.zh: 在学校附近读书期间，我把工作号码设为「主要手机线路」。

examples.en: The phone showed a little icon beside the primary line in the settings menu.
examples.zh: 手机设置菜单里，「主要手机线路」旁显示了一个小图标。

words.enDefinition: an alert allowed to appear despite a mode limiting other notifications

examples.en: A priority notification reminded me about an upcoming tutorial during my focus session.
examples.zh: 专注时段里，一条「优先通知」提醒我辅导课快开始了。

examples.en: I saw a priority notification from the calendar while other banners were hidden.
examples.zh: 其他横幅都隐藏时，我看到了来自日历的一条「优先通知」。

words.enDefinition: a profile with some content limited to approved viewers

examples.en: I switched to a private profile for the pictures I shared with friends.
examples.zh: 我把主页设为「非公开主页」，只和朋友分享那些照片。

examples.en: The app said the photos belonged to a private profile.
examples.zh: 应用说，这些照片属于一个「非公开主页」。

words.enDefinition: the process of making authorised software features available for use

examples.en: The setup screen described product activation before the drawing software opened.
examples.zh: 绘画软件打开前，设置页面说明了「产品激活」。

examples.en: I saw a product activation message after opening my licensed study app.
examples.zh: 我打开有使用许可的学习应用后，看到了「产品激活」消息。

words.enDefinition: software for organising tasks, time or work

examples.en: I compared a few productivity apps before choosing one for my coursework.
examples.zh: 为了选一个做课程作业用的工具，我比较了几款「效率类应用」。

examples.en: The store displayed productivity apps next to tools for learning languages.
examples.zh: 商店把「效率类应用」显示在语言学习工具旁边。

words.enDefinition: a short description someone writes about themselves on a profile

examples.en: I added my course and interests to my profile bio last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚，我把专业和兴趣写进了「个人简介」。

examples.en: Her profile bio mentioned the student radio show she helps produce.
examples.zh: 她的「个人简介」提到了她参与制作的学生广播节目。

words.enDefinition: a grid of post previews shown on a profile

examples.en: I could find the painting easily in the club's profile grid.
examples.zh: 我在社团的「主页帖子网格」里很容易就找到了那幅画。

examples.en: The profile grid showed three columns of photos from the exhibition.
examples.zh: 「主页帖子网格」分三列展示了展览的照片。

words.enDefinition: the top area of a profile showing information such as name and images

examples.en: The profile header showed the club's name above its recent photos.
examples.zh: 「主页顶部区域」在近期照片上方显示了社团名称。

examples.en: I checked how the profile header looked on my smaller phone screen.
examples.zh: 我确认了「主页顶部区域」在小屏手机上的显示效果。

collocations: a name in the profile header

words.enDefinition: an address that opens a specific person's or group's profile

examples.en: I sent the profile link to my classmate after our project meeting.
examples.zh: 项目会议结束后，我把「个人主页链接」发给了同学。

examples.en: The profile link opened the club's page on my phone straight away.
examples.zh: 「个人主页链接」立刻在我的手机上打开了社团主页。

words.enDefinition: the screen showing a person's details and shared content

examples.en: I opened the club's profile page to find the rehearsal photos.
examples.zh: 我打开社团的「个人主页」，想找排练照片。

examples.en: My classmate checked her profile page before sharing it with our group.
examples.zh: 同学把自己的「个人主页」发给小组之前，先打开确认了一下。

words.enDefinition: a field for displaying the pronouns a person uses

examples.en: The pronouns field was visible beneath the text about my course.
examples.zh: 「人称代词栏」显示在我的专业介绍下方。

examples.en: My classmate left the pronouns field empty when she edited the profile.
examples.zh: 同学编辑主页时，把「人称代词栏」留空了。

words.enDefinition: to check a draft for errors before it is sent

examples.en: I try to proofread before sending when asking a professor to review my work.
examples.zh: 请教授看我的作业时，我会尽量「发送前校对」。

examples.en: There was just enough time to proofread before sending as the seminar began.
examples.zh: 研讨课刚开始，我只来得及「发送前校对」一下。

collocations: take a minute to proofread before sending

words.enDefinition: a suggested date for completing and handing in a piece of work

examples.en: My tutor asked for a proposed submission date before discussing the extension.
examples.zh: 导师想先知道「拟提交日期」，再谈延期的事。

examples.en: I included a proposed submission date in my email about the missed deadline.
examples.zh: 我在说明错过截止时间的邮件里写了一个「拟提交日期」。

words.enDefinition: a profile people can view without first being approved

examples.en: Our radio club kept a public profile so anyone could find it.
examples.zh: 我们广播社保留了「公开主页」，方便大家找到。

examples.en: I checked which details appeared on my public profile that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我确认了自己的「公开主页」显示了哪些资料。

collocations: a post on a public profile

words.enDefinition: to make prepared content available to its chosen viewers

examples.en: I wanted to publish a post about the new practice room that evening.
examples.zh: 我那天晚上想「发一条关于新练习室的帖子」。

examples.en: The app asked which page I wanted to publish a post on.
examples.zh: 应用问我想在哪个页面上「发布一条帖子」。

collocations: get ready to publish a post
publish a post on a profile

words.enDefinition: an option to make prepared content visible as soon as it is submitted

examples.en: I chose “Publish now” once everyone approved the photos in our update.
examples.zh: 大家都同意用这些照片后，我选了「立即发布」。

examples.en: The preview screen offered “Publish now” beside a button for choosing a date.
examples.zh: 预览页面把「立即发布」放在选择日期的按钮旁边。

words.enDefinition: to place your phone with its screen facing the surface

examples.en: You can put your phone face down so incoming messages don't catch your eye.
examples.zh: 可以「把手机屏幕朝下放」，这样新来的消息就不会引开视线。

examples.en: One person suggested we put your phone face down during the timed practice exam.
examples.zh: 有个同学建议，做限时模拟考试时「把手机屏幕朝下放」。

collocations: remember to put your phone face down
decide to put your phone face down
put your phone face down while studying

words.enDefinition: a message telling someone that a mail system has held suspected unsafe emails

examples.en: I received a quarantine notice while waiting for replies to the event invitations.
examples.zh: 我等活动邀请的回信时，收到了一则「邮件隔离通知」。

examples.en: The quarantine notice listed the subject lines of messages held for further checks.
examples.zh: 「邮件隔离通知」列出了需要进一步检查的邮件主题。

words.enDefinition: an email held separately after a system flags it for possible security concerns

examples.en: Campus IT reviewed a quarantined email that the student society had been expecting.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门审查了一封学生社团一直在等的「被隔离的邮件」。

examples.en: The digest listed one quarantined email from a guest speaker at our college.
examples.zh: 汇总通知列出了一封「被隔离的邮件」，发件人是我们学院的客座讲者。

words.enDefinition: a request for information about what to read or understand

examples.en: I put "Question about the reading" in the subject line before sending my email.
examples.zh: 我在邮件主题行写好「关于阅读材料的问题」，然后发送。

examples.en: The professor answered my question about the reading after the afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午的大课结束后，教授回答了我「关于阅读材料的问题」。

collocations: email a question about the reading
ask a question about the reading
have a question about the reading

words.zhGloss: 按轻重缓急排好的问题
words.enDefinition: questions listed from the most important to the least important
acceptedZhAnswers: 按轻重缓急排好的问题

examples.en: I listed my questions in order of priority so we could start with the deadline.
examples.zh: 我把「问题按轻重缓急排好了」，这样可以先谈截止日期。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to send questions in order of priority before the meeting.
examples.zh: 导师请我们见面前发去「按轻重缓急排好的问题」。

collocations: put questions in order of priority
list questions in order of priority
send questions in order of priority

words.enDefinition: a new post that embeds another post with your own text

examples.en: Her quote post added a note about which rehearsal was open.
examples.zh: 她在「带评语的引用转发」里说明了哪次排练对外开放。

examples.en: I read the quote post because it explained the picture's background.
examples.zh: 我看了那条「带评语的引用转发」，因为它解释了图片的来历。

words.enDefinition: text from an earlier email reproduced in a reply

examples.en: The quoted text below my reply showed what the tutor originally wrote.
examples.zh: 回复下面「引用的邮件原文」显示了导师最初的措辞。

examples.en: I looked at the quoted text to confirm the date of our meeting.
examples.zh: 我查看了「引用的邮件原文」，确认见面日期。

words.enDefinition: a mobile messaging standard supporting richer chat features than ordinary texts

examples.en: My phone showed RCS under messaging settings when I checked the new line.
examples.zh: 我查看新线路时，手机的消息设置下显示了「富通信消息服务」。

examples.en: The carrier explained which devices could use RCS with its service that term.
examples.zh: 运营商解释了该学期哪些设备可以在其网络上使用「富通信消息服务」。

words.enDefinition: to download again an app you obtained in an earlier purchase

examples.en: I used the store to re-download a purchased app for my new tablet.
examples.zh: 我通过商店给新平板「重新下载已购应用」。

examples.en: I checked how to re-download a purchased app from the account menu.
examples.zh: 我查了怎样从账号菜单「重新下载已购应用」。

collocations: choose to re-download a purchased app
be able to re-download a purchased app
re-download a purchased app on a new device

words.enDefinition: to review the earlier emails in a conversation

examples.en: I wanted to read back through the exchange before sending my supervisor the new timetable.
examples.zh: 把新课表发给导师前，我想「回看这串往来邮件」。

examples.en: You can read back through the exchange if you're unsure which draft the tutor meant.
examples.zh: 拿不准导师指哪份草稿，可以「回看这串往来邮件」。

collocations: take time to read back through the exchange
want to read back through the exchange
need to read back through the exchange

words.enDefinition: A file state that permits viewing and prevents changes to that copy.

examples.en: The sample contract opened in read-only mode when I checked it during our group workshop.
examples.zh: 我们小组做工作坊练习时，我打开样本合同查看，文件进入了「只读模式」。

examples.en: I left the minutes in read-only mode while checking the spelling of the speakers' names.
examples.zh: 我核对发言者姓名的拼写时，让会议记录保持在「只读模式」。

words.enDefinition: an indicator reporting that a recipient has opened a message

examples.en: A read receipt appeared after my classmate opened the message about our meeting.
examples.zh: 同学打开关于开会的那条消息后，显示了「已读回执」。

examples.en: My friend asked where the read receipt appeared beneath the message.
examples.zh: 朋友问「已读回执」会显示在消息下方的哪里。

collocations: a read receipt for a message

words.enDefinition: the sequence in which parts of a document or screen are read, including by assistive tools

examples.en: We checked the reading order of the handout after moving its diagram and captions.
examples.zh: 挪动讲义里的示意图和图注之后，我们检查了内容的「阅读顺序」。

examples.en: The reading order was clear even when the screen reader moved through the page aloud.
examples.zh: 即使用屏幕阅读器逐项朗读页面，「阅读顺序」也很清楚。

words.enDefinition: Editing in which changes become visible to collaborators as they are made.

examples.en: Real-time editing made it easier for us to rearrange the slides during the rehearsal.
examples.zh: 「实时编辑」让我们在排练时更容易调整幻灯片顺序。

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated real-time editing by changing a heading while we watched from our laptops.
examples.zh: 辅导老师改了一个标题，让我们在自己的笔记本电脑上观看「实时编辑」的效果。

words.enDefinition: recent actions or alerts that affect the security of an account

examples.en: I reviewed recent security activity before calling the helpdesk about my account settings.
examples.zh: 我先查看了「近期安全活动」，然后打电话向服务台咨询账户设置。

examples.en: The app lists recent security activity on the same page as your account settings.
examples.zh: 应用把「近期安全活动」列在账户设置所在的同一页。

words.enDefinition: bars on a device display indicating the relative strength of its mobile signal

examples.en: The reception bars dropped to one when I moved to the basement study room.
examples.zh: 我走到地下室的自习室时，「手机信号格」降到了一格。

examples.en: My phone showed more reception bars once the bus came out of the long tunnel.
examples.zh: 公交车一出长隧道，我的「手机信号格」就多了。

words.enDefinition: the email address of a person or group to whom a message is being sent

examples.en: I checked the recipient address against the one on the syllabus.
examples.zh: 我对照课程大纲核对了「收件人邮箱地址」。

examples.en: The recipient address was still blank after I drafted the whole message.
examples.zh: 我写完整封邮件草稿时，「收件人邮箱地址」还空着。

words.enDefinition: to connect a device again after a wireless connection ended or failed

examples.en: I had to reconnect to Wi-Fi after moving from the library to the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 我从图书馆走到阶梯教室后，不得不「重新连接无线网」。

examples.en: The tablet tried to reconnect to Wi-Fi when I opened its screen after lunch.
examples.zh: 我午饭后打开屏幕时，平板尝试「重新连接无线网」。

words.enDefinition: A copy kept or created to recover data when a working file becomes unavailable.

examples.en: I found a recovery copy of the field notes after the laptop closed during our lab.
examples.zh: 实验课上笔记本电脑关机后，我找到了现场笔记的「恢复副本」。

examples.en: The recovery copy contained the table we thought had disappeared before the last workshop ended.
examples.zh: 「恢复副本」里有那张表格，我们原以为它在上次工作坊结束前就丢了。

words.enDefinition: the available ways to regain access when you cannot sign in to an account

examples.en: I checked my recovery options before changing the phone number linked to my account.
examples.zh: 更换账户绑定的电话号码前，我查看了「账户找回选项」。

examples.en: The account page listed two recovery options at the end of the security checklist.
examples.zh: 账户安全检查清单的最后列出了两种「账户找回选项」。

words.zhGloss: 用于找回账户的手机号码
words.enDefinition: a phone number registered as a way to regain access to your account
acceptedZhAnswers: 用于找回账户的手机号码

examples.en: I changed my recovery phone number after switching from an overseas mobile plan.
examples.zh: 我停用原来的海外手机套餐后，更改了「用于找回账户的手机号码」。

examples.en: The portal asked me to check that my recovery phone number still worked.
examples.zh: 门户请我确认「用于找回账户的手机号码」还能用。

words.enDefinition: The place in some systems where deleted items are held before final removal.

examples.en: The file was still in the recycle bin when I noticed it missing from our folder.
examples.zh: 我发现文件在我们文件夹里不见了时，它还在「回收站」。

examples.en: My classmate looked in the recycle bin for a spreadsheet she had deleted earlier that morning.
examples.zh: 同学在「回收站」里找当天早些时候删掉的电子表格。

collocations: find a document in the recycle bin

words.enDefinition: to make interface elements less see-through so their contents stand out more clearly

examples.en: Turning on Reduce Transparency made the text over my wallpaper easier to read.
examples.zh: 打开「降低透明度」后，壁纸上面的文字更容易读清了。

examples.en: I selected Reduce Transparency while testing the menu on the seminar room's computer.
examples.zh: 我在研讨室电脑上测试菜单时，选了「降低透明度」。

words.enDefinition: an accessibility option that reduces the intensity of bright colours on the display

examples.en: I tried Reduce White Point because bright areas of the reading app were distracting.
examples.zh: 阅读应用里亮的地方让我分心，我试了「降低白点值」。

examples.en: The guide showed where to adjust Reduce White Point on the tablet during setup.
examples.zh: 指南说明了设置平板时去哪里调「降低白点值」。

words.enDefinition: a lower rate for transferring mobile data than the usual service rate

examples.en: The note mentioned reduced data speed after the included monthly allowance had been used.
examples.zh: 说明写着套餐内月流量用完后，会对「移动网络降速」。

examples.en: I noticed the reduced data speed while loading slides from home that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午在家加载幻灯片时，我注意到了「移动网络降速」。

collocations: reduced data speed for the remainder of the month

words.enDefinition: to look at an attached file for more information

examples.en: Please refer to the attachment for the updated sequence of readings and discussion topics.
examples.zh: 更新后的阅读和讨论顺序「请参见附件」。

examples.en: The lecturer asked us to refer to the attachment before emailing about the timetable.
examples.zh: 老师让我们写邮件问课表前先「参见附件」。

collocations: refer to the attachment for details
ask students to refer to the attachment

words.enDefinition: the number of times per second a display can update its image

examples.en: I checked the refresh rate after a video looked uneven on the borrowed monitor.
examples.zh: 视频在借来的显示器上播放得不流畅，我查看了「屏幕刷新率」。

examples.en: The settings page shows the current refresh rate beside the name of the monitor.
examples.zh: 设置页在显示器名称旁边列出了当前「屏幕刷新率」。

words.enDefinition: a device that forms changing patterns of raised dots to display digital text in braille

examples.en: She used a refreshable braille display to read the list of assignments before class.
examples.zh: 她上课前用「可刷新盲文显示器」读了作业清单。

examples.en: The new refreshable braille display connected to the tablet we used for the demonstration.
examples.zh: 新的「可刷新盲文显示器」连上了我们演示用的平板。

collocations: read on a refreshable braille display

words.enDefinition: information about where an app or feature is offered

examples.en: I checked the regional availability of the app before our exchange term.
examples.zh: 交换学期前，我查了这款应用「在各地区的提供情况」。

examples.en: The store listed regional availability separately from the languages the app included.
examples.zh: 商店把「各地区的提供情况」和应用支持的语言分开列出。

words.enDefinition: To turn down a proposed change and leave it out of the main document.

examples.en: I had to reject a suggestion because it accidentally changed the meaning of the original quotation.
examples.zh: 那条建议无意中改了原引文的意思，我不得不「拒绝这条修订建议」。

examples.en: If you reject a suggestion about my paragraph, could you tell me your reason in a comment?
examples.zh: 如果你对我写的段落「拒绝了一条修订建议」，能在批注里告诉我理由吗？

collocations: reject a suggestion with an explanation
reject a suggestion from a reviewer

words.enDefinition: a written summary of the changes in a software release

examples.en: I read the release notes to see where the drawing tools had moved.
examples.zh: 我看了「版本更新说明」，想知道绘画工具移到了哪里。

examples.en: The release notes listed the new templates for the study planner.
examples.zh: 「版本更新说明」列出了学习计划工具新增的模板。

collocations: changes listed in the release notes

words.enDefinition: the amount of time still available under an application's limit

examples.en: I checked my remaining app time before starting another video on the tablet.
examples.zh: 在平板上打开另一段视频前，我查看了「应用剩余使用时间」。

examples.en: The report showed remaining app time alongside my use of other apps.
examples.zh: 报告列出了「应用剩余使用时间」，也有其他应用的使用情况。

words.enDefinition: to delete a comment you posted or have permission to manage

examples.en: I asked the club admin how to remove a comment I had duplicated.
examples.zh: 我问社团管理员，怎样「移除自己重复发出的那条评论」。

examples.en: The organiser chose to remove a comment that repeated an older meeting time.
examples.zh: 组织者选择「移除那条还在重复旧会面时间的评论」。

collocations: be allowed to remove a comment
an option to remove a comment

words.enDefinition: to take someone off the list of accounts following you

examples.en: I found an option to remove a follower from my private profile.
examples.zh: 我在非公开主页上找到了「移除一位关注者」的选项。

examples.en: My friend asked what happens when you remove a follower from the list.
examples.zh: 朋友问，把「一位关注者从列表里移除」后会怎样。

collocations: an option to remove a follower
decide whether to remove a follower

words.enDefinition: To take away a person's permission to open or use a shared item.

examples.en: The course facilitator used “Remove access” after the guest review session had ended that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，外部评阅活动结束后，课程负责人使用了「移除访问权限」。

examples.en: The option to remove access appeared beside each collaborator's name in the group project settings.
examples.zh: 小组项目设置里，每位协作者的姓名旁都有「移除访问权限」的选项。

words.enDefinition: To change a file's name while keeping it as the same file.

examples.en: Our tutor asked me to rename a file so its title would include our workshop date.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我「重命名文件」，好让标题能包含工作坊的日期。

examples.en: Do I need to rename a file if our group decides to change its presentation title?
examples.zh: 如果小组决定改演示标题，我需要「重命名文件」吗？

collocations: rename a file in the folder

words.enDefinition: To make a resolved comment active again so discussion can continue.

examples.en: I had to reopen a comment when the revised graph raised the same question again.
examples.zh: 修改后的图表又引出了同一个问题，我只好「重新开启批注」。

examples.en: Could you reopen a comment about the appendix so we can finish that discussion tonight?
examples.zh: 你能「重新打开关于附录的那条批注」吗？这样我们今晚就能把那件事谈完。

words.enDefinition: an instruction to type your response above a marked separator

examples.en: The department's automated email said "Reply above this line" under its welcome message.
examples.zh: 系里的自动邮件在欢迎语下面写着「请在此线上方回复」。

examples.en: I noticed "Reply above this line" just before typing my question about the timetable.
examples.zh: 我正要输入课表问题时，注意到了「请在此线上方回复」。

collocations: message saying reply above this line
notice reading reply above this line
footer marked reply above this line

words.enDefinition: to place answers beside the corresponding points in the original message

examples.en: My lecturer chose to reply inline so each answer had some context.
examples.zh: 老师选择「在原文相应位置回复」，让每个答复都有上下文。

examples.en: You can reply inline to the numbered questions in my email.
examples.zh: 你可以对邮件里编号的问题「在原文相应位置回复」。

words.enDefinition: To respond to a note by adding a message in the same discussion.

examples.en: I can reply to a comment in the draft instead of starting another email chain.
examples.zh: 我可以直接在草稿里「回复批注」，不用另开一串邮件。

examples.en: Please reply to a comment about the survey if you know where the figures came from.
examples.zh: 如果你知道这些数字的来源，请「回复那条关于调查的批注」。

collocations: reply to a comment in context

words.enDefinition: to link your response to one particular message in a chat

examples.en: I chose to reply to a specific message so everyone knew which date I meant.
examples.zh: 我选择「回复指定消息」，让大家知道我指的是哪个日期。

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to reply to a specific message in the group.
examples.zh: 室友教我怎样在群里「回复指定消息」。

collocations: choose to reply to a specific message
let users reply to a specific message
reply to a specific message in a group

words.enDefinition: to send a response from the screen showing someone's story

examples.en: I chose to reply to a story after seeing my friend's sketch.
examples.zh: 看到朋友的速写后，我选择「回复一条限时动态」。

examples.en: My classmate showed me where to reply to a story on her phone.
examples.zh: 同学指给我看，在她手机上可以在哪里「回复一条限时动态」。

collocations: choose to reply to a story
an option to reply to a story
reply to a story with a message

words.enDefinition: to tell an authority, platform or support service about an attempted or completed scam

examples.en: I asked student services how to report a scam involving a fake scholarship message.
examples.zh: 我向学生服务处询问如何「举报诈骗」，事情涉及一条虚假的奖学金通知。

examples.en: The consumer agency's help page explained where students could report a scam.
examples.zh: 消费者机构的帮助页面说明了学生可以去哪里「举报诈骗」。

collocations: report a scam to the platform
learn where to report a scam

words.enDefinition: to notify a service or organisation about a suspected phishing message or site

examples.en: Use the campus help page to report phishing if you suspect a message is fraudulent.
examples.zh: 如果怀疑一条消息有诈，可以用校园帮助页面「举报网络钓鱼」。

examples.en: The tutor showed us where to report phishing in our university email service.
examples.zh: 导师给我们看了在校邮箱服务的什么位置可以「举报网络钓鱼」。

collocations: use the button to report phishing

words.enDefinition: to tell a service or its support team about actions you do not recognise

examples.en: I used the official support page to report unusual activity on my student account.
examples.zh: 我通过官方支持页面「报告异常活动」，涉及我的学生账户。

examples.en: The helpdesk explained where students should report unusual activity if they cannot sign in.
examples.zh: 服务台解释了学生无法登录时应该去哪里「报告异常活动」。

collocations: learn how to report unusual activity

words.enDefinition: a designated place or method for sending a report about a concern

examples.en: The university has a dedicated reporting channel for suspicious messages in student email.
examples.zh: 学校有专门的「举报渠道」，处理学生邮箱收到的可疑消息。

examples.en: We checked which reporting channel the platform recommends for concerns about account impersonation.
examples.zh: 我们查了平台建议通过哪个「举报渠道」反映账号冒充的问题。

words.enDefinition: a notice confirming that a service has received a report

examples.en: I saved the reporting confirmation because it included the reference for my submission.
examples.zh: 我保存了「举报提交确认」，因为里面有这次提交的编号。

examples.en: The reporting confirmation appeared on screen as soon as I submitted the form.
examples.zh: 我一提交表格，屏幕上就显示了「举报提交确认」。

words.enDefinition: to share someone else's post again with your own viewers

examples.en: I asked the craft group whether I could repost its workshop announcement.
examples.zh: 我问手作小组，能不能「转发他们的工作坊公告」。

examples.en: My classmate chose to repost the club's invitation for her study group.
examples.zh: 同学选择「转发社团发的邀请帖」给学习小组看。

words.enDefinition: to make a reported problem happen again so that it can be observed or investigated

examples.en: The support adviser asked whether I could reproduce the issue on another tablet.
examples.zh: 支持人员问，我能否在另一台平板上「复现问题」。

examples.en: I could only reproduce the issue when the laptop was connected to the projector.
examples.zh: 只有笔记本连上投影仪时，我才能「复现问题」。

collocations: be able to reproduce the issue

words.enDefinition: To ask the person responsible for a file or folder for permission to open it.

examples.en: I clicked “Request access” when I couldn't open the worksheet from my seminar group.
examples.zh: 打不开研讨小组的练习表时，我点了「请求访问权限」。

examples.en: My classmate needed to request access before she could read the group's background notes.
examples.zh: 同学需要先「请求访问权限」，才能看小组的背景笔记。

words.enDefinition: a message or question asking someone to provide identifying personal details

examples.en: I checked with the registrar about an unexpected request for personal information in my inbox.
examples.zh: 收件箱里有条意外的「索要个人信息的请求」，我向教务处核实了。

examples.en: The bank said the request for personal information had not come from its support team.
examples.zh: 银行说，那项「索要个人信息的请求」并非其支持团队发出的。

collocations: receive a request for personal information
verify a request for personal information
review a request for personal information

words.enDefinition: the amount of room an app needs for installation

examples.en: I checked the required storage space before choosing the drawing software.
examples.zh: 选择绘画软件前，我查了「所需存储空间」。

examples.en: The required storage space was listed below the operating system version.
examples.zh: 「所需存储空间」列在操作系统版本下方。

words.enDefinition: to send the same document again in PDF format

examples.en: Could you resend it as a PDF so the tables keep their original layout?
examples.zh: 能「用 PDF 格式重发」吗？这样表格能保持原来的排版。

examples.en: The instructor asked me to resend it as a PDF before our meeting began.
examples.zh: 老师请我在见面前「用 PDF 格式重发」。

collocations: ask someone to resend it as a PDF
please resend it as a PDF
offer to resend it as a PDF

words.enDefinition: to send a message again using the right email address

examples.en: I had to resend to the correct address after noticing a spelling error in the directory.
examples.zh: 发现通讯录里有个拼写错误后，我只得「重发到正确的地址」。

examples.en: The tutor asked me to resend to the correct address before her next class began.
examples.zh: 导师请我在她下一节课开始前「重发到正确的地址」。

collocations: need to resend to the correct address
offer to resend to the correct address
ask someone to resend to the correct address

words.enDefinition: to turn the device off and start it again as part of normal operation

examples.en: I saved my notes before I chose to restart the device between classes.
examples.zh: 我在课间选择「重启设备」前，先保存了笔记。

examples.en: The instructions suggested that we restart the device after changing the sound settings.
examples.zh: 操作说明建议我们更改声音设置后「重启设备」。

collocations: save your work before you restart the device

words.enDefinition: a message asking for a restart so an update can finish

examples.en: The laptop displayed “Restart to finish update” after I closed the app.
examples.zh: 关闭应用后，笔记本电脑显示「重启以完成更新」。

examples.en: I noticed “Restart to finish update” below the list of installed changes.
examples.zh: 我在已安装的变更列表下方看到了「重启以完成更新」。

collocations: a message saying “Restart to finish update”
prompt users to “Restart to finish update”

words.enDefinition: To make an earlier state of a file its current version again.

examples.en: Our group decided to restore a previous version after we discovered a missing source table.
examples.zh: 发现少了一张列出资料来源的表格后，我们小组决定「恢复旧版本」。

examples.en: I asked whether we should restore a previous version before changing the introduction a second time.
examples.zh: 我问是否应该先「恢复旧版本」，再第二次修改引言。

collocations: restore a previous version from history
restore a previous version of a document
choose to restore a previous version

words.enDefinition: to make a previously archived post visible on your profile again

examples.en: I chose to restore an archived post for our end-of-year photo display.
examples.zh: 为了年末的照片展示，我选择「恢复已归档的帖子」。

examples.en: My classmate asked where to restore an archived post on the club profile.
examples.zh: 同学问，在社团主页哪里可以「恢复已归档的帖子」。

collocations: choose to restore an archived post
an option to restore an archived post
decide whether to restore an archived post

words.enDefinition: to return selected settings to their original values

examples.en: I chose “Restore defaults” for the display options on my planner.
examples.zh: 我给计划工具的显示选项用了「恢复默认设置」。

examples.en: The help page described “Restore defaults” on the language settings screen.
examples.zh: 帮助页面介绍了语言设置页面上的「恢复默认设置」。

words.enDefinition: To return a deleted item from a service's trash to the files you can use.

examples.en: Our tutor chose Restore from trash when the sample data disappeared from the workshop folder.
examples.zh: 示例数据从工作坊文件夹消失后，辅导老师选择了「从回收站恢复」。

examples.en: The Restore from trash option was available for the worksheet we misplaced during the class demo.
examples.zh: 课堂演示时弄丢的那份工作表还有「从回收站恢复」选项。

collocations: restore from trash in the file menu

words.enDefinition: to restore access to eligible purchases already associated with an app store account

examples.en: I used “Restore purchases” after opening the app on my new tablet.
examples.zh: 我在新平板上打开应用后，用了「恢复已购项目」。

examples.en: The account menu showed “Restore purchases” beneath the app's add-ons.
examples.zh: 账户菜单在应用附加功能的下方显示了「恢复已购项目」。

words.enDefinition: to limit which people are allowed to respond to a post

examples.en: I chose to restrict replies to the members who followed the group.
examples.zh: 我选择「限制谁可以回复」，只有关注本组的成员可以回复。

examples.en: The club could restrict replies when posting practice notes for its members.
examples.zh: 社团发布成员练习记录时，可以「限制谁可以回复」。

words.zhGloss: 仅授权用户可用的链接
words.enDefinition: A sharing link limited to the recipients or group selected by the person sharing it.
acceptedZhAnswers: 仅授权用户可用的链接

examples.en: The tutor sent a restricted link for the feedback addressed to our project group.
examples.zh: 导师用「仅授权用户可用的链接」发来专门给我们项目组的反馈。

examples.en: My classmate labeled the restricted link so we could distinguish it from the public reading list.
examples.zh: 同学标记了「仅授权用户可用的链接」，让我们能把它和公开阅读清单区分开。

collocations: a restricted link to the folder

words.enDefinition: to start using an app again after it was paused

examples.en: I could resume app use when my timed study period had ended.
examples.zh: 计时学习时段结束后，我可以「恢复使用应用」。

examples.en: My phone showed when I could resume app use after the quiz ended.
examples.zh: 小测结束后，手机显示了我什么时候能「恢复使用应用」。

words.enDefinition: to continue a timed period of focus after pausing it

examples.en: I tapped to resume the focus session after answering the door of our study room.
examples.zh: 我去开了自习室门，回来后点了「继续专注时段」。

examples.en: The app asked if I wanted to resume the focus session after the break.
examples.zh: 休息结束后，应用问我是否想「继续专注时段」。

collocations: choose to resume the focus session
tap to resume the focus session
want to resume the focus session

words.enDefinition: To continue an upload that was interrupted or paused.

examples.en: I was able to resume the upload when my laptop reconnected to Wi-Fi in the library.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑在图书馆重新连上 Wi-Fi 后，我得以「继续上传」。

examples.en: The student handbook showed a button to resume the upload of an interrupted recording in the demo.
examples.zh: 学生手册用演示说明了如何用按钮「继续上传」中断的录音。

collocations: resume the upload after a pause

words.enDefinition: To attempt the same upload again after it did not complete successfully.

examples.en: I chose to retry the upload once the connection recovered and showed my partner the result.
examples.zh: 网络恢复后，我选择了「重试上传」，并把结果给搭档看了。

examples.en: The portal asked me to retry the upload because the draft had not reached our group folder.
examples.zh: 草稿没有传到小组文件夹，门户提示我「重试上传」。

collocations: retry the upload once the connection returns

words.enDefinition: to examine the recent actions or sign-ins recorded for an account

examples.en: I wanted to review account activity before calling the university helpdesk about the alert.
examples.zh: 我想先「查看账户活动」，再打电话向学校服务台咨询提醒的事。

examples.en: The student handbook shows how to review account activity from the profile settings page.
examples.zh: 学生手册介绍了如何从个人资料设置页「查看账户活动」。

collocations: learn how to review account activity
review account activity after an alert

words.enDefinition: A number identifying a revision of a file or document.

examples.en: The revision number on the diagram helped us identify which version the workshop leader had printed.
examples.zh: 图上的「修订编号」让我们知道工作坊负责人打印的是哪个版本。

examples.en: Our tutor wrote the revision number on the feedback form so we could find the right document.
examples.zh: 辅导老师在反馈表上写了「修订编号」，方便我们找到对应的文档。

words.enDefinition: the loudness of the sound made when a call arrives

examples.en: I checked the ringer volume as I walked toward the study room.
examples.zh: 走向自习室的时候，我查看了「来电铃声音量」。

examples.en: The ringer volume was still high after I lowered the music volume.
examples.zh: 我把音乐音量调低了，「来电铃声音量」还是很高。

words.enDefinition: a fee for using a mobile device through another provider's network away from home

examples.en: The bill showed a roaming charge beside the calls I made during the trip.
examples.zh: 账单在我旅行中打的电话旁边列了一笔「漫游费用」。

examples.en: I asked why a roaming charge appeared when I thought the destination was included.
examples.zh: 我以为目的地包含在套餐里，就问为什么会出现「漫游费用」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary package giving specified mobile service away from the user's usual network

examples.en: I bought a roaming pass before the weekend conference in the neighbouring country.
examples.zh: 我在去邻国参加周末会议前买了「漫游短期套餐」。

examples.en: The account showed when the roaming pass would stop working during my trip.
examples.zh: 账户显示了旅行期间「漫游短期套餐」何时会失效。

words.enDefinition: a geographical group of places treated alike under a provider's roaming arrangements

examples.en: The provider showed a different roaming zone for the two countries on my itinerary.
examples.zh: 运营商显示，我行程里的两个国家分属不同的「漫游计费区」。

examples.en: I checked which roaming zone included the place we were visiting for the conference.
examples.zh: 我查了开会要去的地方属于哪个「漫游计费区」。

words.enDefinition: a call made by an automated system that typically plays a recorded message

examples.en: The library uses a robocall to remind borrowers when requested books are ready.
examples.zh: 图书馆用「自动拨号语音电话」提醒读者预约的书已经可以领取。

examples.en: I received a robocall about the closure while walking to the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我走去公交站时接到一通「自动拨号语音电话」，告知暂停开放。

words.enDefinition: a scam in which someone exploits a supposed romantic relationship to obtain money or information

examples.en: The student newspaper covered a romance scam without naming the people who were affected.
examples.zh: 校报报道了一起「假借恋爱关系诈骗」，省去了受影响人士的姓名。

examples.en: She contacted student support after a friend raised concerns about a possible romance scam.
examples.zh: 朋友提醒她可能遇上「假借恋爱关系诈骗」后，她联系了学生支持部门。

collocations: the signs of a romance scam

words.enDefinition: a setting that keeps the screen orientation fixed when the device turns

examples.en: I turned on rotation lock so the readings would stay upright on the bus.
examples.zh: 我开启了「旋转锁定」，这样在公交车上阅读时页面能保持竖向。

examples.en: The help button explains where to find rotation lock if the display will not turn.
examples.zh: 如果屏幕转不过来，帮助按钮会提示去哪里找「旋转锁定」。

words.enDefinition: a light on a router showing its current condition or activity

examples.en: I could see the router indicator light from my desk on the opposite wall.
examples.zh: 我从对面墙边的桌子能看见「路由器状态灯」。

examples.en: The help page explained what each colour of the router indicator light meant.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了「路由器状态灯」每一种颜色分别表示什么。

collocations: colour of the router indicator light

words.expression: save a copy of the message
words.lemma: save a copy of the message
words.enDefinition: to keep a separate copy of a message for later reference
acceptedEnVariants: save a copy of the message

examples.en: The adviser asked me to save a copy of the message for our appointment.
examples.zh: 顾问请我「保存一份消息副本」，见面时好查阅。

examples.en: I chose to save a copy of the message before clearing out my mailbox.
examples.zh: 清理邮箱之前，我决定先「保存一份消息副本」。

collocations: save a copy of the message for reference
need to save a copy of the message
remember to save a copy of the message

words.enDefinition: To save an updated form of an existing file as a new version of that file.

examples.en: Our project leader decided to save a new version when we corrected the mislabeled axes.
examples.zh: 我们改正坐标轴标签后，项目组长决定「保存为新版本」。

examples.en: Please save a new version of the poster before sending us a link to review it.
examples.zh: 发链接给我们审阅前，请先把海报「保存为新版本」。

collocations: save a new version after editing
save a new version of the document

words.enDefinition: to keep chosen settings for later use

examples.en: I used “Save preferences” after changing the planner's date display.
examples.zh: 改好计划工具里的日期显示后，我用了「保存偏好设置」。

examples.en: The window showed “Save preferences” at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 窗口页面底部显示了「保存偏好设置」。

words.enDefinition: To store a file on the phone, tablet, or computer you are using.

examples.en: The Save to device option let me keep the diagram on my phone for class.
examples.zh: 我用「保存到设备」把示意图保存在手机上课用。

examples.en: I tapped Save to device after finding the updated reading list in our class folder.
examples.zh: 在班级文件夹找到更新后的阅读清单后，我点了「保存到设备」。

words.enDefinition: a named group of posts saved together

examples.en: I added the sketching post to my saved collection of drawing ideas.
examples.zh: 我把这条速写帖子加进了我的绘画灵感「收藏合集」。

examples.en: The saved collection helped me find the club's older tutorials again.
examples.zh: 「收藏合集」帮我重新找到了社团以前的教程。

collocations: add a post to a saved collection

words.enDefinition: a network whose connection information is stored on a device for later use

examples.en: The phone recognized the saved network when I returned to the same study room.
examples.zh: 我回到同一间自习室时，手机认出了「已保存的网络」。

examples.en: I checked the name of the saved network before deleting it from the list.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「已保存的网络」的名称，再把它从列表移除。

words.enDefinition: a list of posts you have bookmarked

examples.en: I opened saved posts to find yesterday's recipe from the cooking club.
examples.zh: 我打开「已收藏的帖子」，找烹饪社昨天发的菜谱。

examples.en: The picture was in saved posts under the event's original caption.
examples.zh: 那张图在「已收藏的帖子」里，保留了活动原来的配文。

words.enDefinition: a warning that informs people about a suspected or known scam

examples.en: A scam alert from the university appeared on the student portal that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，学生门户网站上出现了学校发来的「诈骗提醒」。

examples.en: The bank's scam alert included examples of messages customers had already reported to it.
examples.zh: 银行的「诈骗提醒」列举了客户已经举报过的一些消息。

words.enDefinition: a phone call intended to trick the recipient into paying money or revealing information

examples.en: I ended the scam call and contacted the office using its published number.
examples.zh: 我挂断「诈骗电话」，按公开号码联系了办公室。

examples.en: The resident adviser asked whether anyone else had received the same scam call that morning.
examples.zh: 宿舍辅导员问，当天上午还有没有别人接到同样的「诈骗电话」。

collocations: hang up on a scam call

words.enDefinition: an online or paper form used to submit details about a scam

examples.en: I opened the scam reporting form from the consumer agency's main help page.
examples.zh: 我从消费者机构的帮助首页打开了「诈骗举报表」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me find the scam reporting form after our morning meeting.
examples.zh: 早上的会面结束后，顾问帮我找到了「诈骗举报表」。

words.enDefinition: to arrange for a post to appear at a later time

examples.en: We decided to schedule a post for the morning before the club fair.
examples.zh: 我们决定在社团展前的早上「定时发布帖子」。

examples.en: I used the app to schedule a post while drafting the next one.
examples.zh: 我用应用「定时发布帖子」，同时准备下一条的草稿。

collocations: an option to schedule a post

words.enDefinition: to arrange for Do Not Disturb to start at certain times

examples.en: I decided to schedule Do Not Disturb on the days I have early lectures.
examples.zh: 我决定在有早课的那些日子「定时开启勿扰」。

examples.en: Can you schedule Do Not Disturb for different times on weekdays and at weekends?
examples.zh: 能不能分别给工作日和周末安排不同时间，「定时开启勿扰」？

collocations: choose to schedule Do Not Disturb
want to schedule Do Not Disturb

words.enDefinition: a recurring period during which the device restricts access to selected apps

examples.en: My iPhone began scheduled downtime while I was reading a printed chapter.
examples.zh: 我看纸质教材时，iPhone 进入了「定时停用时段」。

examples.en: I set scheduled downtime for the evenings before our early lab sessions.
examples.zh: 每次要上早间实验课的前一晚，我都开启了「定时停用时段」。

words.enDefinition: the day arranged for an existing number to move to a new service provider

examples.en: The message listed my scheduled port date as the first Friday of the summer term.
examples.zh: 消息把我的「计划号码转网日期」定在夏季学期第一个周五。

examples.en: I wrote the scheduled port date in my calendar before starting the new course.
examples.zh: 开始新课程前，我把「计划号码转网日期」记到了日历里。

words.enDefinition: a setting that bundles selected notifications for delivery at chosen times

examples.en: I read the scheduled summary from several apps after my afternoon seminar.
examples.zh: 下午研讨课后，我读到了来自几个应用的「定时通知摘要」。

examples.en: The scheduled summary arrived while I was walking out of the library.
examples.zh: 我走出图书馆时，收到了「定时通知摘要」。

collocations: add apps to a scheduled summary

words.enDefinition: a dishonest scheme claiming to offer scholarship money or help applying for it

examples.en: The financial aid office discussed a scholarship scam during our first orientation session.
examples.zh: 助学办公室在第一次迎新会上讲到了一起「奖学金诈骗」。

examples.en: Campus IT flagged the message as a scholarship scam after hearing from several students.
examples.zh: 收到几名学生的反馈后，校园 IT 部门把该消息标为「奖学金诈骗」。

words.enDefinition: an alert signalled by a brief change in screen brightness or colour

examples.en: I saw a screen flash before checking the change to my timetable.
examples.zh: 查看课表变更前，我看到了「屏幕闪光提醒」。

examples.en: The tablet used screen flash as its visual signal during the test.
examples.zh: 测试时，平板用「屏幕闪光提醒」作为视觉信号。

words.enDefinition: rapid repeated changes in the brightness or stability of a displayed image

examples.en: The lab assistant noticed the screen flicker before the first student started presenting.
examples.zh: 第一位学生开始演示前，机房助理注意到了「屏幕闪烁」。

examples.en: I reported screen flicker on the library computer after it happened twice that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午图书馆电脑出现两次「屏幕闪烁」后，我报了修。

words.enDefinition: a period deliberately spent away from phones or other screens

examples.en: I set aside screen-free time to read on paper after dinner.
examples.zh: 我晚饭后安排了「不看屏幕的时间」，读纸质书。

examples.en: We had some screen-free time while walking to the study centre.
examples.zh: 我们走去学习中心的路上，有一小段「不看屏幕的时间」。

words.enDefinition: a feature that prevents use of a device until the user unlocks it

examples.en: I enabled the screen lock before starting to take my phone to group rehearsals.
examples.zh: 开始带手机去集体排练前，我先启用了「屏幕锁」。

examples.en: My screen lock turned on automatically while I was taking notes in the seminar.
examples.zh: 我在研讨课上记笔记时，手机的「屏幕锁」自动开启了。

words.enDefinition: a tool that enlarges all or part of what appears on a screen

examples.en: The screen magnifier made the small labels in the timetable easier to read.
examples.zh: 「屏幕放大镜」让我更容易看清时间表上的小字。

examples.en: I used a screen magnifier to check the notes in the margin carefully.
examples.zh: 我用「屏幕放大镜」仔细查看页边的笔记。

words.enDefinition: software that presents digital text and interface elements through speech or braille

examples.en: The library website works with a screen reader when I look up books for class.
examples.zh: 我查上课要用的书时，可以用「屏幕阅读器」浏览图书馆网站。

examples.en: We used a screen reader to check the labels on the society's signup form.
examples.zh: 我们用「屏幕阅读器」检查社团报名表上的标签。

words.enDefinition: a touch action that operates a screen reader or moves between elements it announces

examples.en: I learned a screen reader gesture to move to the next heading on the page.
examples.zh: 我学了一个「屏幕阅读器手势」，可以跳到页面中的下一个标题。

examples.en: The guide describes a screen reader gesture that reads from the top of the screen.
examples.zh: 指南介绍了一种「屏幕阅读器手势」，可以从屏幕顶端开始朗读。

words.enDefinition: a change in the way content is oriented on a screen as the device turns

examples.en: My tablet's screen rotation made the map easier to view when I held it sideways.
examples.zh: 我横着拿平板时，「屏幕旋转」让地图更容易看。

examples.en: The drawing app supports screen rotation, so we could work in either position.
examples.zh: 绘图应用支持「屏幕旋转」，所以我们横着竖着都能画。

words.zhGloss: 按类别统计的屏幕时长
words.enDefinition: device use time grouped by what kind of app was used
acceptedZhAnswers: 按类别统计的屏幕时长

examples.en: I compared screen time by category to see how much was course related.
examples.zh: 我对比了「按类别统计的屏幕时长」，看有多少和课程有关。

examples.en: The report displayed screen time by category, including games and reference tools.
examples.zh: 报告显示了「按类别统计的屏幕时长」，包括游戏和参考工具。

words.zhGloss: 按设备统计的屏幕时长
words.enDefinition: the amount of screen use measured separately for each device
acceptedZhAnswers: 按设备统计的屏幕时长

examples.en: I checked screen time by device to separate my tablet use from my phone use.
examples.zh: 我查看了「按设备统计的屏幕时长」，把平板和手机的使用分开看。

examples.en: The report could show screen time by device, which helped during our online term.
examples.zh: 报告能显示「按设备统计的屏幕时长」，上网课的那个学期用得上。

words.enDefinition: a report on how much you used devices and apps

examples.en: My screen time report showed more reading time than I had expected.
examples.zh: 我的「屏幕使用时间报告」显示，阅读时间比我预想的长。

examples.en: I checked the screen time report before planning my next study week.
examples.zh: 安排下一周的学习前，我查看了「屏幕使用时间报告」。

words.enDefinition: the measuring and recording of time spent using a device

examples.en: I tried screen time tracking during the first week of my course.
examples.zh: 课程第一周，我试用了「屏幕时长统计」。

examples.en: The tablet had no old reports because screen time tracking was off.
examples.zh: 平板没有以前的报告，因为「屏幕时长统计」没开。

words.enDefinition: the time a device waits without input before turning off its display

examples.en: I changed the screen timeout so the recipe would stay visible while I cooked.
examples.zh: 我修改了「屏幕熄灭等待时间」，这样做饭时菜谱不会很快消失。

examples.en: The screen timeout was too short while we used the tablet to read music.
examples.zh: 我们在平板上看乐谱时，「屏幕熄灭等待时间」太短了。

words.enDefinition: to look for particular words or items within one conversation

examples.en: I wanted to search within a chat for the name of the café.
examples.zh: 我想「在聊天内搜索」那家咖啡馆的名字。

examples.en: The app let me search within a chat instead of checking every conversation.
examples.zh: 应用让我能「在聊天内搜索」，省去了查看每个会话的麻烦。

collocations: choose to search within a chat
search within a chat for a word
let users search within a chat

words.enDefinition: To look for items using a search limited to the contents of a particular folder.

examples.en: I wanted to search within a folder because every workshop had its own copy of the handout.
examples.zh: 每个工作坊都有自己的讲义副本，所以我想「在指定文件夹内搜索」。

examples.en: Our tutor showed us how to search within a folder for the current reading schedule.
examples.zh: 辅导老师向我们演示了如何「在指定文件夹内搜索」当前的阅读安排。

collocations: search within a folder by name

words.enDefinition: a phone status showing it is trying to find an available cellular network

examples.en: My phone showed searching for network for several seconds after leaving the parking garage.
examples.zh: 我离开停车库后，手机有几秒显示「正在搜索网络」。

examples.en: I saw searching for network on the screen when our train reached the station.
examples.zh: 火车抵达车站时，我在屏幕上看到了「正在搜索网络」。

words.enDefinition: a display option that shows the computer's output only on the connected screen

examples.en: I selected "Second screen only" to use the larger monitor at my study desk.
examples.zh: 我选了「仅用第二屏」，在书桌上用那台较大的显示器。

examples.en: After I chose "Second screen only", the image disappeared from the laptop's own display.
examples.zh: 选择「仅用第二屏」后，笔记本自带屏幕的画面就没了。

words.enDefinition: an additional mobile line used alongside a main line on a device

examples.en: The secondary line was useful when I needed a separate number for my placement.
examples.zh: 实习需要一个独立号码时，「第二手机线路」就派上了用场。

examples.en: I checked which plan I had assigned to the secondary line before going abroad.
examples.zh: 出国前，我确认了「第二手机线路」使用哪一个套餐。

words.enDefinition: to take steps that prevent unwanted access to your account

examples.en: The guide suggests ways to secure your account before using computers at the library.
examples.zh: 指南介绍了在使用图书馆电脑前如何「保护账户安全」。

examples.en: The university explains where to find help if you need to secure your account.
examples.zh: 学校说明了如果需要「保护账户安全」，可以去哪里求助。

collocations: take steps to secure your account
learn how to secure your account
secure your account after an alert

words.enDefinition: an official notice about a security concern and any recommended protective action

examples.en: The security advisory explained which software versions needed changes before the next workshop.
examples.zh: 「信息安全公告」说明了哪些软件版本需要在下次工作坊前更新。

examples.en: Campus IT shared a security advisory on the student portal after the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末过后，校园信息技术部门在学生门户发布了「信息安全公告」。

words.enDefinition: training that teaches people to recognise information security risks and respond appropriately

examples.en: New lab assistants completed security awareness training before they received their university accounts.
examples.zh: 新实验室助理拿到校园账户前，先完成了「安全意识培训」。

examples.en: The university added examples about student email to its security awareness training this year.
examples.zh: 学校今年在「安全意识培训」中加入了学生邮件相关案例。

words.enDefinition: a browser warning that a site's certificate cannot be verified or has a problem

examples.en: A security certificate warning appeared on the old department site, so I asked the helpdesk.
examples.zh: 旧院系网站弹出「网站安全证书警告」，所以我去问了服务台。

examples.en: I sent the webmaster a screenshot of the security certificate warning on the library site.
examples.zh: 我把图书馆网站上出现的「网站安全证书警告」截图发给了网站管理员。

words.enDefinition: a guided review of an account's security settings and activity

examples.en: I ran the security checkup after moving my university account to a new phone.
examples.zh: 把校园账户转到新手机后，我运行了「安全检查向导」。

examples.en: The security checkup showed me which devices were still signed in to my account.
examples.zh: 「安全检查向导」显示了还有哪些设备登录着我的账户。

words.enDefinition: a record submitted to an organisation about an actual or suspected security incident

examples.en: I filed a security incident report through the page listed in the student handbook.
examples.zh: 我通过学生手册上列出的网站提交了一份「安全事件报告」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me add the correct time to my security incident report that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，顾问帮我把正确的时间补进了「安全事件报告」。

words.enDefinition: a physical device that verifies your identity when you sign in to a supported service

examples.en: I borrowed a security key from campus IT to test it with my account.
examples.zh: 我向校园信息技术部门借了一个「实体安全密钥」，用自己的账户试了试。

examples.en: The library guide explains how to register a security key for the student portal.
examples.zh: 图书馆指南解释了如何给学生门户登记「实体安全密钥」。

words.enDefinition: a software fix that addresses one or more specific security flaws

examples.en: The vendor released a security patch for the version installed in the computer lab.
examples.zh: 供应商发布了一个适用于机房所装版本的「安全补丁」。

examples.en: Our lab administrator applied the security patch before students returned for the afternoon session.
examples.zh: 同学们回来上下午的课前，机房管理员安装了「安全补丁」。

words.enDefinition: options that control how a device, service or account is protected

examples.en: I checked the security settings after switching to my new university email account.
examples.zh: 换成新的学校邮箱账户后，我查看了「安全设置」。

examples.en: The helpdesk explained where the app keeps its security settings on mobile devices.
examples.zh: 服务台解释了移动设备上这个应用的「安全设置」在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a change to software intended to address security problems or improve protection

examples.en: The computer installed a security update while I was away at a seminar.
examples.zh: 我去上研讨课时，电脑安装了一次「安全更新」。

examples.en: Campus IT recommended installing the security update before connecting to the student network.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门建议在连学生网络前先安装这次「安全更新」。

words.enDefinition: To mark several files at the same time so an action can be applied to them together.

examples.en: Can you select multiple files before moving the field recordings into the folder for our report?
examples.zh: 你能先「选中多个文件」，再把实地录音移到存放报告的文件夹里吗？

examples.en: I tried to select multiple files after our tutor asked me to collect everyone's diagrams.
examples.zh: 辅导老师让我收集大家的示意图后，我试着「选中多个文件」。

collocations: select multiple files in the list
an option to select multiple files

words.enDefinition: to send an email through the account provided by your university

examples.en: The note asked students to send from your university account when writing about their marks.
examples.zh: 通知要求，写邮件询问成绩时「用学校账号发送」。

examples.en: An adviser explained how to send from your university account using the campus mail website.
examples.zh: 一位顾问用学校的邮件网站演示如何「用学校账号发送」。

collocations: remember to send from your university account
need to send from your university account
always send from your university account

words.enDefinition: the email address shown as the source of a message

examples.en: I checked the sender address because the subject line looked unusual for our course.
examples.zh: 标题不像我们课程平时的写法，所以我核对了「发件人地址」。

examples.en: The adviser compared the sender address with the one in our official staff directory.
examples.zh: 顾问把「发件人地址」与正式员工名录里的邮箱作了比对。

words.enDefinition: the name shown alongside a message, which can differ from its sending address

examples.en: The sender display name looked familiar, but I couldn't recognise the rest of the message.
examples.zh: 「发件人显示名」看着眼熟，但邮件其他内容我都不认得。

examples.en: I checked the sender display name against the address after the university sent its warning.
examples.zh: 学校发出提醒后，我把「发件人显示名」和邮箱地址做了核对。

collocations: compare the sender display name with the address

words.enDefinition: private or important information that could cause harm if disclosed to the wrong people

examples.en: The course policy explained which sensitive information should not appear in student project files.
examples.zh: 课程规定说明了学生项目文件不应包含哪些「敏感信息」。

examples.en: I asked whether the form requested any sensitive information before opening it in class.
examples.zh: 课上打开表格前，我问它是否要求填写「敏感信息」。

words.enDefinition: the mailbox folder where copies of sent messages are stored

examples.en: I looked in the sent folder to find my email about the essay.
examples.zh: 我在「已发送文件夹」里找谈那篇论文的邮件。

examples.en: The sent folder showed that I had emailed the tutor after lunch.
examples.zh: 「已发送文件夹」显示我午饭后给导师发过邮件。

words.enDefinition: a webpage reporting whether a provider's services are operating normally

examples.en: I opened the service status page when our mobile calls suddenly started dropping.
examples.zh: 手机通话突然开始断线时，我打开了「服务运行状态页」。

examples.en: The service status page showed an issue with data in our area that morning.
examples.zh: 当天上午，「服务运行状态页」显示我们这一带的流量服务出了问题。

words.zhGloss: 英国换商不保号授权码
words.enDefinition: a UK code for switching mobile providers without keeping the previous number
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国换商不保号授权码

examples.en: The Ofcom page described a Service Termination Authorisation Code for customers choosing a new number.
examples.zh: Ofcom 的网页介绍了选择新号码的客户使用的「英国换商不保号授权码」。

examples.en: The provider explained how the Service Termination Authorisation Code differed from the code for keeping numbers.
examples.zh: 运营商解释了「英国换商不保号授权码」与保留号码所用代码有什么区别。

collocations: request a Service Termination Authorisation Code
receive a Service Termination Authorisation Code

words.enDefinition: to make a choice the one used automatically in the future

examples.en: I selected “Set as default” after choosing my usual PDF reader.
examples.zh: 选好常用 PDF 阅读器后，我点了「设为默认」。

examples.en: The app showed “Set as default” beside the other language options.
examples.zh: 应用在其他语言选项旁显示了「设为默认」。

collocations: choose an app to set as default

words.enDefinition: groups that organise related options in a settings interface

examples.en: I browsed the settings categories to find the app's display section.
examples.zh: 我浏览了「设置分类」，想找到应用的显示版块。

examples.en: The settings categories were listed on the left on my computer.
examples.zh: 在我的电脑上，「设置分类」列在左边。

collocations: open one of the settings categories

words.enDefinition: a search tool for locating controls in the settings interface

examples.en: I used settings search to find the language option on the tablet.
examples.zh: 我用「设置搜索」找到了平板上的语言选项。

examples.en: The settings search found two places to change how dates appeared.
examples.zh: 「设置搜索」找到了两个可以改日期显示方式的位置。

collocations: type a term into settings search

words.enDefinition: to send a version without editing marks or comments

examples.en: Could you share a clean copy of the worksheet before we send it to students?
examples.zh: 发练习给学生前，能「分享一份清稿」吗？

examples.en: My supervisor asked me to share a clean copy alongside the marked version.
examples.zh: 导师请我发带标记的版本时也「分享一份清稿」。

collocations: ask someone to share a clean copy
offer to share a clean copy
remember to share a clean copy

words.enDefinition: an Apple setting that syncs Screen Time settings and reports

examples.en: I saw "Share Across Devices" while checking the screen time settings on my iPad.
examples.zh: 我在 iPad 上检查屏幕使用时间设置时看到了「跨设备共享」。

examples.en: With "Share Across Devices", my iPhone and tablet used the same limits.
examples.zh: 开启「跨设备共享」后，我的 iPhone 和平板使用同样的限制。

words.enDefinition: to let others see that your alerts are currently silenced

examples.en: I chose to share focus status so my group knew why replies might wait.
examples.zh: 我选择「共享专注状态」，这样组员知道我为什么可能晚点回消息。

examples.en: My iPhone let me share focus status for the schedule I use in seminars.
examples.zh: 我的 iPhone 可以为研讨课所用的模式「共享专注状态」。

collocations: decide whether to share focus status

words.zhGloss: 分享到自己的限时动态
words.enDefinition: to post an existing item in your personal story area
acceptedZhAnswers: 分享到自己的限时动态

examples.en: The app showed how to share to your story from the club page.
examples.zh: 应用演示了怎样从社团页面「分享到自己的限时动态」。

examples.en: I saw the option to share to your story below the photograph.
examples.zh: 我在照片下方看到了「分享到自己的限时动态」的选项。

collocations: an option to share to your story

words.enDefinition: To give people you select access to a file or folder.

examples.en: We chose “Share with specific people” when we sent the draft to two classmates.
examples.zh: 把草稿发给两位同学时，我们选了「与指定人员共享」。

examples.en: The tutorial used “Share with specific people” as its example for a seminar project.
examples.zh: 教程用研讨课项目作例子，介绍了「与指定人员共享」。

collocations: a setting to share with specific people
decide to share with specific people

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the name of the person or account that shared an item.

examples.en: I checked the “Shared by” label to see which classmate had sent the reading notes.
examples.zh: 我看了「共享人」一栏，想知道读书笔记是哪位同学发的。

examples.en: The list showed a name next to “Shared by” for each of our project files.
examples.zh: 列表中，我们每个项目文件的「共享人」旁都显示了一个名字。

words.enDefinition: a plan with one data allowance used by multiple devices or mobile lines

examples.en: The shared data plan showed both phones using the same pool of data.
examples.zh: 「共享流量套餐」显示两部手机用的是同一份流量额度。

examples.en: We chose a shared data plan because our phones used very different amounts.
examples.zh: 两部手机的用量相差很大，所以我们选择了「共享流量套餐」。

collocations: devices on a shared data plan

words.enDefinition: an area listing links previously shared in a chat

examples.en: I looked in the shared links tab for the reading group form.
examples.zh: 我在「共享链接标签页」里找读书小组的表单。

examples.en: The shared links tab listed both websites my classmate had mentioned.
examples.zh: 「共享链接标签页」列出了同学提过的两个网站。

collocations: a link in the shared links tab

words.enDefinition: an area collecting photos, clips or other media sent in a chat

examples.en: I found our old picnic pictures in the shared media tab.
examples.zh: 我在「共享媒体标签页」找到了我们以前的野餐照片。

examples.en: The shared media tab showed videos separately from photos in that chat.
examples.zh: 那个聊天的「共享媒体标签页」把视频和照片分开显示。

collocations: a photo in the shared media tab

words.enDefinition: A file service label for items other people have shared with your account.

examples.en: I found the tutor's reading list under “Shared with me” after opening my cloud drive.
examples.zh: 我打开云盘后，在「与我共享」里找到了导师的阅读清单。

examples.en: The folder appeared in “Shared with me” when our group leader finished setting it up.
examples.zh: 组长设置好文件夹后，它就出现在「与我共享」里。

collocations: an item in shared with me

words.enDefinition: An online space where a group can access materials and work on a project together.

examples.en: Our seminar group kept its research notes in a shared workspace for the term.
examples.zh: 整个学期，我们研讨小组都把研究笔记放在一个「共享工作空间」里。

examples.en: The shared workspace had separate sections for the schedule, meeting notes, and reading list.
examples.zh: 「共享工作空间」把日程、会议笔记和阅读清单分在不同栏目里。

collocations: add materials to a shared workspace

words.enDefinition: A link used to open a file or folder that someone has shared.

examples.en: I opened the sharing link from my classmate to read the group's latest draft.
examples.zh: 我打开同学发来的「共享链接」，看了小组最新的草稿。

examples.en: The tutor posted a sharing link beside the notes for our seminar on Monday.
examples.zh: 导师把一个「共享链接」发在星期一研讨课的笔记旁边。

words.enDefinition: a brief video made for quick viewing online

examples.en: I made a short-form video about the crafts we finished that week.
examples.zh: 我把那周做好的手工作品拍成了一个「短视频」。

examples.en: Our club shared a short-form video to introduce its new practice space.
examples.zh: 我们社团发了一个「短视频」，介绍新的练习空间。

words.enDefinition: a short link that directs a user to a longer web address

examples.en: I asked campus IT about the shortened link because its destination was unclear to me.
examples.zh: 因为不清楚「缩短后的网址链接」指向哪里，我问了校园 IT 部门。

examples.en: The event organizer sent the full address after I asked about the shortened link.
examples.zh: 我问起「缩短后的网址链接」后，活动组织者发来了完整地址。

collocations: replace a shortened link with the full address

words.expression: should we submit one copy per group
words.lemma: should we submit one copy per group
words.enDefinition: asks whether one submission is enough for an entire group
acceptedEnVariants: should we submit one copy per group

examples.en: Should we submit one copy per group for the poster, or upload our own individual copies?
examples.zh: 海报「每组交一份就可以吗」？还是要各自上传一份？

examples.en: Should we submit one copy per group? Several people in our team asked me to check.
examples.zh: 「每组交一份就可以吗」？我们组好几个人让我确认一下。

collocations: ask whether we should submit one copy per group
should we submit one copy per group online
email to check if we should submit one copy per group

words.enDefinition: a setting that keeps an app's control visible in the menu bar

examples.en: I selected “Show in menu bar” to keep the timer visible.
examples.zh: 为了让计时器一直可见，我选了「在菜单栏中显示」。

examples.en: The app placed “Show in menu bar” with its other display settings.
examples.zh: 应用把「在菜单栏中显示」和其他显示设置放在了一起。

words.enDefinition: allows details of an alert to appear after unlocking

examples.en: I chose to show previews when unlocked instead of seeing messages on the lock screen.
examples.zh: 我选择「解锁后显示通知预览」，锁屏上就不用直接显示消息。

examples.en: My tablet can show previews when unlocked while leaving alert icons visible beforehand.
examples.zh: 我的平板可以「解锁后显示通知预览」，解锁前仍显示提醒图标。

collocations: choose to show previews when unlocked
prefer to show previews when unlocked
set alerts to show previews when unlocked

words.enDefinition: To display comments that had been marked as finished during an earlier review.

examples.en: I needed to show resolved comments to check why our tutor asked us to move the table.
examples.zh: 我需要「显示已解决的批注」，才能查看辅导老师为什么让我们挪动表格。

examples.en: Can you show resolved comments so we can revisit the questions we answered at the first meeting?
examples.zh: 你能「显示已解决的批注」吗？我们想回顾第一次会议上答过的问题。

collocations: show resolved comments in the pane
a setting to show resolved comments

words.enDefinition: confirmation that a particular attempt to sign in should be allowed

examples.en: The app asked for sign-in approval before I could open my university mailbox.
examples.zh: 在我能打开学校邮箱之前，应用要求「登录确认」。

examples.en: My password was accepted, but the computer was still waiting for sign-in approval.
examples.zh: 我的密码验证通过了，但电脑仍在等待「登录确认」。

words.enDefinition: an action that tries to enter an account, whether or not it succeeds

examples.en: I saw a sign-in attempt listed just before the account stopped accepting my password.
examples.zh: 账户不再接受我的密码前，我看到记录里有一次「登录尝试」。

examples.en: The system recorded my first sign-in attempt from the computer in the language lab.
examples.zh: 系统记录了我从语言实验室的电脑发起的第一次「登录尝试」。

words.enDefinition: a record of past attempts to sign in to an account or system

examples.en: I checked my sign-in history after noticing a message about an unfamiliar computer.
examples.zh: 我看到有条消息提到陌生电脑，于是查看了「登录记录」。

examples.en: The sign-in history showed the last time I had used the campus computers.
examples.zh: 「登录记录」显示了我上次使用校园电脑是什么时候。

words.enDefinition: to access an account by using a saved passkey rather than typing an account password

examples.en: I could sign in with a passkey once I had set up my new phone.
examples.zh: 设置好新手机后，我就能「用通行密钥登录」。

examples.en: The portal asked whether I wanted to sign in with a passkey this time.
examples.zh: 门户问我这次要不要「用通行密钥登录」。

collocations: choose to sign in with a passkey
try to sign in with a passkey
sign in with a passkey on your phone

words.expression: sign off with your full name
words.lemma: sign off with your full name
words.enDefinition: to finish a message by typing your complete name
acceptedEnVariants: sign off with your full name

examples.en: The lecturer asked you to sign off with your full name so she could check the register.
examples.zh: 老师请你「用全名署名」，方便她核对名册。

examples.en: It helps to sign off with your full name when several students share a first name.
examples.zh: 好几个学生同名时，「用全名署名」有帮助。

collocations: remember to sign off with your full name
be sure to sign off with your full name
asked to sign off with your full name

words.enDefinition: to end a sign-in session on a device from another device or location

examples.en: I decided to sign out remotely after leaving my university session open on a library computer.
examples.zh: 我把校园账户留在图书馆电脑上没退出，于是决定「远程退出登录」。

examples.en: The helpdesk showed me where to sign out remotely from my missing tablet.
examples.zh: 服务台告诉我去哪里操作，就能从丢失的平板上「远程退出登录」。

collocations: learn how to sign out remotely
sign out remotely from a lost device

words.enDefinition: disruption caused by other signals or sources affecting wireless communication

examples.en: The adviser suggested signal interference when the connection slowed near the crowded study room.
examples.zh: 连接在自习室人多的地方变慢后，技术人员认为可能有「无线信号干扰」。

examples.en: The report mentioned signal interference as a possible factor in one area of the building.
examples.zh: 报告说，这栋楼的某个区域可能有「无线信号干扰」。

words.enDefinition: how strongly a device receives a particular wireless signal

examples.en: I checked the signal strength near my desk before starting the online tutorial.
examples.zh: 开始上网课前，我查看了桌子附近的「信号强度」。

examples.en: The app showed better signal strength at the other end of the corridor.
examples.zh: 应用显示，走廊另一端的「信号强度」更好。

words.enDefinition: to stop less important alerts from making a sound

examples.en: I decided to silence nonessential alerts while keeping reminders from my calendar.
examples.zh: 我决定「静音非必要提醒」，但保留日历提醒。

examples.en: Can we set the tablet to silence nonessential alerts during our practice?
examples.zh: 练习期间，能把平板设成「静音非必要提醒」吗？

words.enDefinition: an alert that appears without a sound or vibration

examples.en: I got a silent notification about the lab without disturbing anyone.
examples.zh: 我收到了有关实验课的「静音通知」，没打扰到别人。

examples.en: The calendar sent a silent notification while I was in the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆时，日历应用发来一条「静音通知」。

words.enDefinition: the process of enabling a SIM to work with its assigned mobile service

examples.en: The provider sent an email confirming SIM activation while I was travelling to university.
examples.zh: 我在去学校的路上，运营商发来邮件确认「手机卡开通」。

examples.en: I checked the SIM activation status on the account page before calling support.
examples.zh: 联系支持人员前，我先在账户页查看了「手机卡开通」状态。

words.enDefinition: the opening in a device where a removable SIM card fits

examples.en: The guide pointed out the SIM card slot on the side of the old handset.
examples.zh: 指南指出了旧手机侧面的「手机卡插槽」。

examples.en: I checked whether the SIM card slot was on the same side on both models.
examples.zh: 我确认了两个型号的「手机卡插槽」是否在同一侧。

collocations: cover for the SIM card slot

words.enDefinition: a phone sold without an included SIM or mobile service plan

examples.en: The shop showed me a SIM-free handset on a separate display from the contract deals.
examples.zh: 商店把「不随附手机卡的手机」摆在和合约套餐分开的展台上，并拿了一部给我看。

examples.en: I bought a SIM-free handset after finding a cheaper plan from my existing provider.
examples.zh: 原运营商有更便宜的套餐，我就买了部「不随附手机卡的手机」。

words.enDefinition: a mobile service plan supplied without a new handset

examples.en: I kept my old phone and chose a SIM-only plan for the exchange semester.
examples.zh: 交换学期我继续用旧手机，选了「不含手机的通信套餐」。

examples.en: The SIM-only plan was listed separately from deals that included a new device.
examples.zh: 「不含手机的通信套餐」与附带新设备的优惠分开列出。

collocations: sign up for a SIM-only plan

words.enDefinition: an Android tool limiting time spent on a selected website

examples.en: I saw a site timer option beside the website in the usage report.
examples.zh: 我在使用报告里看到那个网站旁边有个「网站使用限时器」选项。

examples.en: I chose a site timer for one site instead of limiting the browser.
examples.zh: 我给一个网站设了「网站使用限时器」，没限制整个浏览器。

words.enDefinition: an Apple Focus that limits interruptions around your scheduled sleep

examples.en: My iPhone was in sleep focus when my housemate sent a photo.
examples.zh: 室友发来一张照片时，我的 iPhone 处于「睡眠专注模式」。

examples.en: I checked whether sleep focus would start before our late train arrived.
examples.zh: 我看了看，深夜列车到站前「睡眠专注模式」会不会启动。

words.enDefinition: phishing carried out through SMS or similar text messages

examples.en: The student guide explains smishing in the section about suspicious text messages.
examples.zh: 学生指南在介绍可疑短信的章节解释了「短信钓鱼」。

examples.en: Our tutor mentioned smishing when several students asked about unexpected texts on campus.
examples.zh: 几名学生问起在校园里收到的陌生短信时，导师提到了「短信钓鱼」。

words.enDefinition: a service for sending and receiving short text messages over mobile networks

examples.en: The university sent an SMS to confirm my arrival time for the orientation session.
examples.zh: 学校发了条「普通手机短信」，确认我到迎新活动的时间。

examples.en: I received the update by SMS because my mobile data wasn't working that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午移动流量不能用，我通过「普通手机短信」收到了更新。

words.enDefinition: to hide an alert temporarily and have it return later

examples.en: I chose to snooze a notification about my book return until after class.
examples.zh: 我选择先「暂缓图书还书通知」，下课后再提醒。

examples.en: You can snooze a notification instead of opening it during your timed practice.
examples.zh: 如果正在计时练习，可以先「暂缓一条通知」，不用马上打开。

words.enDefinition: manipulation that tricks people into giving access or sharing protected information

examples.en: Our induction covered social engineering alongside other risks that students might encounter online.
examples.zh: 入学培训介绍了「社交工程欺骗」以及学生上网时可能遇到的其他风险。

examples.en: The guide describes social engineering in everyday language suitable for first-year students.
examples.zh: 指南用适合大一学生的日常语言解释了「社交工程欺骗」。

words.enDefinition: a fault or difficulty involving the programs or operating system on a device

examples.en: The helpdesk traced the software issue to the application we used in the workshop.
examples.zh: 服务台查出「软件问题」来自我们工作坊用的那个应用。

examples.en: I reported the software issue when the reading app stopped opening my saved notes.
examples.zh: 阅读应用打不开已保存的笔记后，我报告了这个「软件问题」。

words.enDefinition: To order files according to when they were last changed.

examples.en: I used Sort by date modified to find the diagram our group finished after lunch today.
examples.zh: 我用「按修改日期排序」找到小组今天午饭后完成的示意图。

examples.en: Can you sort by date modified to see which files changed after our last workshop?
examples.zh: 你能「按修改日期排序」，看看上次工作坊后改了哪些文件吗？

collocations: the sort by date modified setting
sort by date modified in descending order

words.enDefinition: to change the order in which comments are shown

examples.en: I wanted to sort comments by time to see which comment came last.
examples.zh: 我想按时间「给评论排序」，看看哪条评论最后发出。

examples.en: The menu let me sort comments before reading the responses to my post.
examples.zh: 我读帖子回复之前，可以先用菜单「给评论排序」。

words.enDefinition: a feature that detects selected sounds in the environment and lets the user know

examples.en: I enabled sound recognition so the phone could notify me when someone rang the doorbell.
examples.zh: 我启用了「环境声音识别」，这样有人按门铃时手机就能提醒我。

examples.en: The setup page lists the types of sounds included in the sound recognition feature.
examples.zh: 设置页面列出了「环境声音识别」功能能检测的声音类别。

words.enDefinition: options for audio inputs, outputs, volume and other sound behaviour

examples.en: I opened sound settings to check which speaker the laptop was using that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，我打开「声音设置」，看笔记本在用哪个扬声器。

examples.en: The assistant checked the sound settings before replacing the microphone in the small classroom.
examples.zh: 工作人员更换小教室的麦克风前，先查看了「声音设置」。

words.enDefinition: The amount of a storage allowance currently occupied by files or other data.

examples.en: I checked the space used after our seminar uploaded three videos to the class drive.
examples.zh: 研讨小组往班级云盘传了三个视频后，我查了一下「已用存储空间」。

examples.en: The space used on our class drive went up after we added the full rehearsal recordings.
examples.zh: 我们上传完整的排练录像后，班级云盘的「已用存储空间」增加了。

collocations: calculate the space used by a folder

words.enDefinition: a system that detects or sorts unwanted or unsolicited messages

examples.en: The spam filter caught most of the advertisements sent to our club inbox.
examples.zh: 「垃圾邮件过滤器」拦下了发到我们社团邮箱的大部分广告。

examples.en: One legitimate signup reminder was caught by the spam filter on my university account.
examples.zh: 我校园账户的「垃圾邮件过滤器」误拦了一封有效的报名提醒。

words.enDefinition: a mailbox folder for messages marked as unwanted or likely to be spam

examples.en: I found the workshop invitation in my spam folder the day before registration closed.
examples.zh: 报名截止前一天，我在「垃圾邮件文件夹」里找到了工作坊邀请。

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to check the spam folder if the reading list was missing.
examples.zh: 导师说，如果没收到阅读书单，可以看看「垃圾邮件文件夹」。

words.enDefinition: an accessibility control that reads the text displayed on the current screen aloud

examples.en: I enabled Speak Screen so I could listen to the reading while preparing dinner.
examples.zh: 我开启了「朗读屏幕」，这样准备晚饭时也能听阅读材料。

examples.en: The adviser demonstrated Speak Screen on a long page from the student support website.
examples.zh: 顾问用学生支持网站上较长的页面演示了「朗读屏幕」。
