words.enDefinition: a control that reads a selected piece of text aloud

examples.en: I turned on Speak Selection to hear unfamiliar words while reading the course notes.
examples.zh: 我打开了「朗读所选内容」，用来听课程笔记里不熟悉的单词。

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated Speak Selection on one line from the handout on her tablet.
examples.zh: 导师在平板上用讲义中的一行字演示了「朗读所选内容」。

words.enDefinition: the speed at which a device reads text aloud or gives spoken feedback

examples.en: I lowered the speaking rate when the screen reader started reading unfamiliar names from class.
examples.zh: 屏幕阅读器开始读课上遇到的陌生名字时，我调低了「合成语音的语速」。

examples.en: The speaking rate on the borrowed tablet was faster than the one I normally use.
examples.zh: 借来的平板上，「合成语音的语速」比我平时用的快。

words.enDefinition: technology that converts spoken words into written text

examples.en: I used speech-to-text to turn our recorded interview into a written transcript.
examples.zh: 我用「语音转文字」把访谈录音转成了一份文字稿。

examples.en: The speech-to-text feature missed my tutor's name, so I corrected it in the notes.
examples.zh: 「语音转文字」没识别出导师的名字，我就在笔记里改了一下。

words.enDefinition: a test measuring how quickly an internet connection transfers data

examples.en: I ran a speed test before asking the residence office about our slow connection.
examples.zh: 询问宿管办公室为什么网络慢之前，我做了一次「网速测试」。

examples.en: The speed test gave different results in the study room and the common area.
examples.zh: 「网速测试」在自习室和公共区域给出了不同的结果。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen keyboard arranged in two groups with a gap between them

examples.en: I enabled the split keyboard so my thumbs could reach the keys on the tablet.
examples.zh: 我打开「分体屏幕键盘」，这样两只拇指都够得到平板上的按键。

examples.en: The setup guide shows how to join the two halves of the split keyboard again.
examples.zh: 设置指南演示了如何重新合并「分体屏幕键盘」的两半。

words.enDefinition: a post that someone pays to have shown to more viewers

examples.en: I saw a sponsored post for an exhibition in the city centre.
examples.zh: 我看见一条介绍市中心展览的「付费推广帖子」。

examples.en: The sponsored post had a small label above the first photo.
examples.zh: 那条「付费推广帖子」的第一张照片上方有个小标识。

collocations: a sponsored post in the feed

words.enDefinition: a sender identity made to appear as though a message came from another source

examples.en: The technician identified a spoofed sender address in the email I had reported.
examples.zh: 技术人员在我举报的邮件里发现了「伪造的发件人地址」。

examples.en: A spoofed sender was listed among the reasons the help desk had blocked the email.
examples.zh: 技术服务台列出拦截这封邮件的理由，其中包括「伪造的发件人身份」。

words.enDefinition: a release intended for normal use after testing

examples.en: The class guide recommended the stable release for the drawing assignment.
examples.zh: 课程指南建议用「稳定版」完成绘画作业。

examples.en: I waited for a stable release before putting the app on my tablet.
examples.zh: 我等出了「稳定版」，才把这款应用装到平板上。

words.enDefinition: to mark a message so it can be found again quickly

examples.en: I chose to star a message containing the details of our rehearsal.
examples.zh: 我选择「给一条包含排练细节的消息加星标」。

examples.en: My tutor explained how to star a message in the class group.
examples.zh: 导师解释了怎么在班级群里「给消息加星标」。

collocations: an option to star a message

words.enDefinition: to begin a separate email conversation about a new topic

examples.en: I decided to start a new thread for the question about next semester's reading.
examples.zh: 我决定为下学期阅读材料的问题「另开一个邮件会话」。

examples.en: The lecturer asked me to start a new thread when I changed topics.
examples.zh: 老师请我换话题时「另开一个邮件会话」。

collocations: decide to start a new thread
need to start a new thread
start a new thread for another topic

words.expression: state the purpose of your email
words.lemma: state the purpose of your email
words.enDefinition: to clearly tell the recipient why you are writing
acceptedEnVariants: state the purpose of your email

examples.en: Try to state the purpose of your email before describing what happened in the seminar.
examples.zh: 先「说明邮件来意」，再叙述研讨课上发生的事。

examples.en: It helps to state the purpose of your email before giving your background in the course.
examples.zh: 先「说明邮件来意」，再交代你在这门课上的背景，有助于对方阅读。

collocations: state the purpose of your email early
be sure to state the purpose of your email
state the purpose of your email directly

words.enDefinition: an accessibility feature that allows keys in a combination to be pressed one at a time

examples.en: I enabled Sticky Keys so I could use shortcuts without holding two keys together.
examples.zh: 我开启了「粘滞键」，不用同时按两个键也能用快捷键。

examples.en: The lab assistant showed me how to turn on Sticky Keys before the practical session.
examples.zh: 上实验课之前，实验室助理给我演示了如何打开「粘滞键」。

words.enDefinition: to pause before acting and check that a message or request is genuine

examples.en: The security poster advised students to stop and check before trusting urgent payment instructions.
examples.zh: 安全海报提醒学生，遇到催付款的指示要「先停下核实」。

examples.en: I decided to stop and check when the email asked for another tuition payment.
examples.zh: 那封邮件让我再付一次学费，我决定「先停下核实」。

collocations: take a moment to stop and check

words.enDefinition: To end the sharing arrangements for a particular file.

examples.en: The menu offered “Stop sharing this file” beside the list of people with access.
examples.zh: 菜单在已有权限的人员名单旁提供了「停止共享此文件」。

examples.en: Our group leader discussed when to stop sharing this file after submitting the final report.
examples.zh: 交了最终报告后，组长和大家商量何时「停止共享此文件」。

collocations: a button saying stop sharing this file

words.enDefinition: information about how much disk or device space is being used and what uses it

examples.en: I reviewed storage usage to find which folders were taking up the most space.
examples.zh: 我查看了「存储占用情况」，找出哪些文件夹用掉的空间最多。

examples.en: My tablet shows storage usage by file type on the main settings page.
examples.zh: 我的平板在设置主页按文件类型显示「存储占用情况」。

words.enDefinition: a section of an app store for apps with similar uses

examples.en: I chose the store category for education before looking at the apps.
examples.zh: 查看应用之前，我选了教育这一「商店分类」。

examples.en: The store category helped me find more tools for planning study sessions.
examples.zh: 这个「商店分类」帮我找到了更多安排学习时间的工具。

words.enDefinition: the country or area assigned to a store account and its catalogue

examples.en: I checked the store region shown beside the app name on my account.
examples.zh: 我查看了账号里应用名称旁显示的「应用商店地区」。

examples.en: The help page explained where to find the current store region.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明了在哪里查看当前的「应用商店地区」。

collocations: a catalogue for a store region

words.enDefinition: a saved item or group of stories kept visible on a profile

examples.en: The craft club made a story highlight for its previous workshops.
examples.zh: 手作社把之前的工作坊存成了一个「精选动态」。

examples.en: I opened the story highlight on our group's profile after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议结束后，我点开了小组主页的「精选动态」。

collocations: add something to a story highlight

words.enDefinition: an individual update published in a platform's Stories feature, usually visible for a limited time

examples.en: Our club shared a story post after we finished setting up the tables.
examples.zh: 摆好桌子后，社团发了一条「限时动态」。

examples.en: I opened the story post to see the second photo of the garden.
examples.zh: 我点开那条「限时动态」，想看花园的第二张照片。

words.enDefinition: a count of views recorded for a particular story

examples.en: I checked story views after posting the clip from our outdoor rehearsal.
examples.zh: 发完户外排练的短视频后，我查了「限时动态观看次数」。

examples.en: The app showed story views under the picture I had uploaded.
examples.zh: 应用在我上传的照片下面显示了「限时动态观看次数」。

collocations: the total number of story views

words.enDefinition: a short pause to get up and stretch your body

examples.en: Our group took a stretch break after the timed reading exercise.
examples.zh: 做完限时阅读练习后，我们小组「起身活动了一小会儿」。

examples.en: The study app offered a stretch break between two longer sessions.
examples.zh: 学习应用在两个较长的时段之间安排了一次「起身活动的短休」。

words.enDefinition: a password chosen to resist guessing, typically by being long and hard to predict

examples.en: Our tutor asked us to choose a strong password for the shared course platform.
examples.zh: 导师请我们为共用的课程平台各自选一个「强密码」。

examples.en: I created a strong password when I signed up for the university library app.
examples.zh: 我注册学校图书馆应用时设置了「强密码」。

words.enDefinition: permission to use software under terms intended for students

examples.en: I got a student licence for the software used in our workshop.
examples.zh: 我拿到了工作坊所用软件的「学生使用许可」。

examples.en: The student licence included the tools needed for my drawing assignment.
examples.zh: 「学生使用许可」涵盖了做绘画作业需要的工具。

words.enDefinition: a period reserved in a schedule for a studying task

examples.en: I started a study block before opening the practice questions online.
examples.zh: 在网上打开练习题前，我进入了「一段专门学习的时间」。

examples.en: My calendar labels the hour after lunch as a study block.
examples.zh: 我的日历把午饭后一小时标为「一段专门学习的时间」。

words.enDefinition: the number of successive days someone meets a study goal

examples.en: The app showed my study streak after I finished the day's reading.
examples.zh: 我读完当天的材料后，应用显示了「连续学习天数」。

examples.en: I didn't worry about breaking my study streak during the field trip.
examples.zh: 实地考察期间，我不担心自己的「连续学习天数」记录会中断。

words.enDefinition: A folder contained inside another folder.

examples.en: Each project group had a subfolder for sample photographs inside the shared class folder online.
examples.zh: 班级共享云文件夹中，每个项目小组都有一个用来存示例照片的「子文件夹」。

examples.en: I created a subfolder for slides so our notes and handouts were easy to find.
examples.zh: 我建了一个放幻灯片的「子文件夹」，这样笔记和讲义也更好找。

words.enDefinition: a short marker added before the rest of an email subject

examples.en: The subject prefix "Re:" showed that this was a reply from my tutor.
examples.zh: 「邮件主题前缀」里的 Re: 表明这封是导师的回复。

examples.en: I recognised the forwarded seminar notice from its subject prefix alone.
examples.zh: 我只看「邮件主题前缀」，就认出这是转来的研讨课通知。

words.enDefinition: a smaller menu opened from an item in a larger menu

examples.en: I found the language option in a submenu under the main settings.
examples.zh: 我在主设置下的一个「子菜单」里找到了语言选项。

examples.en: The submenu stayed open while I read through the different options.
examples.zh: 我逐项看说明时，「子菜单」一直开着。

collocations: choose an option from a submenu

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that the subscribed period has ended

examples.en: The app showed “Subscription expired” after my last day of access.
examples.zh: 最后一天的使用权限结束后，应用显示「订阅已到期」。

examples.en: I saw “Subscription expired” beside the name of the extra tools.
examples.zh: 我在额外工具名称旁看到了「订阅已到期」。

words.enDefinition: the person whose account controls a particular subscription

examples.en: I checked who the subscription owner was before updating the reading plan.
examples.zh: 改阅读套餐前，我核实了谁是「订阅持有人」。

examples.en: The subscription owner was listed separately from the other people sharing access.
examples.zh: 「订阅持有人」与其他有共享权限的人分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that another subscription period has started

examples.en: The account displayed “Subscription renewed” beside the name of my reading app.
examples.zh: 账户在阅读应用名称旁显示了「订阅已续订」。

examples.en: I saved the “Subscription renewed” message with my other account records.
examples.zh: 我把「订阅已续订」的消息和其他账户记录一起保存了。

words.enDefinition: the date when a particular subscription begins

examples.en: I checked the subscription start date before opening the new reading tools.
examples.zh: 使用新的阅读工具前，我查了「订阅开始日期」。

examples.en: The account listed my subscription start date beneath the name of the plan.
examples.zh: 账户在套餐名称下方列了我的「订阅开始日期」。

words.enDefinition: the current state of a subscription shown in an account

examples.en: I checked the subscription status before opening the paid version of the app.
examples.zh: 打开应用的付费版前，我查看了「订阅状态」。

examples.en: The subscription status appeared underneath the name of my reading plan.
examples.zh: 「订阅状态」显示在阅读套餐名称的下方。

words.enDefinition: To propose a change that another person can review before it becomes part of the document.

examples.en: I want to suggest an edit to the introduction before anyone rewrites the whole section.
examples.zh: 在有人重写整节内容前，我想先对引言「提出修改建议」。

examples.en: Could you suggest an edit to that sentence so the reader knows who conducted the interviews?
examples.zh: 你能否对那句话「提出修改建议」，让读者知道访谈是谁做的？

collocations: suggest an edit to a sentence
suggest an edit in the margin

words.enDefinition: accounts an app recommends that you might want to follow

examples.en: I found the campus craft group under suggested accounts after following the radio club.
examples.zh: 关注广播社后，我在「推荐关注的账号」里找到了校园手作小组。

examples.en: The suggested accounts included two groups that my roommate already followed.
examples.zh: 「推荐关注的账号」里有两个室友已经关注的小组。

collocations: follow one of the suggested accounts

words.enDefinition: a post offered by the app based on what might interest you

examples.en: A suggested post showed how another club organised its reading group.
examples.zh: 一条「推荐帖子」介绍了另一个社团怎样组织读书小组。

examples.en: I opened a suggested post about weekend walks near the university.
examples.zh: 我打开一条讲周末在大学附近散步的「推荐帖子」。

collocations: a suggested post in the feed

words.enDefinition: the devices on which a particular app is intended to work

examples.en: I checked supported devices to see whether my old tablet appeared.
examples.zh: 我查看了「兼容设备」，想知道有没有我的旧平板。

examples.en: The store displayed supported devices on the same page as system requirements.
examples.zh: 商店把「兼容设备」和系统要求放在同一个页面。

words.enDefinition: the languages in which an app can display content or controls

examples.en: I checked supported languages to see whether the menu could appear in Spanish.
examples.zh: 我查看「支持的语言」，想知道菜单能不能用西班牙语显示。

examples.en: The app listed supported languages beside the platform information on its store page.
examples.zh: 应用的商店页面把「支持的语言」列在平台信息旁边。

words.enDefinition: a link that seems unreliable or that might lead somewhere unsafe

examples.en: I shared a screenshot of the suspicious link with the campus support desk for review.
examples.zh: 我截了「可疑链接」的图，发给校园技术服务台核查。

examples.en: The seminar included a short discussion about recognising a suspicious link in a message.
examples.zh: 研讨课简短讨论了如何识别消息里的「可疑链接」。

words.enDefinition: a message whose sender, content, or purpose makes it seem potentially unsafe

examples.en: I received a suspicious message about a payment I did not recognise that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，我收到一条跟一笔陌生付款有关的「可疑消息」。

examples.en: My roommate asked the residence office whether they had sent the suspicious message.
examples.zh: 室友问宿管办公室，那条「可疑消息」是不是他们发的。

words.enDefinition: an attempt to sign in that appears unusual and may not be authorised

examples.en: The app flagged a suspicious sign-in when I was travelling to another campus.
examples.zh: 我在去另一个校区的路上，应用标记了一次「可疑登录」。

examples.en: I contacted the university helpdesk after the portal reported a suspicious sign-in overnight.
examples.zh: 门户报告夜里有一次「可疑登录」后，我联系了学校服务台。

words.enDefinition: to move a finger upward across a touchscreen to scroll or trigger an action

examples.en: I had to swipe up to see the rest of the schedule on my phone.
examples.zh: 我得「向上滑动」，才能在手机上看见日程的剩余部分。

examples.en: On my Android phone, I swipe up from the home screen to open the app drawer.
examples.zh: 在我的安卓手机上，我从主屏幕「向上滑动」，就能打开应用列表。

words.enDefinition: an Android accessibility feature for operating a device with physical switches or other supported controls

examples.en: The university showed us how Switch Access worked on the Android tablet in the lab.
examples.zh: 学校给我们演示了实验室的安卓平板怎么用「辅助开关操作」。

examples.en: I tested switch access with the provided switches before the discussion group arrived that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上讨论小组到场前，我用配套开关测试了「辅助开关操作」。

words.enDefinition: to change to the level available without a subscription fee

examples.en: I decided to switch to the free tier after the group project ended.
examples.zh: 小组项目结束后，我决定「切换到免费档位」。

examples.en: The plan page explained how to switch to the free tier.
examples.zh: 套餐页面介绍了怎样「切换到免费档位」。

collocations: choose to switch to the free tier
plan to switch to the free tier
an option to switch to the free tier

words.enDefinition: To update another storage location or device with file edits so both show matching contents.

examples.en: The app began to sync changes as soon as my tablet reconnected to the campus network.
examples.zh: 我的平板一重新连上校园网，应用就开始「同步修改」。

examples.en: I left the notes from our afternoon workshop open while the program tried to sync changes.
examples.zh: 应用尝试「同步修改」时，我让下午工作坊用过的笔记保持打开。

words.enDefinition: A situation in which a service cannot automatically combine inconsistent changes to the same file.

examples.en: We saw a sync conflict when the field notes and their cloud version contained different edits.
examples.zh: 现场记录和对应的云端版本各有不同修改，我们看到了「同步冲突」。

examples.en: I reported a sync conflict after my partner and I both updated the same spreadsheet offline.
examples.zh: 搭档和我离线更新了同一份电子表格，我报告了这次「同步冲突」。

words.enDefinition: An issue that prevents a service from keeping a file up to date across locations.

examples.en: The sync error explained why the graph on my tablet still showed the old survey results.
examples.zh: 「同步错误」说明了我平板上的图为什么仍显示旧的调查结果。

examples.en: I reported a sync error when the cloud folder stopped showing my latest notes from class.
examples.zh: 云文件夹不再显示我最新的课堂笔记后，我报告了一个「同步错误」。

words.enDefinition: A designated folder whose contents a service keeps matched with another location.

examples.en: I saved the slides in my sync folder so I could check them on my tablet.
examples.zh: 我把幻灯片放进「同步文件夹」，好在平板上查看。

examples.en: The tutor pointed to a sync folder while explaining where each group should keep its drafts.
examples.zh: 辅导老师解释各小组该把草稿放在哪时，指给我们看了一个「同步文件夹」。

collocations: save files in a sync folder

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that synchronization has been temporarily stopped.

examples.en: The Sync paused notice was still visible when I returned to the library after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后我回到图书馆时，「同步已暂停」的提示还在显示。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out the Sync paused message while showing us the sample folder online.
examples.zh: 辅导老师给我们展示示例云文件夹时，特意指出了「同步已暂停」的提示。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that a file or change is waiting to be synchronized.

examples.en: The folder showed Sync pending when I reopened my notes on the bus after class.
examples.zh: 下课后我在公交车上重新打开笔记，文件夹显示「等待同步」。

examples.en: My laptop displayed Sync pending beside the photos I had added during the field trip.
examples.zh: 我在实地考察时添加的照片旁，笔记本电脑显示「等待同步」。

collocations: show sync pending beside a file

words.enDefinition: An indication of whether files are up to date, waiting, or having trouble syncing.

examples.en: I checked the sync status before asking my project partner to open the revised worksheet.
examples.zh: 我先看了「同步状态」，再请项目搭档打开修改过的工作表。

examples.en: The sync status beside our report helped explain why I was seeing yesterday's table instead.
examples.zh: 报告旁的「同步状态」让我明白自己为什么看到的还是昨天的表格。

words.enDefinition: the language used by the device's operating system

examples.en: The system language determined which labels appeared in the tablet's menus.
examples.zh: 「系统语言」决定了平板菜单上的标签用什么语言显示。

examples.en: I checked the system language before comparing menu labels with my roommate.
examples.zh: 我先查了「系统语言」，再和室友对照菜单标签。

words.enDefinition: device settings that control which alerts appear and how they behave

examples.en: I opened the system notification settings to check why my apps had gone quiet.
examples.zh: 我打开「系统通知设置」，看看为什么应用都没了提示音。

examples.en: The course app links to system notification settings for changes affecting every alert type.
examples.zh: 要改所有类型的提醒，课程应用会跳转到「系统通知设置」。

words.enDefinition: the controls for changing how the device itself behaves

examples.en: I opened system settings to check which language the tablet used.
examples.zh: 我打开「系统设置」，查看平板用的是哪种语言。

examples.en: The system settings showed where to choose the default reading app.
examples.zh: 「系统设置」显示了在哪里选默认阅读应用。

words.enDefinition: a setting for reviewing tags before they appear on your profile

examples.en: I turned on tag approval after finding an unfamiliar photo on my profile.
examples.zh: 在主页看到一张不熟悉的照片后，我开启了「标记审核」。

examples.en: The tag approval screen showed a picture from our group picnic.
examples.zh: 「标记审核」页面显示了我们集体野餐的一张照片。

words.enDefinition: a PDF containing tags that define structural roles such as headings, lists and tables

examples.en: The support team gave us a tagged PDF so students could navigate by headings.
examples.zh: 支持团队给了我们一份「带结构标签的 PDF」，学生可以按标题跳转。

examples.en: I checked that the tagged PDF identified the rows and columns in each table.
examples.zh: 我检查了「带结构标签的 PDF」是否标出了每张表中的行和列。

collocations: check a tagged PDF for accessibility

words.enDefinition: to stop looking at a screen for a short period

examples.en: My tablet reminded me to take a screen break between two practice exercises.
examples.zh: 两道练习之间，平板提醒我「暂时离开屏幕」。

examples.en: I planned to take a screen break before reading the next set of slides.
examples.zh: 看下一组幻灯片之前，我打算「暂时离开屏幕」歇一会儿。

collocations: choose to take a screen break
time to take a screen break
want to take a screen break

words.enDefinition: to touch an item on a screen and keep a finger there briefly

examples.en: I had to tap and hold the picture before the options appeared underneath it.
examples.zh: 我得「长按」图片，下方才会出现选项。

examples.en: The guide says to tap and hold an icon to display its shortcut menu.
examples.zh: 指南上说，要「长按」图标才会显示它的快捷菜单。

collocations: tap and hold to open a menu

words.enDefinition: a touch setting that uses the first or last position of a touch to register a tap

examples.en: I enabled Tap Assistance to make the location of my taps more predictable on screen.
examples.zh: 我开启了「轻点辅助」，让屏幕记录的点按位置更符合预期。

examples.en: The help page explains the options for Tap Assistance and when each setting applies.
examples.zh: 帮助页面介绍了「轻点辅助」的不同选项，以及各自何时生效。

words.enDefinition: repeated highlighting of a taskbar app icon to attract attention

examples.en: I noticed taskbar flashing when a classmate sent a chat message.
examples.zh: 同学发来聊天消息时，我注意到「任务栏图标闪烁」。

examples.en: My Windows focus session stopped the taskbar flashing while I finished writing.
examples.zh: 我写完之前，Windows 的专注时段阻止了「任务栏图标闪烁」。

words.enDefinition: a scam in which someone pretends to offer technical support

examples.en: Campus IT warned about a tech support scam targeting new students this week.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门提醒，新生本周要留意「假冒技术支持诈骗」。

examples.en: We discussed a tech support scam during orientation and saved the real helpdesk number.
examples.zh: 入学培训时我们讨论了「假冒技术支持诈骗」，还存下了真正的服务台号码。

collocations: a warning about a tech support scam

words.enDefinition: a banner that disappears from the screen automatically after appearing

examples.en: I chose a temporary banner so the alert would disappear on its own.
examples.zh: 我选了「临时横幅」，提醒就会自己消失。

examples.en: The reminder appeared as a temporary banner while I was editing my essay.
examples.zh: 我在改论文时，提醒以「临时横幅」的形式出现。

words.enDefinition: files created for short-term use while an application or system carries out a task

examples.en: The support adviser explained which temporary files the operating system could clean up safely.
examples.zh: 支持人员解释了操作系统可以安全清理哪些「临时文件」。

examples.en: I checked how much space temporary files were using on the tablet we borrowed.
examples.zh: 我查看了我们借来的平板上「临时文件」占了多少空间。

words.enDefinition: a phone number assigned for use for a limited time

examples.en: The carrier gave me a temporary mobile number before the transfer was completed.
examples.zh: 转网完成前，运营商给了我一个「临时手机号码」。

examples.en: I copied the temporary mobile number from the letter into my university contact form.
examples.zh: 我把信上的「临时手机号码」抄进了学校的联系信息表。

words.enDefinition: to check that a microphone is working and picking up sound properly

examples.en: I used the recording app to test the microphone before our project interview.
examples.zh: 项目访谈前，我用录音应用「测试麦克风」。

examples.en: The tutor asked us to test the microphone before the remote discussion began that morning.
examples.zh: 导师请我们在当天上午的远程讨论开始前先「测试麦克风」。

collocations: test the microphone before a call
use a recorder to test the microphone

words.enDefinition: using one device's mobile connection to provide internet access to another device

examples.en: My flatmate used tethering to open a course page on her laptop on the bus.
examples.zh: 室友在公交上用「共享手机网络功能」，在笔记本电脑上打开课程网页。

examples.en: The mobile plan listed a separate allowance for tethering while away from campus.
examples.zh: 手机套餐列出了离开学校时用于「共享手机网络功能」的单独额度。

words.enDefinition: a visual marker that makes the place where typed text will appear easier to see

examples.en: I enabled the text cursor indicator to find where I was typing in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我打开了「文本光标指示器」，方便在练习表里找到当前输入的位置。

examples.en: The text cursor indicator helped me find my place when editing the presentation notes.
examples.zh: 编辑演示备注时，「文本光标指示器」让我更容易找到编辑位置。

collocations: change the text cursor indicator colour

words.enDefinition: a notice reporting whether a text message was delivered

examples.en: I checked the text message delivery report after sending the new meeting address to my friend.
examples.zh: 我把新碰头地址发给朋友后，查看了「短信送达报告」。

examples.en: The text message delivery report arrived a minute after I stepped out of the lift.
examples.zh: 我走出电梯一分钟后，收到了「短信送达报告」。

collocations: request a text message delivery report
receive a text message delivery report
check the text message delivery report

words.enDefinition: a published item containing written text without attached pictures or video

examples.en: I shared a text-only post about the reading group's change of plans.
examples.zh: 我发了条「纯文字帖子」，说读书小组的计划变了。

examples.en: The club used a text-only post to explain the rehearsal schedule.
examples.zh: 社团发了条「纯文字帖子」说明排练安排。

words.enDefinition: changing the relative size of text across a device or interface

examples.en: I increased text scaling to make the reading app easier to use between classes.
examples.zh: 我调大了「文字缩放」，课间看阅读应用更轻松了。

examples.en: The timetable remained readable after I changed text scaling on the university's loan tablet.
examples.zh: 我在学校借来的平板上调整「文字缩放」后，时间表依然看得清。

words.enDefinition: technology that converts written text into spoken audio

examples.en: I used text-to-speech to listen to the assigned reading while looking at the diagrams.
examples.zh: 我用「文字转语音」听指定读物，同时看其中的图表。

examples.en: The note-taking app offers text-to-speech for students who prefer listening to their notes.
examples.zh: 笔记应用为更喜欢听笔记的学生提供「文字转语音」。

words.expression: thank you for reviewing my draft
words.lemma: thank you for reviewing my draft
words.enDefinition: expresses appreciation to someone who has read and checked your draft
acceptedEnVariants: thank you for reviewing my draft

examples.en: Thank you for reviewing my draft. Your comments helped me reorganise the last two sections.
examples.zh: 「谢谢您审阅我的草稿」。您的意见帮我重新安排了最后两节的结构。

examples.en: Thank you for reviewing my draft on such short notice before next week's presentation.
examples.zh: 下周就要展示了，时间这么紧，「谢谢您审阅我的草稿」。

collocations: thank you for reviewing my draft before we met
thank you for reviewing my draft in detail
write thank you for reviewing my draft

words.enDefinition: thanks the teacher for making the work requirements easier to understand

examples.en: Thanks for clarifying the assignment. I now know which examples need a reference list.
examples.zh: 「谢谢您解释作业要求」。我现在知道哪些例子需要列参考文献了。

examples.en: Thanks for clarifying the assignment in the message you sent to our tutorial group.
examples.zh: 「谢谢您解释作业要求」，我看了您发给辅导小组的那封邮件。

collocations: thanks for clarifying the assignment by email
thanks for clarifying the assignment before class
write thanks for clarifying the assignment

words.expression: thanks for meeting outside office hours
words.lemma: thanks for meeting outside office hours
words.zhGloss: 谢谢您在答疑时间外见我
words.enDefinition: thanks an instructor for meeting beyond their normal student meeting period
acceptedZhAnswers: 谢谢您在答疑时间外见我
acceptedEnVariants: thanks for meeting outside office hours

examples.en: Thanks for meeting outside office hours so I could make it to my lab afterward.
examples.zh: 「谢谢您在答疑时间外见我」，这样我之后才能赶去上实验课。

examples.en: Thanks for meeting outside office hours. It helped to talk through the outline in person.
examples.zh: 「谢谢您在答疑时间外见我」。当面梳理论文提纲很有帮助。

collocations: thanks for meeting outside office hours this week
really, thanks for meeting outside office hours
email saying thanks for meeting outside office hours

words.enDefinition: says that a file arrived but contains no visible content

examples.en: I can open the handout, but the attachment is blank on my screen.
examples.zh: 我能打开讲义，但在我的屏幕上「附件里是空白的」。

examples.en: The tutor replied that the attachment is blank and asked for another copy.
examples.zh: 导师回信说「附件里是空白的」，请我再发一份。

collocations: report that the attachment is blank
explain that the attachment is blank

words.enDefinition: using three on-screen buttons for actions such as going back, going home and switching apps

examples.en: I used three-button navigation on the borrowed phone because the buttons stayed visible.
examples.zh: 我在借来的手机上用「三键导航」，因为按钮一直显示在屏幕上。

examples.en: The setup guide explains how to switch from gestures to three-button navigation when needed.
examples.zh: 设置指南解释了需要时怎样从手势切换到「三键导航」。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating an app's permitted usage time has run out

examples.en: The game showed "Time limit reached" after my evening of practice questions.
examples.zh: 晚上做完练习题后，那款游戏显示「已达到使用时限」。

examples.en: I saw "Time limit reached" when I tried to open the drawing app.
examples.zh: 我试着打开绘图应用时，看到了「已达到使用时限」。

words.enDefinition: an alert that appears before a time allowance runs out

examples.en: A time limit warning appeared just before I finished the practice quiz.
examples.zh: 我快做完练习小测时，弹出一个「时限将到提醒」。

examples.en: I checked my notes after receiving the time limit warning on my tablet.
examples.zh: 平板收到「时限将到提醒」后，我看了看自己的笔记。

words.enDefinition: an alert marked for prompt delivery because its information may expire

examples.en: A time-sensitive notification warned that our assigned room had just changed.
examples.zh: 一条「时效性通知」提示，我们分到的教室刚刚变了。

examples.en: I noticed a time-sensitive notification about an update to my appointment time.
examples.zh: 我注意到一条关于预约时间变更的「时效性通知」。

words.enDefinition: how long a user spent using applications individually

examples.en: I checked time spent in each app after a long afternoon of working on slides.
examples.zh: 改了很久的幻灯片后，我查了查「每个应用的使用时长」。

examples.en: My phone listed the time spent in each app over the course of a week.
examples.zh: 手机列出了一周内「每个应用的使用时长」。

collocations: track time spent in each app
show time spent in each app
check time spent in each app

words.expression: to correct the date in my last email
words.lemma: to correct the date in my last email
words.zhGloss: 更正上封邮件里的日期
words.enDefinition: introduces a correction to a date stated in an earlier email
acceptedZhAnswers: 更正上封邮件里的日期
acceptedEnVariants: to correct the date in my last email

examples.en: I'm writing to correct the date in my last email about the meeting for next week's presentation.
examples.zh: 我写信是为了「更正上封邮件里的日期」，是下周展示准备会的日期。

examples.en: I wanted to correct the date in my last email about when I can bring the poster.
examples.zh: 我想「更正上封邮件里的日期」，就是我能把海报带来的那天。

collocations: I'm writing to correct the date in my last email
just to correct the date in my last email
email to correct the date in my last email

words.enDefinition: the box for addresses of the main recipients of an email

examples.en: I put my supervisor's address in the To field before attaching my draft.
examples.zh: 我把导师的地址填进「主收件人栏」，然后附上草稿。

examples.en: Both instructors appeared in the To field because they shared the course.
examples.zh: 因为两位老师共同授课，他们的地址都在「主收件人栏」里。

collocations: add an address to the To field

words.enDefinition: a control that changes a setting between two states

examples.en: I used the toggle switch to show week numbers in my planner.
examples.zh: 我用「切换开关」开启了计划工具里的周数显示。

examples.en: A toggle switch beside the option showed whether it was enabled.
examples.zh: 选项旁的「切换开关」显示它是否已开启。

collocations: a toggle switch for a setting

words.enDefinition: comments the app chooses to place prominently by its ranking

examples.en: The top comments included a question about the club's sign-up process.
examples.zh: 「热门评论」里有人问社团怎么报名。

examples.en: I switched from top comments to a view sorted by time.
examples.zh: 我从「热门评论」切换到了按时间排序的视图。

words.enDefinition: a comment on the original post rather than on another comment

examples.en: I posted a top-level comment because my question concerned the whole update.
examples.zh: 我的问题和整条动态有关，所以发了一条「一级评论」。

examples.en: The top-level comment showed three replies beneath it on my phone.
examples.zh: 在我的手机上，那条「一级评论」下面显示有三条回复。

collocations: a top-level comment on a post

words.enDefinition: a voucher that adds prepaid credit to a mobile account

examples.en: I bought a top-up voucher at the shop opposite the residence hall entrance.
examples.zh: 我在宿舍楼入口对面的商店买了一张「手机充值券」。

examples.en: The cashier showed me where the value was printed on the top-up voucher.
examples.zh: 收银员给我指出了「手机充值券」面值印在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the combined duration of a person's activity on one device

examples.en: The chart compared my total time on device for different days of the week.
examples.zh: 图表对比了我一周中不同日子的「设备使用总时长」。

examples.en: My total time on device was higher on the day we had online classes.
examples.zh: 上网课那天，我的「设备使用总时长」更长。

words.enDefinition: settings that change how a touchscreen responds to taps, holds and other touch actions

examples.en: I opened Touch Accommodations to change how my tablet responded to quick taps in class.
examples.zh: 我打开「触控调节」，调整平板在课堂上对快速轻点的反应。

examples.en: The support adviser checked Touch Accommodations while helping me set up the borrowed device.
examples.zh: 支持人员帮我设置借来的设备时，查看了「触控调节」。

words.enDefinition: how readily a touchscreen registers contact from a finger or compatible input device

examples.en: The touch sensitivity felt different after I put a new protector on the screen.
examples.zh: 更换屏幕保护膜后，我感觉「触控灵敏度」变了。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where to adjust touch sensitivity on the device from the lab.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了在机房设备上哪里可以调「触控灵敏度」。

words.enDefinition: the area on a screen that responds when someone taps a control

examples.en: A larger touch target made the sign-up button easier to press on my phone.
examples.zh: 更大的「触控目标区域」让手机上的报名按钮更容易点中。

examples.en: We checked each touch target on the society's page while testing it for accessibility.
examples.zh: 测试社团网页的无障碍功能时，我们检查了每一个「触控目标区域」。

words.enDefinition: To change who is recorded as the owner of a file or folder.

examples.en: The old project lead agreed to transfer ownership once the new group had been confirmed.
examples.zh: 新小组确定后，原项目负责人同意「转让所有权」。

examples.en: The dialog summarized what it would mean to transfer ownership of our shared reference folder.
examples.zh: 对话框简要说明了，共享参考文件夹一旦「转让所有权」会有哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: whether a user meets the conditions for a trial

examples.en: I read the trial eligibility details before opening the offer page.
examples.zh: 打开优惠页面之前，我看了「试用资格」的详细说明。

examples.en: The account page showed my trial eligibility for the drawing programme.
examples.zh: 账户页面显示了我对绘画软件的「试用资格」。

words.enDefinition: wording introducing the date when a trial period finishes

examples.en: The page said “Trial ends on” above the date listed for my account.
examples.zh: 页面在我账号所列的日期上方写着「试用到期日」。

examples.en: I read “Trial ends on” before noting the date in my planner.
examples.zh: 我看到「试用到期日」后，把日期记在了计划本里。

words.enDefinition: to shorten a video by removing part of its beginning or end

examples.en: My roommate showed me how to trim a clip before sharing it.
examples.zh: 室友给我演示了怎样在分享前「剪短视频片段」。

examples.en: I decided to trim a clip because the end was too long.
examples.zh: 片尾拖得太长，我决定「剪短视频片段」。

words.enDefinition: instructions for identifying the cause of a problem and trying appropriate fixes

examples.en: I opened the troubleshooting guide after the lecture recording played without any sound.
examples.zh: 课堂录像播放时没有声音，我打开了「故障排查指南」。

examples.en: The support page provides a troubleshooting guide for common problems with borrowed tablets.
examples.zh: 支持页面为借用平板的常见问题提供了「故障排查指南」。

words.enDefinition: a known communication route that can be used to reach someone reliably

examples.en: I checked through a trusted contact channel when the message appeared to come from my adviser.
examples.zh: 消息看起来像导师发的，我用「可靠的联系渠道」核实了一下。

examples.en: The bank referred me to a trusted contact channel listed in its official app.
examples.zh: 银行让我用官方应用中列出的「可靠的联系渠道」沟通。

collocations: confirm through a trusted contact channel

words.enDefinition: a scheme pretending to collect tuition charges or offer a discount on tuition

examples.en: The university sent a warning about a tuition payment scam before the new semester.
examples.zh: 新学期前，学校发了一份有关「学费支付诈骗」的提醒。

examples.en: I asked the accounts office whether the message was part of the tuition payment scam.
examples.zh: 我问财务办公室，这条消息是不是「学费支付诈骗」的一部分。

collocations: warn students about a tuition payment scam
notice about a tuition payment scam

words.enDefinition: to stop an app from showing alerts through the device system

examples.en: I decided to turn off app notifications for a game I rarely played anymore.
examples.zh: 我决定给一款已经很少玩的游戏「关闭应用通知」。

examples.en: My roommate wanted to turn off app notifications while keeping the app on her phone.
examples.zh: 室友想「关闭应用通知」，同时把应用留在手机里。

collocations: decide to turn off app notifications
option to turn off app notifications
turn off app notifications at night

words.enDefinition: to prevent people from adding comments to a post

examples.en: The group decided to turn off comments on its old announcement.
examples.zh: 小组决定给那条旧公告「关闭评论」。

examples.en: I checked where to turn off comments before archiving the page.
examples.zh: 归档页面前，我确认了在哪里可以「关闭评论」。

collocations: turn off comments on a post
an option to turn off comments

words.enDefinition: a sign that another person is composing a message

examples.en: The typing indicator appeared while I waited for my lab partner's reply.
examples.zh: 我等实验搭档回复时，出现了「正在输入提示」。

examples.en: I saw the typing indicator disappear when my classmate sent her message.
examples.zh: 同学发来消息时，我看到「正在输入提示」消失了。

collocations: a typing indicator in a chat

words.enDefinition: use of an account, system or information without the right to do so

examples.en: The helpdesk investigated possible unauthorized access after an alert appeared on my student account.
examples.zh: 我的学生账户弹出提醒后，服务台调查了可能的「未经授权的访问」。

examples.en: The training explained how the university records reports of unauthorized access to its systems.
examples.zh: 培训介绍了学校如何记录有关系统遭「未经授权的访问」的报告。

words.enDefinition: a file included in a message when the recipient was not expecting one

examples.en: I told the help desk about an unexpected attachment from a number I didn't know.
examples.zh: 我告诉技术服务台，陌生号码发来了一个「意外收到的附件」。

examples.en: The tutor confirmed that the unexpected attachment was her updated worksheet for the seminar.
examples.zh: 导师确认，这个「意外收到的附件」是她更新过的研讨课练习单。

words.enDefinition: a request to verify a sign-in that you did not start or expect

examples.en: An unexpected sign-in prompt appeared while my laptop was still closed in my bag.
examples.zh: 笔记本电脑还合着放在包里时，我收到了一条「意外出现的登录提示」。

examples.en: The helpdesk asked when I first saw the unexpected sign-in prompt on my phone.
examples.zh: 服务台问我什么时候第一次在手机上看到「意外出现的登录提示」。

words.enDefinition: to stop following an account or person on a social app

examples.en: I chose to unfollow the old account after the club moved elsewhere.
examples.zh: 社团换了账号后，我选择「取消关注」原来的账号。

examples.en: My classmate decided to unfollow a page she no longer read.
examples.zh: 同学决定「取消关注」一个已经不看的页面。

words.enDefinition: time set aside for studying without other activities interrupting it

examples.en: I booked a library room for some uninterrupted study time before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前，我订了间图书馆自习室，想留点「不受打扰的学习时间」。

examples.en: My phone stayed quiet throughout the uninterrupted study time I'd planned that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我那天下午安排的「不受打扰的学习时间」里，手机一直没响。

words.enDefinition: a password used for only one account or service

examples.en: I made a unique password for the portal instead of reusing my email password.
examples.zh: 我给门户设了一个「独立专用的密码」，没有沿用邮箱密码。

examples.en: My password manager generates a unique password whenever I open a new account.
examples.zh: 我每开一个新账户，密码管理器都会生成一个「独立专用的密码」。

collocations: use a unique password for each site

words.enDefinition: the units an app uses to display quantities such as distance

examples.en: I checked the units of measurement before comparing the two map readings.
examples.zh: 比较两个地图读数之前，我查了「度量单位」。

examples.en: The app let me switch units of measurement in the settings screen.
examples.zh: 应用让我能在设置页面切换「度量单位」。

words.enDefinition: a caller whose number or name cannot be identified by the receiving phone

examples.en: My phone marked the call as unknown caller while I was on the bus.
examples.zh: 我在公交上时，手机把来电标为「未知来电」。

examples.en: I let the unknown caller leave a message about the change to my appointment.
examples.zh: 我没接那通「未知来电」，对方留了言，说预约时间有变化。

words.enDefinition: to remove the like you previously gave a post

examples.en: I tried to unlike a post after tapping the heart by accident.
examples.zh: 不小心点到爱心后，我试着「取消给帖子的点赞」。

examples.en: The help page showed how to unlike a post from the feed.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明了怎样在信息流里「取消给帖子的点赞」。

collocations: tap again to unlike a post
be able to unlike a post

words.enDefinition: the number of occasions when a device was unlocked

examples.en: My phone showed an unlock count for each day in the report.
examples.zh: 手机报告里每天都有一个「解锁次数」。

examples.en: I compared my unlock count on weekdays with the number on weekends.
examples.zh: 我比较了工作日和周末的「解锁次数」。

words.enDefinition: a phone that can be used on compatible networks from more than one provider

examples.en: I took an unlocked handset to the residence so I could choose a provider locally.
examples.zh: 我带了一部「无运营商锁的手机」去宿舍，这样可以在当地选择运营商。

examples.en: The seller confirmed it was an unlocked handset before letting me check the model number.
examples.zh: 卖家先确认这是「无运营商锁的手机」，再让我查型号。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen line marking where unread messages begin

examples.en: The unread message divider helped me find where I had stopped reading.
examples.zh: 「未读消息分隔线」帮我找到了上次读到的位置。

examples.en: I scrolled to the unread message divider before checking the new schedule.
examples.zh: 我先滚到「未读消息分隔线」，再看新的日程。

collocations: scroll to the unread message divider

words.enDefinition: a device that a service or user does not recognise as previously associated with an account

examples.en: The page listed an unrecognized device that I did not remember using at college.
examples.zh: 页面列出了一台「不熟悉的设备」，我不记得自己在学校用过它。

examples.en: I asked the helpdesk about an unrecognized device in my university account settings.
examples.zh: 我向服务台咨询了校园账户设置里的一台「不熟悉的设备」。

collocations: an alert for an unrecognized device

words.enDefinition: A comment that remains open and may still require a reply or action.

examples.en: There was one unresolved comment asking whether we had permission to reproduce the photograph in the handout.
examples.zh: 还有一条「未解决的批注」，问我们是否获准在讲义里复制那张照片。

examples.en: An unresolved comment at the end of the draft reminded me to check the spelling of Lina's name.
examples.zh: 草稿末尾的一条「未解决的批注」提醒我核对莉娜名字的拼写。

words.enDefinition: a touch display that does not react when the user touches it

examples.en: I couldn't check in because the kiosk had an unresponsive touchscreen that morning.
examples.zh: 当天上午，自助机的「触摸屏没有响应」，我没能签到。

examples.en: The desk attendant replaced the loan tablet after I reported an unresponsive touchscreen.
examples.zh: 我报告借来的平板「触摸屏没有响应」后，服务台给我换了一台。

words.enDefinition: to request removal of a message you already sent for other viewers

examples.en: I chose to unsend a message that I had sent to the wrong group.
examples.zh: 我选择「撤回一条消息」，因为刚才发错群了。

examples.en: I checked whether I could unsend a message from our rehearsal chat.
examples.zh: 我确认能不能在排练群里「撤回一条消息」。

collocations: an option to unsend a message
decide whether to unsend a message

words.enDefinition: a duration option that keeps a mode active until manually stopped

examples.en: I selected "Until I turn it off" for a study session without a fixed ending.
examples.zh: 这次自习结束时间不定，所以我选了「直到我手动关闭」。

examples.en: My phone can stay in that mode until I turn it off after the workshop.
examples.zh: 工作坊结束后，手机可以保持这个模式，「直到我手动关闭」。

collocations: stay on until I turn it off
select until I turn it off
leave it active until I turn it off

words.zhGloss: 身份未经核验的发件人
words.enDefinition: a sender whose identity has not been confirmed by the service
acceptedZhAnswers: 身份未经核验的发件人

examples.en: The app marked the email as coming from an unverified sender that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午，应用把这封邮件标为「身份未经核验的发件人」所发。

examples.en: I asked what unverified sender meant before replying to the message from outside campus.
examples.zh: 回复校外消息前，我先问了「身份未经核验的发件人」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: an option to install each available app update together

examples.en: I chose “Update all” after checking which study apps had new versions.
examples.zh: 查完哪些学习应用出了新版本后，我选了「全部更新」。

examples.en: The store displayed an “Update all” button above the available updates.
examples.zh: 商店在可用更新的上方显示了「全部更新」按钮。

words.enDefinition: a message saying that a newer version can be installed

examples.en: I saw “Update available” beside the note-taking app that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早晨，我在笔记应用旁看到了「有可用更新」。

examples.en: The store displayed “Update available” above the description of the new drawing tools.
examples.zh: 商店在新绘画工具的说明上方显示了「有可用更新」。

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that a newer version has finished installing

examples.en: I saw “Update complete” before opening the planner again after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我先看到「更新完成」，才重新打开计划工具。

examples.en: The store showed “Update complete” below the drawing app's name.
examples.zh: 商店在绘画应用的名称下方显示了「更新完成」。

words.enDefinition: an option to postpone installation of a newer version

examples.en: I tapped “Update later” because I was about to open my timetable.
examples.zh: 我正要打开课表，就点了「稍后更新」。

examples.en: The store offered “Update later” next to the immediate install option.
examples.zh: 商店在立即安装选项旁提供了「稍后更新」。

words.enDefinition: to change the contact information or options used to regain access to an account

examples.en: I remembered to update recovery details before giving up my old mobile number.
examples.zh: 停用旧手机号码之前，我记得先「更新账户找回信息」。

examples.en: Our adviser reminded students to update recovery details when they move to another country.
examples.zh: 顾问提醒学生，搬到另一个国家时要「更新账户找回信息」。

collocations: update recovery details in account settings

words.enDefinition: a status showing that selected updates are waiting to be installed

examples.en: The tablet still showed “Updates pending” when I checked it after class.
examples.zh: 我下课后查看平板时，还是显示「更新待安装」。

examples.en: I noticed “Updates pending” at the top of the app list.
examples.zh: 我在应用列表顶部看到了「更新待安装」。

words.enDefinition: to move from a current subscription to a higher service level

examples.en: I checked what changed if I chose to upgrade a subscription that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我查看了选择「升级订阅套餐」会有哪些变化。

examples.en: The app showed where to upgrade a subscription from its account page.
examples.zh: 应用指明了在账户页面哪里可以「升级订阅套餐」。

collocations: an option to upgrade a subscription
check whether you can upgrade a subscription

words.enDefinition: To send a folder and its contents to an online service in one operation.

examples.en: Our class assistant helped us upload a folder containing the diagrams from the architecture workshop.
examples.zh: 班级助手帮我们「上传了文件夹」，里面有建筑工作坊用过的示意图。

examples.en: Can I upload a folder with separate copies of the slides for each presenter to review?
examples.zh: 我能「上传一个文件夹」吗？里面放各位展示者供自己审阅的幻灯片副本。

collocations: upload a folder to the drive
upload a folder from your computer

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a file is being sent to the app

examples.en: The screen showed “Upload in progress” while our club video was being sent.
examples.zh: 我们的社团视频在传输时，屏幕显示「正在上传」。

examples.en: I waited when “Upload in progress” appeared under the photos I had picked.
examples.zh: 选好的照片下方出现「正在上传」时，我等了一会儿。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that an upload has stopped temporarily before completing.

examples.en: The Upload paused notice appeared while I was switching from my home network to the hotspot.
examples.zh: 我从家里网络切换到热点时，屏幕上出现了「上传已暂停」的提示。

examples.en: I saw Upload paused beside the rehearsal video and told my group it might arrive later.
examples.zh: 我看到排练视频旁显示「上传已暂停」，便告诉小组视频可能晚些才会传好。

words.enDefinition: The list of files waiting for their turn to be uploaded.

examples.en: The upload queue still held two videos when our group finished rehearsing in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我们小组在教室排练结束时，「上传队列」里还有两个视频。

examples.en: I added the handout to the upload queue after checking that the latest chart was included.
examples.zh: 我确认已放入最新图表后，把讲义加入了「上传队列」。

collocations: add files to the upload queue

words.enDefinition: a summary separating mobile use into categories such as calls, messages, or data

examples.en: The usage breakdown showed that the extra charge came from a call I made while abroad.
examples.zh: 「通信使用量明细」显示，那笔额外费用来自我在境外拨打的一通电话。

examples.en: I checked the usage breakdown after comparing my plan with the students' offer.
examples.zh: 把自己的套餐与学生优惠比较后，我查了「通信使用量明细」。

words.enDefinition: a record of how a device or its apps were used previously

examples.en: My usage history included the time I spent reading on the tablet.
examples.zh: 我的「使用记录」里有在平板上阅读的时长。

examples.en: I looked at last month's usage history to compare it with this week.
examples.zh: 我查了上个月的「使用记录」，想和这周比较。

words.enDefinition: a socket for the small reversible connector used on many computers and other devices

examples.en: I connected the lecture room adapter to the USB-C port on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我把讲堂里的适配器连到笔记本的「USB-C 接口」。

examples.en: The new tablet has a USB-C port on the side facing my desk.
examples.zh: 新平板朝向我桌子的一侧有一个「USB-C 接口」。

words.enDefinition: a device that adds multiple USB connections through a single port

examples.en: I used a USB hub to connect a mouse and a drive during class.
examples.zh: 我上课时用「USB 集线器」接上了鼠标和存储盘。

examples.en: The library loan desk had one USB hub left when my group arrived.
examples.zh: 我们小组到图书馆借用服务台时，那里只剩一个「USB 集线器」。

collocations: plug devices into a USB hub

words.enDefinition: a setting making an app follow the device's language choice

examples.en: I chose “Use device language” after checking the reader's own options.
examples.zh: 看过阅读器自己的选项后，我选了「使用设备语言」。

examples.en: The app listed “Use device language” above the other available languages.
examples.zh: 应用在其他可用语言的上方列了「使用设备语言」。

words.enDefinition: a choice to follow the system's values for supported preferences

examples.en: I chose “Use device settings” to match the tablet's date display.
examples.zh: 我选了「使用设备设置」，让日期显示和平板一致。

examples.en: The preferences screen displayed “Use device settings” beneath the units menu.
examples.zh: 偏好设置页面在单位菜单下方显示了「使用设备设置」。

words.expression: use the name they sign with
words.lemma: use the name they sign with
words.zhGloss: 按对方邮件署名来称呼
words.enDefinition: to address people using the name they put beneath their message
acceptedZhAnswers: 按对方邮件署名来称呼
acceptedEnVariants: use the name they sign with

examples.en: I asked whether to use the name they sign with when replying to the department tutor.
examples.zh: 我问，回复系里的导师时是否可以「按对方邮件署名来称呼」。

examples.en: It felt more natural to use the name they sign with after our second exchange.
examples.zh: 第二次邮件往来后，「按对方邮件署名来称呼」感觉自然些。

collocations: choose to use the name they sign with
remember to use the name they sign with
comfortable to use the name they sign with

words.enDefinition: a notification or screen asking you to confirm your identity or a particular action

examples.en: A verification prompt appeared when I opened the student portal on my new tablet.
examples.zh: 我在新平板上打开学生门户时，弹出了一条「验证提示」。

examples.en: The support page explains why you sometimes see a verification prompt after changing settings.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了为什么更改设置后有时会看到「验证提示」。

words.enDefinition: to check a request using contact details or evidence separate from the original message

examples.en: My adviser suggested I verify the request independently through the department's website that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，顾问建议我通过院系网站「独立核实请求」。

examples.en: If you're unsure, verify the request independently before you provide information or make a payment.
examples.zh: 如果拿不准，请先「独立核实请求」，再提供信息或付款。

collocations: verify the request independently before responding
take time to verify the request independently

words.enDefinition: to check that a message came from the person or institution it claims

examples.en: I called the department to verify the sender of the message about our final exam.
examples.zh: 我给系里打了电话，就期末考试通知「核实发件人身份」。

examples.en: The training asked us to verify the sender before trusting an unexpected payment request.
examples.zh: 培训请我们先「核实发件人身份」，再判断意外收到的付款请求是否可信。

collocations: take time to verify the sender
ask how to verify the sender

words.enDefinition: the label identifying a particular release of an app

examples.en: I checked the version number before comparing screens with my roommate.
examples.zh: 和室友对比画面之前，我先查了「版本号」。

examples.en: The version number appeared at the bottom of the app information page.
examples.zh: 「版本号」显示在应用信息页的底部。

words.enDefinition: a video whose image is taller than it is wide

examples.en: I recorded a vertical video because my friends would watch on phones.
examples.zh: 朋友们会在手机上看，所以我录了一个「竖屏视频」。

examples.en: The vertical video showed the whole poster without needing to turn the phone.
examples.zh: 「竖屏视频」能看到整张海报，不用把手机横过来。

words.enDefinition: to give a vibration alert while sound is turned off

examples.en: I set my phone to vibrate on silent before the group workshop.
examples.zh: 小组工作坊开始前，我设置手机「静音时仍振动」。

examples.en: The device can vibrate on silent when an alert would otherwise make noise.
examples.zh: 设备可以「静音时仍振动」，本来会响的提醒就能靠振动提示。

collocations: set the phone to vibrate on silent
let the watch vibrate on silent

words.enDefinition: a particular sequence of vibrations used for an alert

examples.en: I chose a different vibration pattern for changes to my timetable.
examples.zh: 我为课表变更提醒选了另一种「振动节奏」。

examples.en: The vibration pattern helped me tell my timer apart from incoming calls.
examples.zh: 「振动节奏」让我可以区分计时提醒和来电。

words.enDefinition: an option for seeing your own page as an outside viewer would

examples.en: I chose “View as visitor” to check how my new profile looked.
examples.zh: 我选了「以访客视角查看」，看看自己的新主页是什么样。

examples.en: The student group used “View as visitor” before sharing its profile link.
examples.zh: 学习小组分享主页链接前，用了「以访客视角查看」。

words.enDefinition: Permission to see a file without making changes to it.

examples.en: The tutor gave us view-only access to the sample so the original would stay intact.
examples.zh: 导师给了我们示例的「仅查看权限」，这样原文件能保持完整。

examples.en: I could read the slides with view-only access while another classmate worked on the speaker notes.
examples.zh: 我用「仅查看权限」阅读幻灯片，另一位同学在编辑演讲备注。

collocations: open a file with view-only access

words.enDefinition: an option for expanding the answers attached to a comment

examples.en: I tapped “View replies” to see what the club had written.
examples.zh: 我点了「查看回复」，想看看社团写了什么。

examples.en: The post showed “View replies” below the question about opening hours.
examples.zh: 帖子在营业时间的问题下方显示了「查看回复」。

words.enDefinition: A display mode you can select to review content without making direct edits.

examples.en: I switched to viewing mode before reading the draft aloud to our study group.
examples.zh: 给学习小组朗读草稿前，我切换到了「查看模式」。

examples.en: The teaching assistant kept the file in viewing mode while checking everyone's references yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天助教核对大家的参考文献时，让文件保持在「查看模式」。

words.enDefinition: phishing carried out through phone calls or other voice communications

examples.en: We learned about vishing in the session on staying safe during phone calls.
examples.zh: 我们在通话安全讲座上了解了「语音通话钓鱼」。

examples.en: Campus IT included vishing in its notice about suspicious calls to student accommodation.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门在关于学生宿舍可疑来电的通告中提到了「语音通话钓鱼」。

words.enDefinition: a visible signal that draws attention without relying on sound

examples.en: I noticed a visual alert on the screen while wearing headphones.
examples.zh: 我戴着耳机时，注意到屏幕上有个「视觉提醒」。

examples.en: The tablet can show a visual alert instead of playing a sound.
examples.zh: 平板可以显示「视觉提醒」，不用播放提示音。

words.enDefinition: a service showing voicemail messages in a list so they can be selected individually

examples.en: I opened visual voicemail to play the message that arrived just after class.
examples.zh: 我打开「可视化语音信箱」，播放了下课后刚收到的那条留言。

examples.en: The provider added visual voicemail to the options shown for my second line.
examples.zh: 运营商在第二条线路的可用选项里加了「可视化语音信箱」。

words.enDefinition: a spoken instruction that tells a device or program to carry out an action

examples.en: I used a voice command to open the notes for my afternoon class.
examples.zh: 我用一条「语音指令」打开了下午那门课的笔记。

examples.en: The support guide gives an example of a voice command for selecting a menu item.
examples.zh: 支持指南举了一条「语音指令」的例子，演示如何选择菜单项。

words.enDefinition: using spoken instructions to operate a device or its interface

examples.en: I enabled voice control so I could open the next page without using my hands.
examples.zh: 我启用了「语音控制」，这样不用动手就能打开下一页。

examples.en: The assistant used voice control to search the settings menu during our device workshop.
examples.zh: 设备工作坊上，工作人员用「语音控制」搜索了设置菜单。

words.enDefinition: technology for transmitting voice calls over an internet protocol network

examples.en: Our student office used voice over internet protocol for calls made from its desk phones.
examples.zh: 学生办公室的座机用的是「互联网协议语音通话」技术。

examples.en: The brochure mentioned voice over internet protocol separately from the mobile voice plan I had.
examples.zh: 宣传册把「互联网协议语音通话」和我现有的手机通话套餐分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: phone calling that carries voice through the LTE mobile network

examples.en: The provider said voice over LTE was available on the handset I had brought.
examples.zh: 运营商说，我带来的手机可以用「LTE网络语音通话」。

examples.en: I checked the settings for voice over LTE after changing the device's mobile plan.
examples.zh: 我更换设备的通信套餐后，查看了「LTE网络语音通话」的设置。

words.enDefinition: entering text in a document or field by speaking rather than typing

examples.en: I used voice typing to draft a short email when my hands were tired.
examples.zh: 手累的时候，我用「语音输入」起草了一封简短的邮件。

examples.en: The instructor explained how to start voice typing in the shared document before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，导师解释了如何在共享文档里开始「语音输入」。

words.enDefinition: an alert telling someone a new voicemail is available

examples.en: I got a voicemail notification while the train was passing through the university town.
examples.zh: 火车经过大学城时，我收到了一条「语音留言通知」。

examples.en: The voicemail notification stayed on my screen until I listened to the message.
examples.zh: 我收听留言后，「语音留言通知」才从屏幕上消失。

words.enDefinition: a control that can adjust the level of multiple audio sources or applications separately

examples.en: I used the volume mixer to lower the music without changing the lecture recording.
examples.zh: 我用「音量混合器」调低音乐音量，同时保留课堂录音的音量。

examples.en: The support guide shows where to find the volume mixer on the study room computer.
examples.zh: 支持指南指明了自习室电脑的「音量混合器」在哪里。

collocations: adjust levels in the volume mixer

words.enDefinition: a paired or rocking control with one end for increasing volume and another for decreasing it

examples.en: I used the volume rocker to turn the sound down before entering the library.
examples.zh: 进图书馆之前，我用「音量翘板键」调低了声音。

examples.en: The case made the volume rocker hard to press while I was wearing gloves.
examples.zh: 戴着手套时，那个保护壳让「音量翘板键」不太好按。

words.enDefinition: to make a device's display turn on after it has gone dark

examples.en: I tapped the tablet to wake the screen and check the next workshop time.
examples.zh: 我点了平板「唤醒屏幕」，查看下一场工作坊的时间。

examples.en: My laptop lets me wake the screen by touching the trackpad during a break.
examples.zh: 休息时，我轻碰笔记本触控板就能「唤醒屏幕」。

collocations: press a key to wake the screen

words.enDefinition: a charger that plugs into a wall socket to supply power to a device

examples.en: I left my wall charger in the seminar room after borrowing an outlet near the door.
examples.zh: 我在门旁找插座充了会儿电，离开时把「插座式充电器」落在了研讨室。

examples.en: A wall charger was included with the tablet we borrowed for the workshop that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我们为下午工作坊借的平板附带了一个「插座式充电器」。

words.enDefinition: reminds the instructor of an earlier conversation after a class

examples.en: We spoke after class on Wednesday about my idea for the final project.
examples.zh: 「我们周三课后谈过」我期末项目的构想。

examples.en: We spoke after class yesterday and you suggested I send you the outline.
examples.zh: 「我们昨天课后谈过」，当时您建议我把提纲发给您。

collocations: remind her we spoke after class

words.enDefinition: a password that is relatively easy to guess or predict

examples.en: The registration page rejected my weak password before it let me create the account.
examples.zh: 注册页面拒绝了我的「弱密码」，所以账户当时没有创建成功。

examples.en: Campus IT explained why a weak password can leave a university account exposed.
examples.zh: 校园信息技术部门解释了为什么「弱密码」会给校园账户带来安全风险。

words.enDefinition: a version of software accessed through a web browser

examples.en: We used the web version when working on the library's shared computers.
examples.zh: 我们用图书馆的共用电脑时，选了「网页版」。

examples.en: The web version let me open the reading tool from my browser.
examples.zh: 「网页版」让我能直接从浏览器打开阅读工具。

collocations: a link to the web version

words.enDefinition: the difference in a measurement between consecutive weeks

examples.en: The screen report showed the week-over-week change in my evening use.
examples.zh: 屏幕使用报告显示了我晚上用设备「较上周的变化」。

examples.en: I could see the week-over-week change after classes moved back into the lecture hall.
examples.zh: 课程改回大教室后，我就能看到「较上周的变化」。

words.enDefinition: a change or pattern in device use across several weeks

examples.en: I checked the weekly usage trend to compare midterms with quieter weeks.
examples.zh: 我查看「每周使用趋势」，对比期中考试周和课业较少的几周。

examples.en: My dashboard showed a weekly usage trend rather than just today's total.
examples.zh: 仪表板显示了「每周使用趋势」，也能看到今天以外的变化。

collocations: look at the weekly usage trend

words.expression: what should I focus on revising
words.lemma: what should i focus on revising
words.zhGloss: 我该重点修改哪些地方
words.enDefinition: asks which parts of written work most need improvement
acceptedZhAnswers: 我该重点修改哪些地方
acceptedEnVariants: what should I focus on revising

examples.en: What should I focus on revising before I send you the next draft of the paper?
examples.zh: 给您发下一版草稿之前，「我该重点修改哪些地方」？

examples.en: What should I focus on revising if I only have time to rewrite two sections?
examples.zh: 如果我只来得及重写两节，「我该重点修改哪些地方」？

collocations: ask what I should focus on revising
explain what I should focus on revising
what should I focus on revising first

words.expression: where should I send my draft
words.lemma: where should i send my draft
words.enDefinition: asks which inbox or online channel to use for the draft
acceptedEnVariants: where should I send my draft

examples.en: Where should I send my draft if I want comments from both members of the teaching team?
examples.zh: 如果我想听两位授课老师的意见，「我的草稿该发到哪里」？

examples.en: Where should I send my draft? The supervisor's address isn't on the course page yet.
examples.zh: 「我的草稿该发到哪里」？课程页面上还没有导师的邮箱。

collocations: where should I send my draft for comments
where should I send my draft after I revise it
ask where I should send my draft

words.expression: which citation style should we use
words.lemma: which citation style should we use
words.zhGloss: 我们该用哪种引用格式
words.enDefinition: asks which recognised style to follow when citing sources
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们该用哪种引用格式
acceptedEnVariants: which citation style should we use

examples.en: Which citation style should we use for a short presentation with only two sources in it?
examples.zh: 只有两个来源的简短展示，「我们该用哪种引用格式」？

examples.en: Which citation style should we use? The slides and the sample paper use different ones.
examples.zh: 「我们该用哪种引用格式」？幻灯片和示例论文用的不一样。

collocations: which citation style should we use in the report
which citation style should we use for images
check which citation style we should use

words.enDefinition: asks which tasks receive separate marks for each student

examples.en: Which parts are assessed individually in the group presentation, besides the short written reflection?
examples.zh: 小组展示除了简短的书面反思，「哪些部分单独评分」？

examples.en: Could you confirm which parts are assessed individually before our group divides up the work?
examples.zh: 在我们组分工前，您能确认「哪些部分单独评分」吗？

collocations: check which parts are assessed individually
ask which parts are assessed individually
explain which parts are assessed individually

words.expression: which submission format should we use
words.lemma: which submission format should we use
words.zhGloss: 我们该用哪种提交格式
words.enDefinition: asks what format the instructor wants students to submit work in
acceptedZhAnswers: 我们该用哪种提交格式
acceptedEnVariants: which submission format should we use

examples.en: Which submission format should we use for the group poster? Our template has two export options.
examples.zh: 小组海报「我们该用哪种提交格式」？模板有两个导出选项。

examples.en: Which submission format should we use if our report includes handwritten diagrams and notes from the lab?
examples.zh: 如果报告里有手绘图和实验笔记，「我们该用哪种提交格式」？

collocations: which submission format should we use for the poster
which submission format should we use online
email to ask which submission format we should use

words.expression: which teaching assistant should I contact
words.lemma: which teaching assistant should i contact
words.enDefinition: asks which teaching assistant is responsible for your particular question
acceptedEnVariants: which teaching assistant should I contact

examples.en: Which teaching assistant should I contact about the missing notes for Tuesday's field trip?
examples.zh: 周二实地考察资料缺失的问题，「我该联系哪位助教」？

examples.en: Which teaching assistant should I contact if my usual lab group has moved to another room?
examples.zh: 如果平时那组实验课换了教室，「我该联系哪位助教」？

collocations: ask which teaching assistant I should contact
which teaching assistant should I contact about my grade
which teaching assistant should I contact this week

words.enDefinition: asks which copy or edition of a reading to use

examples.en: Could you confirm which version of the reading we should use for Tuesday's seminar?
examples.zh: 能确认一下周二研讨课用「阅读材料的哪个版本」吗？

examples.en: I asked which version of the reading was meant for the second discussion group.
examples.zh: 我问第二个讨论小组该用「阅读材料的哪个版本」。

collocations: check which version of the reading
ask which version of the reading
confirm which version of the reading is correct

words.enDefinition: a question asking which people may see stories you share

examples.en: I asked, “Who can view my stories?” before sharing the picnic photo.
examples.zh: 分享野餐照片之前，我问了句「谁能看我的限时动态？」

examples.en: “Who can view my stories?” my roommate asked while checking her profile.
examples.zh: 室友查看主页时问「谁能看我的限时动态？」

collocations: “Who can view my stories after I change this?”
“Who can view my stories right now?”

words.enDefinition: equipment that lets nearby wireless devices connect to a network

examples.en: The Wi-Fi access point was mounted high on the wall in our study room.
examples.zh: 「无线网络接入点」装在我们自习室墙上较高的位置。

examples.en: The building manager listed work on a Wi-Fi access point near the north stairs.
examples.zh: 楼管列出了北侧楼梯附近一个「无线网络接入点」的维护工作。

collocations: connect to a Wi-Fi access point

words.enDefinition: a range of radio frequencies used by a wireless network

examples.en: My phone displayed a different Wi-Fi band from the one listed on the laptop.
examples.zh: 我手机显示的「无线网频段」和笔记本电脑上列出的不同。

examples.en: The support page explained which Wi-Fi band the older tablet could connect to.
examples.zh: 支持页面解释了较旧的平板可以连接哪个「无线网频段」。

words.enDefinition: a feature using Wi-Fi to carry ordinary phone calls on a supporting plan

examples.en: I used Wi-Fi calling in the residence because the mobile signal was hard to get.
examples.zh: 宿舍里手机信号不容易收到，我用了「无线网络通话」。

examples.en: The provider explained how Wi-Fi calling appeared on my device when I made a call.
examples.zh: 运营商解释了打电话时，手机上怎样显示「无线网络通话」。

words.zhGloss: 无线网已连接但无法上网
words.enDefinition: a status saying a device has joined Wi-Fi but cannot reach the internet
acceptedZhAnswers: 无线网已连接但无法上网

examples.en: The tablet displayed Wi-Fi connected without internet even though the signal was strong.
examples.zh: 虽然信号很强，平板却显示「无线网已连接但无法上网」。

examples.en: Our phone showed Wi-Fi connected without internet while the library's provider investigated a fault.
examples.zh: 图书馆的运营商调查故障期间，我们的手机显示「无线网已连接但无法上网」。

words.enDefinition: the distance within which a wireless network's signal can be used

examples.en: Our table was within Wi-Fi range even at the far end of the study hall.
examples.zh: 即使在自习大厅远端，我们的桌子仍在「无线网络覆盖范围」内。

examples.en: I asked whether the building's Wi-Fi range extended into the courtyard outside the library.
examples.zh: 我问这栋楼的「无线网络覆盖范围」是否延伸到图书馆外的庭院。

words.zhGloss: 无线网络信号减弱或中断
words.enDefinition: a phrase saying the wireless signal suddenly weakens or disappears
acceptedZhAnswers: 无线网络信号减弱或中断

examples.en: Our tutor asked where the Wi-Fi signal drops most often in the building.
examples.zh: 导师问，这栋楼里哪里最常出现「无线网络信号减弱或中断」。

examples.en: The laptop sometimes freezes when the Wi-Fi signal drops during a video call.
examples.zh: 视频通话中「无线网络信号减弱或中断」时，笔记本电脑的画面有时会卡住。

collocations: Wi-Fi signal drops in the hallway
check when the Wi-Fi signal drops
notice where the Wi-Fi signal drops

words.enDefinition: a status saying that an active plan will not continue automatically

examples.en: The account showed “Will not renew” under the name of my reading plan.
examples.zh: 账户在阅读套餐名称下方显示「将不再续订」。

examples.en: I checked the date beside “Will not renew” before closing the app.
examples.zh: 关闭应用之前，我核对了「将不再续订」旁的日期。

words.enDefinition: A file copy used to make changes or do current work.

examples.en: I kept a working copy of the poster so the original could stay in our archive.
examples.zh: 我保留了一份海报的「编辑用副本」，让原件继续放在归档区。

examples.en: Could I use your working copy for tomorrow's session if you have already added the diagrams?
examples.zh: 如果你已经加上示意图，明天的讨论可以用你的「编辑用副本」吗？

collocations: share a working copy with reviewers

words.enDefinition: asks whether the planned work would satisfy stated assignment criteria

examples.en: Would this meet the requirements if I combined the interview notes with a short survey?
examples.zh: 如果我把采访记录和一份简短问卷结合起来，「这能满足要求吗」？

examples.en: Would this meet the requirements for the analysis section, or should I add another example?
examples.zh: 对于分析部分，「这能满足要求吗」？还是该再加一个例子？

collocations: ask whether this would meet the requirements
would this meet the requirements for the report
would this meet the requirements for the presentation

words.enDefinition: A message saying that the current account does not have access to the item.

examples.en: I got “You need permission” after opening the draft from the wrong account on campus.
examples.zh: 我在学校用错账号打开草稿时，看见了「你需要访问权限」。

examples.en: The screen said “You need permission” when I followed a classmate's link to her folder.
examples.zh: 我点开同学发来的文件夹链接时，屏幕显示「你需要访问权限」。

collocations: a warning saying you need permission
a message reading you need permission
an error labeled you need permission
